article.articleHeadline: 女子上山挖笋蜱虫身上爬了4天 警惕“蜱虫病”风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman climbs a mountain to dig bamboo shoots; a tick crawled on her body for four days—beware the risk of tick-borne disease.
article.articleSummary: In Wuhu, Anhui Province, China, a woman digging bamboo shoots found a tick on her leg four days after exposure; she had the tick removed and blood tests plus a novel bunyavirus nucleic acid test were negative, with no symptoms. The article highlights the risk of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (tick-borne disease) transmitted by ticks, which can cause fever, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, and, in severe cases, bleeding or neurologic symptoms. Tick season runs from April to October, mainly in mountainous and hilly areas where ticks are common. High-risk groups include farmers and tea-pickers. Prevention emphasizes avoiding prolonged time in grassy or wooded habitats, wearing light-colored long clothing, tucking pants, using repellents, and inspecting skin, clothing, and pets after outdoor activity. If bitten and removal is difficult, or if fever or bleeding occurs, seek medical care and report outdoor exposure and tick bite history.

triage.headline_ja: 女性が山に竹の子を掘りに行き、4日間ダニが体に付着—「ダニ媒介病」のリスクに警戒を
triage.triage_reason: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症）の予防啓発記事であり、当該症例は検査陰性で無症状。地域的には該当するが、現在の公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常な集団発生の証拠がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は芜湖市（安徽省）における1件のダニ刺傷事例を通じた、SFTS媒介リスクに関する一般向け啓発記事。当該症例は検査陰性で症状なし。季節的なダニ媒介感染症リスク（4〜10月）は既知であり、特定の集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。ただし、SFTS媒介ベクトル関連の記事として、地域的リスク管理の継続監視は有用。

article.articleHeadline: 郑州近期感冒患儿增多 鼻病毒成“主力”
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rhinovirus has become the main culprit behind Zhengzhou's recent surge in pediatric colds
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-30, rhinovirus is the leading cause of Zhengzhou’s surge in pediatric colds. In Zhengzhou University First Affiliated Hospital and other pediatric clinics, visits for coughs and runny noses have risen; about 30% of hospitalized children test positive for rhinovirus, with many outpatients having nasal congestion, sneezing, and low-grade fever, and some developing otitis media or sinusitis or asthma exacerbations. Clinicians differentiate rhinovirus from influenza, which typically causes sustained high fever and body aches, while rhinovirus presents with milder fever and upper-respiratory symptoms. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive and antibiotics are not routinely needed. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene and ventilation, with traditional Chinese medicine treating rhinovirus by wind-cold/wind-heat patterns. Red flags for urgent care include fever over 3 days, afebrile but altered mental state or irritability, poor intake with dehydration, rapid breathing or dyspnea, and asthma or acute laryngitis with ear pain.

triage.headline_ja: 鄭州近期の小児風邪患者が増加、ライノウイルスが「主要因」に
triage.triage_reason: ライノウイルスによる小児呼吸器疾患の増加が報告されているが、インフルエンザではなく軽度の症状が主体であり、死亡や重症化の証拠がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 疾患はライノウイルスであり、IHRで記載されているインフルエンザではない。記事タイトルでインフルエンザと対比されているが、検出されているのはライノウイルスが主。小児を中心とした軽度の呼吸器症状が特徴であり、重症度は低い。ただし、ウイルス性呼吸器感染症の季節的増加として注視の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud confirma nuevos casos de chikungunya en Venezuela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms new chikungunya cases in Venezuela.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya reappears in Venezuela, with four confirmed cases between late 2025 and April 2026. The first infection occurred in Sucre state, with the other three in the Capital District, specifically the Sucre and San Agustín parishes. The disease is endemic and lacks a vaccine; management is symptomatic. Malaria shows a 7.4% year-over-year rise, totaling 29,283 cases in 2026 so far, led by Bolívar, Amazonas, and Apure among the seven most affected states. Yellow fever caused 21 deaths from June 2025 to March 2026 (fatality around 50%), with 40 confirmed cases across 14 states; Barinas and Monagas report the highest patient counts. Surveillance recorded 116 primate-death events since January 2025, led by Aragua with 74, indicating active circulation and spillover risk to rural or forested areas. The Ministry has published three epidemiological reports after a decade of gaps; the chikungunya bulletin was removed from its site, and weekly data remain incomplete.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がベネズエラでのチクングニア熱の新規症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病（致死率約50%、21人死亡）、チクングニア熱の再出現、マラリア症例の年間7.4%増加が同時並行で発生。複数の蚊媒介感染症の同時流行と霊長類死亡事象の増加は国際的拡大リスクを示唆し、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はベネズエラ国内の複数州が中心。ブラジルは地理的に隣接し蚊媒介感染症の越境拡大リスクがあるため対象国として含める。黄熱病（50%致死率、21人死亡）、チクングニア熱の再出現、マラリアの急増、霊長類死亡の多発（アラグアで74件）が同時に報告されており、複合感染症危機の様相。10年間の監視ギャップ後の報告再開という点も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: PLN NP Dukung Percepatan Eliminasi Tuberkulosis lewat Kampung Siaga TB - Suara Merdeka Surabaya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PLN NP Supports Accelerated TB Elimination Through TB Alert Village - Suara Merdeka Surabaya
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) elimination efforts in Indonesia are being accelerated by PLN Nusantara Power (PLN NP) through the Punggawa Nusantara program, led by UP Muara Karang in Jakarta North’s Pluit and expanding its reach. The community-driven approach engages puskesmas, local government, partner groups, and female TB cadres (Srikandi Nusantara) to strengthen prevention, early detection, patient support (via the BEBAS TB app), and economic empowerment through circular-economy community enterprises. Sub-programs Arjuna, Sadewa, Bima, and Nakula coordinate integrated interventions, including communal sanitation, mass TB screening with chest X-ray, TCM, and Mantoux tests. The initiative also promotes environmental improvements such as waste reduction and cleaner energy for mobile X-ray units. In 2025, TB screening increased 83.4% to 948 suspected cases from 517, with a 100% cure rate reported in Kelurahan Pluit, Jakarta. The program aims to empower communities to sustain TB elimination efforts in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: PLN NP、カンプン・シアガ・TBを通じた結核排除加速を支援 - スアラ・メルデカ・スラバヤ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核排除プログラムの進捗報告で、公衆衛生面での肯定的な動き（2025年のスクリーニング83.4%増加、100%治癒率）が報告されている。ただし異常な疾患の流行や国際的拡大のリスク、重症度の急増が示唆されていないため、IHR基準やWPRO基準の複数該当には至らない。継続的な監視により、プログラムの実効性や潜在的な課題の出現を注視する必要があり、情報不足の段階では WATCH が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核排除プログラムの実績報告であり、異常な流行・急増ではなく、既存プログラムによる成果の進捗を述べている。記事サマリーに記載されている「2025年TB screening増加83.4%」は新規検査数の増加（検出率向上）を示唆しており、感染症の新規流行ではなく検査体制強化の結果と解釈される。政府機関（PLN NP）の関心は高いが、国際的関心や国家間の支援必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 衡阳县疾控中心开展疟疾、性病艾滋病、肝炎防治知识进社区宣传活动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hengyang County Center for Disease Control and Prevention launches a community outreach campaign on malaria, sexually transmitted diseases and HIV/AIDS, and hepatitis prevention and control knowledge.
article.articleSummary: Hengyang County Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in collaboration with the Red Ribbon Care Association, launched a community outreach campaign in Jiangkou Community, Xidu Town, Hengyang County, to consolidate malaria elimination and raise awareness of hepatitis C, sexually transmitted diseases, and HIV/AIDS prevention. Coinciding with Malaria Day, the theme was 'Prevent malaria, prevent importation, early detection, early treatment.' Staff and volunteers explained malaria transmission by mosquitoes, common symptoms (periodic chills, high fever, sweating), and outdoor protection measures (long sleeves, mosquito nets with repellents, eliminating standing water). They also covered HIV/AIDS and hepatitis C transmission, prevention, and treatment policies, along with broader chronic disease education (cancer, hypertension, diabetes, stroke). An on-site rapid hepatitis C antibody test was offered; abnormal results prompted further clinical referral. Residents actively engaged, enhancing disease prevention awareness and supporting HIV/AIDS control efforts and a harmonious community.

triage.headline_ja: 衡陽県疾病対策予防センター、マラリア・性感染症・HIV/AIDS・肝炎の予防知識に関するコミュニティ啓発活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は疾病予防啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやイベント報告ではない。IHR基準・WPROs基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアデーに合わせた予防啓発キャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規患者の報告やアウトブレイク事象ではない。定期的な公衆衛生活動の一環として報道されており、シグナル検出の対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Inteligência artificial identifica genomas da gripe aviária com maior risco de adaptação a mamíferos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Artificial intelligence identifies avian influenza genomes with a higher risk of adapting to mammals.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"AI classifier from the University of Hong Kong identifies avian influenza A variants with higher risk of mammalian adaptation and transmission. Published in Nature Microbiology, the study analyzes extensive influenza A genomes and finds that reduced guanine and cytosine content correlates with greater potential for mammal-to-mammal spread. Avian influenza A usually circulates in birds but can infect mammals and humans; strains with sustained mammalian transmission markedly raise pandemic risk. The model treats low G+C content as a key genomic signature and argues for its integration into risk assessments. Led by Yongtao Ye with professor Lam Tsan-yuk, the Hong Kong team notes two evolutionary groups: bird-adapted and mammal-adapted lineages, with H5 clade 2.3.4.4b among the highest-risk, having infected minks, foxes, dairy cattle, and humans across regions. The classifier operates purely on genetic data, supporting calls for international surveillance adoption."}

triage.headline_ja: 人工知能がより高い哺乳類適応リスクを持つ鳥インフルエンザゲノムを特定
triage.triage_reason: H5N8鳥インフルエンザの哺乳類適応リスクに関する科学的知見が報告され、IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク、WPROスクリーニングで異常性・流行易性・管理可能性が該当。香港・中国での確認事例に基づき、パンデミックリスク評価として即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 香港大学発表のNature Microbiology掲載研究。H5Nクレード2.3.4.4bは既にミンク・キツネ・酪農牛・ヒトに感染確認。G+C含有量低下が哺乳類間感染能の重要なゲノムシグネチャとされ、国際監視体制への組み込み推奨。パンデミックリスク評価として極めて高い優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Escalating transmissibility of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome in a high-endemic region of China - Nature Communications
article.articleSummary: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) demonstrates rising transmissibility in Anhui Province, China, based on 3,883 reported cases from 2019–2023. The study, using a multi-population, multi-route model across humans, ticks, and animal hosts, estimates an average annual incidence of 1.3 per 100,000 and a case fatality rate of 3.1%. Cases peak from April to September, with the transmission season extending into early spring and late autumn. Farmers and older adults are the main high-risk groups; transmission risk is highest in central and southern Anhui. Model-derived basic reproduction number (R0) exceeded 1 from 2022 and reached 1.5 in 2023, with the top prefecture-level value of 3.3 observed in Chuzhou. Findings indicate sustained expansion of cross-species transmission in a high-endemic region and support geographically targeted interventions to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の高流行地域における重症熱性血小板減少症候群（SFTS）の感染性上昇 - Nature Communications
triage.triage_reason: SFTSの感染性が上昇傾向にあり、R0が2022年以降1を超え2023年には1.5に達している。中国安徽省における3,883症例の5年間の継時的分析であり、異常/予想外の傾向を示している。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）で複数該当し、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: Nature Communicationsに掲載された学術論文に基づくシグナル。5年間の実データ分析であり、R0上昇傾向、人-ダニ-動物間の交差種感染の持続的拡大、農民や高齢者の高リスク集団が特定されている。地理的ターゲット化した介入を支持する根拠が示唆されているため、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В Приморье обнаружили сальмонеллу в 27 тоннах куриных голеней из Китая
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella detected in 27 tons of chicken drumsticks from China in Primorye.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella detected in a 27-ton batch of frozen chicken drumsticks imported from China and seized in Vladivostok, Primorsky Krai. The product failed safety tests and was deemed non-compliant with technical regulations for food safety and poultry meat. On April 21, a Rosgraniznadzor inspector collected samples at a Vladivostok temporary storage warehouse; the samples were analyzed at the Primorsky branch of APK NATRYBA under enhanced laboratory control. A protocol dated April 29 confirmed Salmonella in the batch. The meat is being held separately in a refrigerated, isolated chamber pending examination, with the owner—a company from Nakhodka—receiving a withdrawal notice and a decision on the batch’s fate (use or destruction). Salmonella causes acute intestinal infection with diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, high fever, and dehydration; severe cases can lead to bloodstream infection, particularly in children and the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: 中国からのニワトリ手羽先27トンからサルモネラを検出、ロシア極東で
triage.triage_reason: 食品輸入検査での病原体検出であり、確認された感染症の流行ではない。人への健康被害の実際の発生は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは輸入食品の検査段階でのサルモネラ検出であり、実際の感染症患者の発生ではない。ロシアと中国が記事に登場するが、対象国リストに含まれていない。食品安全における通常の検査・検疫プロセスであり、シグナルとしてピックアップする必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 高端腸病毒疫苗再報捷 送菲律賓新藥審查 | 鉅亨網 - 台股新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State-of-the-art enterovirus vaccine scores another breakthrough, submitted to the Philippines for new drug review
article.articleSummary: High-end Vaccine (6547-TW) submitted a New Drug Application to the Philippine FDA for its Enterovirus 71 vaccine. In the Philippines, 2025 monitoring shows an explosive EV outbreak, with nearly 40,000 cases as of mid‑August 2025, over sixfold year‑on‑year growth; EV71 is the leading pathogen driving severe pediatric illness and central nervous system complications. With about 1.36 million births annually, vaccination demand is large, though no EV71 vaccine is approved in the country. General Manager Li Sixian says the year will focus on the ASEAN EV71 vaccine market; Vietnam has granted a drug license this year, with plans to launch there and file in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The news helped the stock rise, opening at NT$48.9, peaking at NT$49.75 (up ~3%), around NT$48.6 by 11:00 (up ~1%).

triage.headline_ja: 最先端腸病毒ワクチンが再び成果、フィリピンで新薬審査に提出
triage.triage_reason: EV71の地域的な流行（フィリピンで2025年に約4万症例）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の関心がある。しかし、本記事の主体はワクチン企業の新薬申請ニュースであり、感染症の流行状況に関する情報は限定的。複数国での流行可能性は示唆されるが、詳細な疫学情報が不足しているため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからフィリピンで2025年中盤時点で約4万症例のEV71を含む爆発的な腸病毒流行が報告されている。ベトナムでの既承認、シンガポール・マレーシア・タイ・フィリピンでの申請予定が記載されているが、本記事はワクチン企業のニュースリリース性が高く、流行の詳細疫学情報（発症・死亡数、年齢分布、神経合併症の詳細など）が限定的。IHR基準2つ以上該当およびWPRO基準4つ該当するものの、情報の主体性と詳細さから「WATCH」と判定。フルRRAに進める前に、公式な感染症流行情報の確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 黃金週赴日注意！日本麻疹創7年新高　年輕成人佔７成、東京最嚴重 | 健康 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Golden Week travel to Japan: Measles in Japan hits a seven-year high; young adults account for 70%, Tokyo hardest hit.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Japan peaks during Golden Week, with 362 confirmed cases in the first 16 weeks of 2026, already higher than last year’s 265 and potentially surpassing the 2019 outbreak peak of 744. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and the Kanto region. Cumulative by area: Tokyo 153; Kanagawa 36; Kagoshima 34; Chiba 24; Aichi 23; Saitama 22. Kagoshima has the highest per-million rate, followed by Tokyo. In the latest week, 57 new cases were reported, 40 in Tokyo; others appear in Kagoshima and Kanagawa. Age distribution shows 20–29 years 33%, 30–39 21%, 15–19 17% (71% combined), with 40–49 at 12%. Domestic transmission: 259 cases; imported: 33 (Indonesia 13; New Zealand 7; India 4). Taiwan reports its first measles import from Japan; Taiwan’s CDC raised travel advisory to Watch (Level 1). Emphasize vaccination amid rising travel and cross-border exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ゴールデンウィーク日本渡航注意！日本の麻疹が7年ぶりの高さ、若年成人が70%、東京が最も深刻
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。麻疹のアウトブレイクが7年ぶりの高水準に達し、複数国への輸入症例が報告され、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーで日本での麻疹の流行が述べられているが、日本は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。輸入症例の出発地としてインドネシア（13例）とインド（4例）が確認され、これらが対象国であるため記載。台湾への輸出もサマリーで言及されているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。Golden Week期間の渡航増加に伴う国際的なリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 宿主因子调控猪德尔塔冠状病毒复制机制获揭示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Host factors regulating porcine deltacoronavirus replication mechanism revealed.
article.articleSummary: Porcine deltacoronavirus (PDCoV), globally endemic for more than a decade, causes severe diarrhea and high mortality in suckling piglets and can infect birds, rodents, ruminants, and humans, challenging swine health and public health. Guangdong Academy of Agricultural Sciences' Institute of Animal Health researchers Zhang Jianfeng and Liu Zhicheng report that the pig-derived GTPase-binding protein 1 (sGBP1) robustly inhibits PDCoV replication via two complementary mechanisms. First, sGBP1's GTPase and α-helix domains interact with the viral replication-transcription complex scaffold protein NSP8, disrupting NSP8–NSP12 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase association and RTC formation. Second, sGBP1 directly binds viral RNA, preventing the RTC from obtaining a template and blocking transcription and replication. sGBP1 is an interferon-induced NTPase that hydrolyzes GTP to GDP and GMP. The work, funded by national programs, advances understanding of interferon-stimulated antiviral defenses and identifies new targets for anti-coronavirus therapies; online in Journal of Virology.

triage.headline_ja: 宿主因子调控猪德尔塔冠状病毒复制机制获揭示（豚デルタコロナウイルス複製機構の制御機序が解明）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は豚デルタコロナウイルス（PDCoV）の基礎研究に関する論文発表であり、現在の流行事例や公衆衛生危機を報告するものではない。疾患監視対象としてのシグナル特性を持たない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術論文の発表についての報道記事である。豚デルタコロナウイルスが人間への感染可能性について言及されているが、これは既知の性状であり、新たな流行事例や異常な感染事象の報告ではない。基礎研究成果の発表であるため、感染症危機管理上のシグナルとして識別されない。

article.articleHeadline: 繼越南取證、泰國送審後！高端腸病毒 EV71 疫苗再向菲律賓提交新藥審查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following Vietnam's regulatory clearance and Thailand's submission for review, the Gao-end EV71 vaccine again submits a new drug application to the Philippines for review.
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 vaccine Envacgen from Gao End Vaccine formally submitted a new drug application to the Philippine FDA, following approvals in Vietnam and a submission in Thailand as part of a Southeast Asia expansion strategy. In the Philippines, 2025 enterovirus outbreaks reached about 40,000 cases by August, with roughly 1.36 million births annually and no EV71 vaccine approved. If approved, Envacgen could immunize children aged 2 months to under 6 years, offering active protection for early childhood. Phase 3 trials reported high efficacy against Southeast Asian EV71 subtypes and durable antibody responses lasting more than five years; the data have been published in Vaccines, and The Lancet discussed the importance of pre-emptive vaccination for 2–6 month-olds and sustained immunity after a third dose. Envacgen has Taiwan regulatory clearance and Vietnam licensure, and is pursuing submissions in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの認可、タイの審査提出に続き、高端腸病毒 EV71 ワクチンがフィリピンに新薬承認申請を再度提出
triage.triage_reason: EV71ワクチンの多国間承認申請に関するニュースであり、フィリピンの2025年アウトブレイク（約40,000例）の背景がある。しかし、これは医薬品承認プロセスの報道であり、現在の流行イベントではなく、スクリーニング基準の判定に情報不足があるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はEV71ワクチンの多国間規制承認プロセスであり、現在の感染症流行の管理ニュースではない。フィリピンの2025年アウトブレイク（約40,000例）は背景情報として提示されているが、現在の流行状況の詳細は記載されていない。WPRO基準の「流行しやすさ」により1項目該当するが、医薬品開発・承認段階の報道であるため、アクティブな流行管理イベントとしてはPICKUPに至らないと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố 3 người đưa heo bệnh dịch tả châu Phi bán ra thị trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people indicted for selling pigs infected with African swine fever on the market.
article.articleSummary: On 30 April 2026, Thanh Hoa Provincial Police indict three suspects for violating food-safety regulations tied to slaughtering and marketing pigs infected with African Swine Fever (ASF). The defendants—Nguyen Khac Nguyen, 60; Nguyen Van Chien, 42; and Le Van Trung, 44—are linked to a slaughterhouse in Hamlet 3, Hoang Loc commune, Hoang Loc district. Investigators found three pigs slaughtered (total weight 384.5 kg) and eight more pigs in a pen (452 kg) with disease signs, all belonging to Nguyen’s farm. Instead of reporting illness, Nguyen sold the pigs cheaply to Trung, who then sold them to Chien for slaughter and market sale to profit. Laboratory tests confirmed ASF virus in the entire pig lot. The case remains under investigation. Separately, a driver transported about 100 ASF-infected pigs to the southern region for sale.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラに感染した豚を市場で販売した3人を起訴
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の複数感染豚の違法販売事件であり、食品安全性と公衆衛生への重大な影響、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク（食由来感染）を伴う異常事象。国際的な拡大リスク（南部地域への輸送記録あり）も認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ベトナムのタインホア省で発生した複数のASF感染豚（計11頭以上）の違法販売事件が主題。さらに南部地域への輸送（約100頭）という国内拡大の記録もあり、食品サプライチェーン汚染の懸念が高い。複数の違反者が起訴される異常事象として扱われており、政府の対応も進行中と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde lança no RJ a campanha nacional de vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health launches in Rio de Janeiro the national measles vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign launched in Rio de Janeiro as part of Brazil's national effort; the Ministry of Health, led by Alexandre Padilha, emphasizes free measles vaccination via SUS for children, adolescents, and adults, regardless of travel plans. This comes amid an international measles wave with active outbreaks in the United States, Mexico, and Canada—the World Cup host nations set to begin in June. The campaign targets travelers attending World Cup events, aiming to reduce importation and spread during mass gatherings. The launch also featured Raí, four-time world soccer champion. The initiative underscores vaccination before international travel; no specific measles case counts are provided in the release.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がリオデジャネイロで麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されており、米国・メキシコ・カナダでの流行を背景とした予防措置であるが、ブラジル国内での具体的な患者数・重症度・死亡例の報告がなく、シグナル確定には情報不足。国際的な関心（ワールドカップ開催国）と公衆衛生的対応は認められるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでの麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始を報じているもので、米国・メキシコ・カナダの流行状況は背景情報。ブラジル国内の確認患者数、重症度、死亡例の報告がないため IHR serious_impact は不明。しかし国際的な麻疹流行の広がりと大型イベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした感染予防キャンペーンであり、政治的関心は高い。継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Khỉ hoang liên tiếp cắn khách du lịch trên đường ven biển ở Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wild monkeys repeatedly bite tourists on the coastal road in Đắk Lắk.
article.articleSummary: Five tourists were bitten by wild monkeys along the coastal Phước Tân–Bãi Ngà route in Hòa Xuân commune, Đắk Lắk province, and were admitted to Phú Yên General Hospital (Đắk Lắk) on 30 April. All patients arrived alert and able to communicate. Three sustained multiple wounds with broad injuries, posing infection risk and rabies exposure; wounds were cleaned, sutured, dressed, and rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) administered, including rabies immunoglobulin. The remaining two had milder injuries but still received rabies immunoglobulin and were advised to complete the vaccination schedule with follow-up monitoring. Local authorities will deploy inspections and install warning signs to deter visitors from approaching or feeding monkeys in the area to prevent further incidents.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク州の海沿い道路でキョン（野生猿）が観光客を相次いで咬む事件が発生
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病曝露に関連した動物由来感染症イベントであり、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度の可能性）に該当するが、現時点での感染確認者がなく情報が限定的であるため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 野生猿による複数の咬傷事件であり、狂犬病の潜在的曝露リスクを示唆。既に適切な曝露後予防（PEP）が実施されており、現在のところは感染例ではなく動物咬傷事件として分類される。地方当局が対応策（警告標識、検査の展開）を実施している。ベトナムは狂犬病の低リスク地域ではないため、今後の患者発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: PMI dan BPBD Belu Perkuat Kolaborasi Tangani Rabies di Wilayah Perbatasan - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesian Red Cross and Belu Regency BPBD Strengthen Collaboration to Tackle Rabies in Border Areas.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, is being tackled with intensified inter-agency collaboration in the border region. The Belu PMI (Indonesian Red Cross) and BPBD reaffirmed a One Health approach to break transmission between humans and animals. A coordination and monitoring meeting at PMI Belu on 29 April 2026, following a 28–30 April 2026 response mandate by PMI NTT Province, involved partners from the American Red Cross, PMI Central, and PMI NTT. Key measures include activating emergency posts as needed, strengthening cross-sector coordination, and reinforcing logistics such as mapping affected areas, and supplying medical equipment and PPE. Public education and ongoing evaluation are also emphasized. Attendees included the Health and Livestock Dinas, Tasifeto Barat District government, and PMI volunteers, with the aim of faster, more coordinated, and effective outbreak response to the border area.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア赤新月社とベル県BPBDが国境地域の狂犬病対策で協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東ヌサ・テンガラ州ベル県での狂犬病の発生が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露の可能性）に該当する。ただし死亡数や重症度、国際的拡大リスクについて情報が不足しているため、フルRRAの前に追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月30日付で、インドネシア東ヌサ・テンガラ州ベル県の国境地域での狂犬病アウトブレイクに対する公式な対応体制（インドネシア赤新月社、地域防災局、米国赤十字、PMI中央部など）が構築されている状況を報告。One Health アプローチの採用、公開教育、ロジスティクス強化が強調されている。ただし患者数、死亡数、重症度に関する具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、リスク評価が限定的。国境地域という特性と人動物感染の継続的リスク（prolonged exposure）が認識されていることから、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ed Sheeran Kena Herpes Zoster, Berikut Fakta yang Perlu Diketahui tentang Penyakit Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ed Sheeran Contracted Herpes Zoster: Here Are the Facts You Need to Know About This Disease.
article.articleSummary: Ed Sheeran revealed on Instagram from Jakarta that he has been battling herpes zoster (shingles) for about a month and is now recovering as of 30 April 2026. The illness causes a skin rash with fluid-filled blisters and significant pain, typically on one side of the body. Shingles is caused by Varicella Zoster virus (VZV), the same virus that causes chickenpox. After recovery from chickenpox, VZV can remain dormant in nerve tissue and reactivate later as shingles, often in people over 50 or with weakened immunity. Transmission occurs through direct contact with vesicle fluid and can spread via bodily fluids; exposure can also cause chickenpox in someone who has never had it. Treatments include antiviral drugs (acyclovir, famciclovir, valacyclovir), pain relievers (ibuprofen, acetaminophen), corticosteroid injections or local anesthesia, and capsaicin cream after the rash heals.

triage.headline_ja: Ed Sheeranが帯状疱疹に感染、この病気について知っておくべき事実
triage.triage_reason: 著名人の個人的な健康問題であり、公衆衛生危機の兆候がない。流行、異常な発生パターン、国際的拡大のリスク、管理上の課題も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（ジャカルタ）にいた著名人の個人的な健康状態に関するものであり、感染症の流行や集団発生ではない。帯状疱疹（Varicella Zoster Virus）は既知の疾患であり、個別事例の報道であるため公衆衛生上のシグナルとして認識されない。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều du khách bị khỉ cắn tại bãi biển Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many tourists were bitten by monkeys at Dak Lak Beach.
article.articleSummary: Five tourists were bitten by monkeys on Dak Lak Beach along Phước Tân - Bãi Ngà, in Hòa Xuân commune, Đắk Lắk province, over 28–29 April. On 30 April, they were treated at Phú Yên General Hospital; all patients were conscious and stable. Medical care included wound cleaning, suturing, and dressing, with risk assessment for rabies exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Three cases had multiple, wide injuries with infection risk and potential rabies exposure, and received rabies immunoglobulin per protocol. The remaining two had milder injuries but were still evaluated for rabies risk, given rabies immunoglobulin, and advised monitoring with complete vaccination scheduling. No severe progression has been observed as of this report. Local authorities in Hòa Xuân plan to deploy patrols and signage to warn visitors not to approach or feed wild monkeys.

triage.headline_ja: ダク・ラク海岸で多くの観光客が猿に噛まれる
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病への潜在的曝露を伴う動物咬傷事例（5件）が報告されているが、現時点では重症化がなく、適切な医療対応（PEP含む）が実施されている。情報は限定的だが、狂犬病の性質から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病への潜在的曝露ケースだが、現在の情報では既に医療対応が完了し、重症化はない。ただし狂犬病の潜伏期間の長さと致命性の高さを考慮すると、患者の経過観察継続が重要。局地的な動物との接触事案のため現時点では国際的拡大リスクは低い。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Bukan Sekadar Minum Obat, Ini Jurus Pemerintah Tekan Penularan TB di Papua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not Just About Taking Medicine, Here’s the Government’s Strategy to Curb TB Transmission in Papua.
article.articleSummary: Tanah Papua, Indonesia, expands TB control beyond treatment with a comprehensive strategy combining early detection and housing improvements. On a working trip to Jayapura, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin P. Octavianus stated that TB management requires more than medication, stressing that healthier living environments support recovery and reduce household transmission. The plan speeds up case finding via portable X-ray screening and household-contact tracing to evaluate family members living with TB patients. It also funds home renovations to address risk factors like poor ventilation, inadequate lighting, and overcrowding. By improving living conditions, authorities aim to enhance cure rates and curb transmission within families, acknowledging that TB spread is closely linked to environment and close contact. These efforts are part of the government's approach in Papua as of April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 単なる服薬だけではない、パプアのTB感染伝播を抑制するための政府の戦略
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、インドネシア政府による対策強化の事例。新規発生や異常な増加傾向は報告されていないが、公衆衛生対策の重要性と実施内容が記載されているため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・パプア州における結核対策の政府主導プログラム（早期発見、住環境改善、家族接触者追跡）について述べている。結核自体は既知の疾患であり、新規流行の報告ではなく、むしろ対策強化の事例である。ただしパプア州は結核の高蔓延地域であり、政府が対策を強化している点で公衆衛生上の関心が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Rising Spread of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia
article.articleSummary: Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), caused by SFTSV, shows rising transmissibility in a highly endemic region of China. The tick-borne viral hemorrhagic fever, traditionally linked to Haemaphysalis longicornis bites, presents with high fever, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and possible multi-organ dysfunction. The Nature Communications study analyzes multi-year epidemiologic data, viral genomes, and vector ecology, identifying mutations in viral glycoproteins that enhance host cell entry and expand host range. Cryo-electron microscopy and functional assays show greater binding to tick salivary gland cells and human monocytes, potentially boosting replication and spread. Tick population expansion, driven by warmer temperatures and rainfall changes, alongside agricultural practices, elevates human exposure. Newly documented human-to-human transmission in caregiving and family clusters raises concern for broader spread. With no antivirals or vaccines, emphasis remains on surveillance, diagnostic capacity, infection control, and development of therapeutics and vaccines; international collaboration is essential.

triage.headline_ja: 深刻熱血小板減少症の広がりが上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な伝播パターン、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。中国での新興ウイルス進化、人人感染の証拠、ワクチン・治療薬なし、国際的対応が必須と言及されている。
triage.notes: Nature Communications誌の査読論文に基づくレポート。SFTSウイルスの遺伝子変異（グリコプロテイン）による宿主細胞への侵入能亢進と宿主範囲の拡大が確認されている。ダニ媒介から人人感染への転換が新たな関心事。中国の風土病流行地域での急速な拡大、気温上昇に伴うダニ個体群増加、農業慣行の影響が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 孟加拉国麻疹疫情加剧，逾220名儿童死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangladesh measles outbreak worsens; more than 220 children have died.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has killed 227 children and sickened about 35,000 suspected cases, most aged 6 months to 5 years, as of April 29, 2026, one of the most severe outbreaks in decades. Between March 15 and April 14, the country reported over 19,000 suspected cases, with nearly 3,000 laboratory-confirmed. The surge is attributed to declining vaccination coverage. One tribal community in Gaibandha District near the Myanmar border is among the hardest hit, where remoteness, poverty, and communication barriers hinder access to care; some residents cannot afford transport to hospitals. Measles is a highly contagious viral illness spread by respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash, with pneumonia a common complication. There is no specific antiviral treatment; vaccination is the best defense. Health ministry spokesperson Zahid Raihan said a nationwide vaccination drive targeting about 18 million children has begun, but impact will take time.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの麻疹流行が悪化、220人以上の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。大規模な麻疹流行により227人の死亡、35,000人の疑い患者発生、国家的な予防接種キャンペーン展開中。国境地域での拡大リスクも存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、バングラデシュ（Gaibandha地区、Rangpur地域）が主要な発生地域であることを確認。Myanmar国境近隣の部族コミュニティが最も打撃を受けており、地理的リスク要因あり。ただしBluedot APIの発生地域にはミャンマーも含まれているが、サマリーからはミャンマーでの直接的な発生の記述がないため、verified_locationsには含めない。全国予防接種キャンペーン（1,800万人規模）が進行中であり、政府レベルでの関心・対応が高い。

article.articleHeadline: പേവിഷബാധയേറ്റ് ഏഴുവയസ്സുകാരിയുടെ മരണം; നാല് ഡോക്ടർമാരുടെ പേരിൽ കേസ്, നടപടി കോടതി നിർദേശപ്രകാരം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a seven-year-old due to poisoning; case against four doctors, as per court directions.
article.articleSummary: Rabies infection caused the death of a seven-year-old girl in Punalur, Kerala. On April 8, 2025, at around 12:00, the child was bitten by a street dog near her home and received anti-rabies vaccination at a nearby community health center. Following doctors’ instructions, she was promptly taken to Punalur Taluk Hospital and later referred to SAT Hospital in Thiruvananthapuram. The subsequent dose was due around May 6, but she developed fever days earlier and was admitted to both facilities. Rabies laboratory confirmed at SAT Hospital; she died on May 5, 2025. A case alleges improper administration of rabies immunoglobulin and acts of negligence, including attempting to destroy evidence; four doctors—Devi Lakshmi, Amjit, Jayasuriya—and Superintendent K.R. Sunilkumar are named. The Punalur First Class Judicial Magistrate Court directed police to register an FIR; Adv. Anis Thangalkunju appeared for the petitioner.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病感染による7歳女児の死亡；4名の医師に対する訴訟提起、裁判所指示による措置
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例で重症度基準を満たすが、インド国内の散発例であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。医療過誤訴訟が並行しており、疾病の公衆衛生的脅威よりも医療システム問題が焦点となっている。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病による死亡事例ですが、インドでの散発例であり、医療過誤訴訟が主焦点。予防接種プロトコル遵守の問題は個別事例に限定。狂犬病は確認済みだが流行兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Deepika Padukone shot Housefull while she was 'shivering' with malaria, recalls Lara Dutta
article.articleSummary: Malaria forced Deepika Padukone to shoot Bollywood’s Housefull while shivering with a high fever, recalled Lara Dutta in a NDTV interview. Dutta said Padukone fell ill during filming, received a doctor’s treatment and medication, yet showed up on a fixed schedule and delivered performance despite being drained. She praised Padukone as a thorough professional who remained focused as malaria wiped her out. Housefull, directed by Sajid Khan and produced by Sajid Nadiadwala, also starred Akshay Kumar, Riteish Deshmukh, Boman Irani, Arjun Rampal, and Lillete Dubey; the franchise began 16 years ago with sequels released in 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2025. Ananya Panday praised Deepika’s professionalism at O Womaniya 2024 Roundtable. On the work front, Lara Dutta will play Kaikeyi in Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana, also starring Ranbir Kapoor, due in October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ディーピカ・パドゥコーン、マラリアで寒気を伴いながら『ハウスフル』を撮影—ララ・ダッタが回想
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はボリウッド俳優の個人的な健康経験に関するエンターテイメント報道であり、公衆衛生上の懸念事項ではない。マラリアの流行、感染拡大、または地域の保健危機を示すいかなる証拠もない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人的な疾患経験に関するセレブリティ・ニュースであり、感染症の疫学的シグナルではない。公衆衛生監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Four Kerala govt doctors booked on negligence charges over 7-year-old girl's rabies death
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Kerala: Four government doctors in Kollam district have been booked on negligence charges after seven-year-old Niya Faisal of Pathanapuram died of rabies following a stray dog attack in front of her home at Punalur. Niya succumbed to rabies in May 2025 after being attacked while playing outside her house. The case was registered on 30 April 2026. The doctors face negligence charges related to post-exposure management after the bite. The infection source is a stray dog, and the death occurred in Kerala in May 2025. The report does not indicate a wider outbreak; it centers on this case and the associated legal action.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州の7歳女児の狂犬病死亡に関わる医師4人が過失罪で起訴
triage.triage_reason: 個別の死亡例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。法的措置は医療過失の問題であって感染症危機管理の対象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は2025年5月の個別の狂犬病死亡事例とその後の医師の法的措置（2026年4月に起訴）であり、集団発生や継続的なアウトブレイクではない。サマリーに明記されている通り『wider outbreak を示さない』。狂犬病は予防可能な疾患であり、本件は医療管理の失敗ケースであって感染症シグナルとしては不適切である。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Papua Jadi Episentrum Malaria Nasional, Pemerintah Fokus Berantas TB dan HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Papua Has Become the National Malaria Epicenter, Government Focuses on Eradicating TB and HIV
article.articleSummary: Papua (Tanah Papua) now accounts for the majority of Indonesia’s malaria burden, with more than 90% of national malaria cases and about 95% of the national malaria burden originating there. The government prioritizes Papua in fast-track efforts to eradicate malaria and tuberculosis while addressing HIV/AIDS. During a working visit to Jayapura (April 27–29), Deputy Health Minister Benny Octavianus stressed that Papua is the main focus of the President’s quick-win program across six provinces in Tanah Papua. Papua also hosts about 12% of Indonesia’s people living with HIV. TB detection and patient treatment adherence remain low, prompting a cross-sector approach involving central and local authorities and communities to strengthen early detection, education, and access to services. Governor Mathius D. Fakhiri pledged regional alignment with central efforts to reduce transmission and achieve program targets.

triage.headline_ja: パプアがインドネシアの全国マラリア震源地に、政府はTBとHIV対策に注力
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パプア地域にマラリア患者が全国の90%以上集中し、TB・HIV併発という複合感染症危機。政府の高優先度対応と大規模公衆衛生影響により、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: パプア地域はインドネシア国内の感染症負担が集中している特殊な地理的・疫学的状況。マラリア(全国の90%以上)・TB・HIVの三重感染構造であり、複合感染症危機として管理可能性に課題あり。政府による大統領令の優先対応地域として位置づけられており、社会政治的関心が高い。WPRO基準の4項目該当により、フルRRA進行の判断が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Penyebaran Kasus Penyakit TB, Dinkes Sumenep Perkuat Sistem Pelacakan dan Skrining Aktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Spread of Tuberculosis Cases, Sumenep Health Office Strengthens the Contact Tracing and Active Screening System.
article.articleSummary: 716 tuberculosis cases detected in Sumenep Regency, East Java, Indonesia, from January through 25 April 2026. The Sumenep Health Office (Dinkes-P2KB) is strengthening contact tracing and active screening to curb transmission, announced after a coordination meeting on 30 April 2026. Cases emerged from both active and passive case finding, and from residents who sought care at puskesmas with symptoms. The response uses the Tuberculosis Information System (SITB) connected in real time across puskesmas, hospitals, government and private clinics, and private practice doctors (PDMs) to speed diagnosis, treatment initiation, and contact tracing. Residents are urged not to ignore prolonged cough, fever, or weight loss, since TB is curable with complete treatment. The emphasis is on early detection and rapid linkage to care to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の拡大を予想し、スメネプ保健局が接触追跡と能動的スクリーニングシステムを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東ジャワ州スメネプ地区での結核患者716人検出は重要だが、記事は地域的な対応強化の報告であり、国際的な拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生危機の直接的な証拠に乏しい。スクリーニング基準では複数項目に該当するが情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性感染症であり「異常」ではないため unusual_unexpected は No。しかし長期曝露（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）は結核の特性として Yes。スメネプ地区の716症例は地域的な負担を示唆するが、記事内に死亡数、重症度、医療体制崩壊の証拠がないため severity は不明。当局は既に対応システムを構築・強化している（manageability: No）。国際的な拡大リスクは記事で示唆されない。続報で患者数の急増や医療体制の逼迫が報告される場合は PICKUP 判定に変更する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria, 9 Others Account for Majority of Global Hepatitis Deaths - WHO
article.articleSummary: WHO's 2026 Global Hepatitis Report, released at the World Hepatitis Summit, reports 2024 deaths from hepatitis B and C totaling 1.34 million. Nigeria ranks among the 10 countries responsible for 69% of hepatitis B deaths, alongside Bangladesh, China, Ethiopia, Ghana, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, South Africa and Vietnam. Nigeria also features in another group of 10 nations accounting for 58% of global hepatitis C cases. While new infections are declining, mortality remains high due to limited diagnosis and treatment access. In Africa, only 17% of newborns receive the hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus cautions that progress is uneven and calls for urgent scale-up of prevention, diagnosis and treatment to meet 2030 targets. In 2024, an estimated 287 million people live with chronic hepatitis B or C; liver cirrhosis and cancer are the primary causes of death.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアとその他9カ国が世界の肝炎死亡の大多数を占める - WHO
triage.triage_reason: 肝炎B型・C型の世界的な死亡・発病統計報告であり、複数の対象国が言及されているが、新規アウトブレイクや急性的な感染症危機ではなく、既知の慢性疾患の疫学報告のため。情報不足による保留。
triage.notes: WHO Global Hepatitis Report (2026)の統計報告であり、新規アウトブレイクではなく既知の慢性感染症の疾病負担報告。対象国リストに含まれないナイジェリア、バングラデシュ、エチオピア、南アフリカは除外。スクリーニング基準では4項目該当するが、IHR基準は1項目のみで、かつ報告は防御的な健康上の課題であってアクティブなシグナルではないため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Lara Dutta recalls Deepika Padukone battling malaria during 'Housefull' shoot, continuing work despite high fever
article.articleSummary: Malaria diagnosed on set during the 2010 film Housefull, with Deepika Padukone fighting high fever and exhaustion yet continuing to shoot on a packed schedule. Doctors prescribed daily medication as nights of fever and shivering persisted, but she reported to set and delivered emotionally charged scenes. Lara Dutta, in a NDTV interview, recalls this period and notes malaria’s draining impact compared with a regular fever. Housefull, directed by Sajid Khan and also starring Akshay Kumar, Riteish Deshmukh, Boman Irani, Arjun Rampal and Lillete Dubey, marked its 16th anniversary on 2026-04-30. Lara also describes Deepika as reserved rather than shy, underscoring her focus on work. The account highlights malaria’s severity and a star’s commitment to maintain performance amid illness, with the film’s release noted as context.

triage.headline_ja: ラーラ・ダッタがハウスフルの撮影中にマラリアと闘うディーピカ・パドゥコーンを回想、高熱にもかかわらず仕事を続けた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2010年の映画撮影中の個人的な過去のマラリア事例についての娯楽記事であり、現在の感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。公衆衛生上の現在の脅威、異常な発生パターン、国際的拡大リスク、流行の可能性はいずれも示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド発信だが、内容は2010年の映画撮影の回想談であり、感染症の疫学的または公衆衛生的な関連性を持たない娯楽記事である。マラリア診断は報告対象の現在のイベントではなく、16年前の個人的な病歴の描写であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Академик Чумаков рассказал о смертельных вирусах, скрывающихся в старых могильниках
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Academician Chumakov spoke about deadly viruses lurking in old cemeteries.
article.articleSummary: Russian molecular biologist and RAS Academician Petr Chumakov warns that viruses linger in old cemeteries and could pose deadly risks to humans. He notes that while some pathogens may be released, rapid identification enables countermeasures. He highlights that the most interesting, large viruses were found in permafrost, which preserved them for about 40,000 years alongside amoebae; these particular viruses are not dangerous to humans. Chumakov explains that many different viruses exist whose genomes can be analyzed to determine if they belong to a new, harmless species. In February, India reported a Nipah virus outbreak that was thought to potentially rival COVID-19 in severity. The Evening Moscow recalls how other epidemics affected humanity. Last year China recorded a chikungunya fever outbreak with total infections exceeding 10,000; Dr Olga Ulankina described how to recognize a dangerous disease.

triage.headline_ja: チューマコフ学士が古い墓地に潜む致命的ウイルスについて語る
triage.triage_reason: 記事は仮説的な警告と過去の事例（インドのニパウイルス、中国のチクングニア熱）の参照であり、現在進行中の具体的な感染症危機の報告ではない。ただしニパウイルスとチクングニア熱への言及があり、情報整理のため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は凍土中のウイルスに関する学術的な警告と歴史的な疫学事例（2月のインドニパウイルス、昨年の中国チクングニア熱）の言及を含む。ロシアの学者による仮説的見解であり、現在進行中の新規感染症危機の報告ではない。インドと中国が言及されているが、これらは過去の事例への参照であり、現在の新規発生状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 1新冠變異株占比增！疾管署：恐現夏季疫情　擴大疫苗接種延至7月底 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Share of one COVID-19 variant on the rise! Taiwan CDC warns of a possible summer outbreak; vaccination campaign expanded to the end of July | yam News
article.articleSummary: Taiwan faces a potential summer COVID-19 wave as the BA.3.2 variant, noted for immune escape, climbs to about 25.9% of circulating strains and approaches XBB globally. The CDC urges travelers to Mainland China or elsewhere to get vaccinated ahead of May–July trips and expands free vaccination to July 31 to strengthen defenses. Domestic transmission remains low, with 820 outpatient visits last week. As of April 26, about 1.694 million people have completed vaccination; public vaccine stock stands around 900,000 doses, including 165,000 Novavax and 738,000 Moderna; another 10,000 Novavax doses will be procured; the Novavax stock expires April 30. High-risk groups (65+; 55–64-year-old Indigenous; immunocompromised) will receive an extra dose starting April 7. A lower-dose Moderna vaccine, containing about one-fifth of the antigen, is planned for rollout around October 1, with about 2.5 million doses pending June selection.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ変異株の割合増加！台湾CDCが夏季流行の可能性を警告　ワクチン接種キャンペーン拡大予定
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのCOVID-19変異株の増加報告だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。記事は国内感染が低水準であり、重大な危機兆候は限定的。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。記事は主に台湾での変異株増加とワクチン接種戦略を扱っており、対象国内での具体的な感染症イベントの報告ではない。社会政治的関心（政府の予防措置拡大）はあるが、PICKUPの閾値には達しない。

article.articleHeadline: 79岁老人长期吃冰箱存货险丧命 细菌“冻不死”
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 79-year-old man who had been eating fridge-stored food for a long time nearly died; bacteria survive freezing.
article.articleSummary: In China, a 79-year-old man developed purulent meningitis attributed to Streptococcus after years of consuming fridge-stored foods. He woke at 3:30 a.m. with weakness; within 30 minutes his temperature rose to 40°C. He was admitted with altered consciousness, severe headache, and fever. Lumbar puncture and CSF analysis, plus blood tests and a head CT, confirmed purulent meningitis. Empirical anti-inflammatory therapy was given, and his condition improved: by day eight, fever had resolved and back and head pain diminished. Doctors linked the infection to long-term intake of frozen meat and seafood stored for months or years and expired dairy, noting that bacteria such as Streptococcus and Listeria monocytogenes can survive freezing. Freezing does not sterilize. Preventive guidance: finish frozen meat within 1–2 months; refrigerate ready-to-eat foods no more than 24 hours; weekly fridge cleaning and discard moldy items. As of 2026-04-30.

triage.headline_ja: 79歳の男性が長期間冷蔵庫保存食を食べて危機一髪；細菌は冷凍でも死なない
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の臨床事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生ではない。通常の食品保存衛生リスクに関する啓発記事で、異常な流行や国際的リスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 単一患者の臨床ケースレポート。食品衛生教育記事として機能しており、感染症危機管理の対象となる集団流行の兆候なし。Streptococcus、Listeria、Classical Swine Feverが列挙されているが、実際の記事内容は食中毒リスクに関する医療啓発に限定され、豚コレラ（Classical Swine Fever）への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh measles outbreak kills over 220 children since March
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has caused 227 child deaths and nearly 35,000 suspected cases since March 15, 2026, with 34,980 nationwide, primarily affecting children six months to five years old. Kurukpata in the Chittagong Hill Tracts near the Myanmar border is among the hardest-hit areas where Indigenous communities face vaccination gaps. Local officials report over 80 children treated in Kurukpata; barriers include poverty, travel costs, and communication difficulties. Common symptoms include high fever, cough, and diarrhoea. Bangladesh health officials, aided by the WHO, UNICEF, and security forces, are working to vaccinate children and curb transmission. The outbreak is ongoing, with fear of vaccination and geographic isolation hindering access to remote populations.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの麻疹流行、3月以来220人以上の児童死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。227人の死亡、35,000件以上の疑い患者を報告する大規模流行。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバングラデシュの麻疹流行について述べているが、バングラデシュは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。ただし「Kurukpata in the Chittagong Hill Tracts near the Myanmar border」と明記され、ミャンマアとの国境地域の先住民コミュニティが影響を受けていることが指摘されている。ミャンマが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locations にはミャンマのみを記載。国境を越えた伝播リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Du khách bị khỉ hoang cắn khi du lịch Phú Yên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A tourist was bitten by a wild monkey while traveling in Phú Yên.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 April 2026, five tourists aged 9–42 were bitten by wild monkeys on a road toward Mũi Điện in Đắk Lắk Province, about 3 km from the site near a protective forest. The incidents occurred on 28–29 April; a 9-year-old boy sustained deep left-leg injuries with high infection and exposure risk to rabies, requiring rabies immunoglobulin and close monitoring. By 30 April, one patient was stable and discharged to return to Hanoi; two others remained hospitalized for observation. Officials note no wild monkeys inhabit the Mũi Điện site itself; bites occurred on the road toward Mũi Điện near the forest edge, with monkeys reportedly habituated to people and seeking food. Public health advice: avoid feeding or carrying food, maintain at least 2 meters from monkeys, treat wounds with alcohol or clean water, then seek prompt rabies prophylaxis at a health facility.

triage.headline_ja: 観光地プーイェンでの旅行中に野生猿に咬まれた観光客
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の曝露リスクを伴う複数の咬傷事例（5人）が報告され、特に9歳児が深い下肢損傷で高リスク。狂犬病は致死率が高い予防可能な感染症で、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は深刻。IHR基準で「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当。
triage.notes: 複数の観光客がダクラク省のムイディエン方面で野生猿に咬まれた事件。狂犬病は曝露後の適切な予防接種で防止可能だが、深い咬傷と低い初期治療アクセスにより高リスク。公式には野生猿がムイディエン地区に生息していないとされているが、森の端で食物を求めて人馴れした猿による咬傷が報告されている。当該地域は観光地であることから国内外の公衆衛生関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 5 du khách bị khỉ hoang cắn ở đường ven biển Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five tourists bitten by wild monkeys on Dak Lak's coastal road.
article.articleSummary: On 28–30 April 2026, ten tourists were bitten by wild monkeys along the Phuoc Tan–Bai Nga coastal road in Hoa Xuan Nam, Dak Lak Province, Vietnam (five on 28–29 April, five on 30 April). All victims were treated at Phu Yen General Hospital and received rabies post-exposure prophylaxis. Three individuals with multiple wounds and extensive tissue damage faced higher infection and rabies exposure risk; wounds were cleaned, sutured, bandaged, with rabies immune globulin administered. The other two suffered milder injuries but also received rabies immune globulin and were advised to complete the full vaccination schedule with ongoing monitoring. Following the incident, Hoa Xuan Nam authorities posted warning signs advising visitors not to approach or feed monkeys in the area.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク州の沿岸道路でサル5頭に観光客が噛まれる
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の暴露事件だが、直ちに公衆衛生危機の段階には達していない。10名全員が適切な暴露後予防処置（PEP）を受け、発症者報告なし。情報がより明確になるまで経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 複数の野生動物による露出事件だが、全員が迅速かつ適切な狂犬病PEPを受けており、現在のところ感染確定者なし。狂犬病の潜伏期間が長いため、今後の臨床経過を注視する必要がある。観光客対象の事件であり、国際的な関心が生じる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: [현장] 국내외 ASF 발생 역학과 백신 개발 현황
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Field Report] Domestic and International African Swine Fever (ASF) Outbreak Epidemiology and Vaccine Development Status.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreaks were the focus of an international symposium in Daejeon, Korea (April 27) on domestic and international epidemiology and vaccine development. One Health-driven strategies emphasize enhanced surveillance, interagency cooperation, and long-term, multi-layered control, shifting from depopulation and fences to vaccination with DIVA testing, and from country-wide bans to zoning-based trade stability. Wildlife-livestock interfaces require ongoing measures including oral vaccines. FAO/WOAH-based global surveillance and real-time data sharing are deemed essential. China reports ASF endemic since 2024, underscoring long-term management. Japan highlights border risks, with 238 passenger-baggage and 136 international-mail ASFV findings by February, and live virus isolation, prompting strengthened disinfection, detection dogs, and strict penalties; training for foreign trainees (Vietnam 36%, China 23%, Philippines 12%) to prevent importation of meat products is emphasized. Thailand advocates preparedness-driven partial depopulation, farm certification, and scaled prevention. Central Vaccine Institute's ASFV-MEC-01, a safe attenuated live vaccine, has completed key WOAH-guided trials; Vietnam and the Philippines are in clinical trials with overseas licensing anticipated next year.

triage.headline_ja: [現場レポート] 国内外のアフリカ豚熱（ASF）発生疫学とワクチン開発状況
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は家畜感染症であり、記事は国際シンポジウムでの疫学・ワクチン開発状況の報告である。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（人への感染）は認められず、複数国での発生は報告されているが、既知の風土病化傾向として管理されている状況である。情報の詳細化による継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物感染症であり、IHR通知対象ではない。ただし記事は国際シンポジウムでの多国間の疫学共有とワクチン開発進捗であり、国境リスク（日本による検疫検査事例、越境での感染リスク）が明記されている。中国では2024年から風土病化、ベトナムとフィリピンではワクチン臨床試験段階と報告されている。動物衛生に関連する国際的な協力体制と監視強化の動向として経過観察を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: 孟加拉国严重疫情致死227名儿童 疫苗接种率下降成主因
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A severe outbreak in Bangladesh has killed 227 children; decline in vaccination rates has become the main cause.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has killed 227 children, with nearly 35,000 suspected infections, mostly among 6 months to 5-year-olds. From March 15 to April 14, over 19,000 suspected cases were reported, with about 3,000 laboratory-confirmed. Affected area includes indigenous communities in the Chittagong Hill Tracts along the Myanmar border, where remoteness, communication barriers, and poverty push cases high and hinder hospital access. Measles causes fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash, with pneumonia and death as possible complications; there is no specific antiviral treatment, vaccination is the best defense. Health ministry spokesperson Zahid Raihan said the government has launched a nationwide vaccination campaign aiming to immunize about 18 million children, but results will take time to materialize.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの深刻な流行で227人の子どもが死亡 ワクチン接種率の低下が主な原因
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。麻疹による227人の死亡、35,000人近い疑い患者、予防接種率低下により管理が困難な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバングラデシュ（対象国外）とミャンマー国境地域を主に述べており、インド（対象国）への言及は見当たらないが、地理的近接性と国境地域での流行拡大リスクがあるため、インドを verified_locations に含める。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ミャンマー（1327865）は対象国だが、記事の主題は国境を越えたバングラデシュ側の流行であり、ミャンマー領土内での発生報告は明示されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Four doctors booked after 7-year-old dies despite anti-rabies treatment at Punalur Taluk Hospital
article.articleSummary: Four doctors have been booked after seven-year-old Niya Faisal died of rabies despite anti-rabies treatment at Punalur Taluk Hospital, Kollam, Kerala. Niya was bitten by a dog on April 8, 2025; after care she was admitted to Punalur Taluk Hospital, where fever appeared April 29. She was referred to Sree Avittom Thirunal Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram, died May 5. The accused are Dr Devi Lakshmi, Dr Amjitha, Dr Jayasurya, and superintendent Dr K R Sunilkumar. FIR cites Sections 106(1), 238 and 3(5), alleging death by negligence, destruction of evidence or false information, and acts by multiple persons in furtherance of common intention. Allegations include improper immunoglobulin administration and that the superintendent provided incomplete RTI information to shield colleagues and tamper with evidence. Preliminary findings suggest the bite affected a nerve, enabling rabies to reach the brain before antibodies developed; Niya had three doses and was due a fourth on May 6.

triage.headline_ja: ラビス（狂犬病）予防治療を受けたにもかかわらず7歳の少女が死亡、プナルル県病院の医師4名が書類送検
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による個別死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。医療過誤に関する司法案件であり、感染症危機管理シグナルとしては適切でない。
triage.notes: 本事例はケーララ州の単一死亡事例であり、医療過誤疑いに関する司法手続きである。発生地域はケーララ州（Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram）だが、感染症の流行や国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。狂犬病は対象国インドで既知の疾患であり、個別死亡事例は EBS シグナルとして該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai phát hiện ca nhiễm vi khuẩn gây bệnh Whitmore đầu tiên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai detects the first case of Whitmore disease-causing bacterial infection.
article.articleSummary: Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, reports its first melioidosis (Whitmore disease) case in 2026. The patient, a 39-year-old woman (K.H.) from Mook Trang Village, Ia Dom Commune, developed symptoms on 16 April and was admitted to Gia Lai General Hospital on 19 April, currently in intensive care. Laboratory tests identified Burkholderia pseudomallei; the patient has diabetes. She was weaned off mechanical ventilation after two days and remains under ongoing treatment. Epidemiology links exposure to soil and muddy water through farming; she worked in Đội 21 at Cửa Khẩu in Ia Dom. Authorities disinfected the area and notified Đức Cơ Health Center; 14-day household and community surveillance found no additional cases in the village or among close contacts. Preventive guidance includes wearing protective gear when farming, avoiding direct river bathing in contaminated areas, using filtered water, and seeking prompt care for fever, pneumonia, or abscess. A separate report notes a man from Nghệ An, living in Thailand, with severe melioidosis.

triage.headline_ja: ザイライ省がホイットモア病を引き起こす細菌感染の最初の症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは稀な新興感染症であり、ベトナムのザイライ省での初症例報告は該当地域にとって異常・予想外である。患者が集中治療を要する重症例であり、環境対策（消毒）と接触者追跡が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にベトナム・ザイライ省での初症例を詳述。タイに関しては、「タイに住むンゲアン省出身の男性が重症メリオイドーシスを患っている」との記載があり、タイでの症例報告を含む。両国が記事の主題に含まれるため、verified_locationsに両国を列挙した。メリオイドーシスは土壌・水への曝露が主たる感染経路であり、農業従事者が高リスク。現地の接触者追跡では追加症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: बुखार में तपती थीं दीपिका पादुकोण, मलेरिया में पूरी की शूटिंग, 1 दिन भी नहीं लिया ब्रेक, र
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deepika Padukone worked through a fever, completed filming while suffering from malaria, not a single day off.
article.articleSummary: Malaria struck Deepika Padukone during the Housefull shoot, triggering a high fever and prolonged weakness that required doctors and medicines. Doctors were called and she received medications. She fought the fever overnight and nevertheless continued filming, showing extraordinary dedication and reportedly not taking a single day off. Lara explained that outdoor shoots are tightly scheduled and halting production is difficult with a big star cast. The illness occurred on the Housefull set, with malaria identified as the infection causing fever and fatigue during filming, highlighting the pressures of outdoor productions. As of 2026-04-30, the account notes she carried on with filming despite illness.

triage.headline_ja: ディーピカ・パードゥコーンが熱病に苦しみながら、マラリアで撮影を完了、1日も休まず
triage.triage_reason: これは映画撮影中の個人の健康イベント報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発症ではない。マラリアは個人事例で、流行または異常な疾病パターンを示さず、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、または管理可能性に関する懸念はない。
triage.notes: 記事は映画女優ディーピカ・パードゥコーンの個人的な健康エピソードを報道しており、公衆衛生監視対象外。マラリア疾患の記載があるため Bluedot で検出されたが、感染症イベント監視の対象ではない。エンターテイメント・ニュースの分類に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: پاکستان میں ہیپاٹائٹس سی کے پھیلاؤ میں تشویشناک حد تک اضافہ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rise in the spread of Hepatitis C in Pakistan
article.articleSummary: Pakistan faces an alarming rise in Hepatitis C transmission. A WHO report shows Pakistan, India and China together bear 39% of the global Hepatitis C burden, and Pakistan is among the 10 countries accounting for 58% of Hepatitis C deaths. Globally, 2024 saw 1.34 million deaths from hepatitis B and C, among the world’s deadliest infections. That year recorded about 1.8 million new hepatitis B and C infections; only about 20% of Hepatitis C patients could access treatment, and fewer than 5% of Hepatitis B patients did. Transmission is driven largely by unsafe medical practices and reuse of syringes; concerns exist about fake auto-disable syringes falsely implying protection. The WHO notes Hepatitis B vaccination provides over 95% protection, while Hepatitis C is curable in 8–12 weeks. Despite these advances, progress toward the 2030 elimination targets remains insufficient, with Pakistan particularly highlighting unsafe injections.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンにおけるC型肝炎の拡大が懸念されるほど増加
triage.triage_reason: パキスタンのC型肝炎拡大が重大な公衆衛生問題であり、WHO報告書で世界的な負担が示されている。IHR基準では重症度（死亡数が多い）と異常性（急増）が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、長期曝露（不安全な医療慣行の継続）、流行やすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、ワクチン未接種者多数）が該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはパキスタンの懸念を主題としているが、WHO報告では「パキスタン、インド、中国が世界的なC型肝炎負担の39%を占める」と明記されており、インドと中国も実質的に関連している。ただしパキスタンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに追加できない。不安全な医療慣行（注射針の再利用）が主要な感染経路とされており、継続的な曝露リスクが存在する。グローバルな死亡数（2024年で134万）が多く、治療へのアクセスが限定的（C型肝炎20%未満）である点が重症度を支持する。

article.articleHeadline: 高烧不退，医生从患者身上拔出 17 只蜱虫！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent fever won't subside; the doctor removed 17 ticks from the patient!
article.articleSummary: A severe case of tick-borne bunyavirus infection was diagnosed at the Fourth Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University, after a patient bitten by ticks had 17 ticks removed (13 from the lower abdomen, chest/back; 4 from hair). Prior to admission the patient experienced fatigue, fever, and poor appetite; the diagnosis was confirmed after initial cold treatment failed. Symptoms included high fever up to 40°C, weakness, headache, myalgia, nausea, with potential gum bleeding and purpura. Tick bites are often painless; removal should use fine-tipped tweezers to extract the head and disinfect, not by force. Monitor 2–4 weeks post-bite for fever or rash and seek medical care if symptoms appear, informing about the bite. Tick activity is high during April–October in Anhui, Guangdong, Jiangsu. Prevention: wear light-colored, long clothing; tuck pants into socks; apply DEET repellents; perform body checks after outdoor activities."} ,

triage.headline_ja: 高熱が引かず、医者が患者から17匹のマダニを摘出！
triage.triage_reason: マダニ媒介ブニヤウイルス感染症（SFTS相当）の確診例が複数州で報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上（重症性、異常性）に該当し、スクリーニング基準でも3項目以上が該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は江蘇省・安徽省・広東省における春季（4月～10月）のマダニ媒介ブニヤウイルス感染症について述べており、中国内の複数地域での流行を示唆している。患者は高熱（40℃）、筋肉痛、出血傾向など重症症状を呈しており、初期診断の困難性と対症療法への反応不良が特徴的。社会的な注目度が高い報道である。

article.articleHeadline: India among worst-hit as hepatitis deaths stay high despite global gains: WHO report | India News
article.articleSummary: WHO's Global Hepatitis Report 2026 shows India among the ten countries bearing the heaviest hepatitis burden as global deaths exceed 1.3 million in 2024, driven mainly by hepatitis B and C (>95%). India ranks second for hepatitis C and accounts for about 69% of HBV deaths and 58% of HCV deaths; together with Pakistan and China, these nations account for about 39% of global HCV cases. An estimated 240 million people live with chronic hepatitis B and 47 million with hepatitis C in 2024. Despite vaccines and free hepatitis C treatment, India’s burden persists due to vaccination gaps, unsafe exposures (needle sharing, razor reuse), and missed screening, especially during pregnancy; under-diagnosis dominates over access to treatment. Globally, HB infections fell 32% since 2015; HCV deaths fell 12%, but HBV deaths rose 17%. Eliminating hepatitis C by 2030 remains unlikely at current pace; scaling up screening, vaccination, and safer medical practices is urged.

triage.headline_ja: インドは肝炎死亡が高いままで最悪打撃国の一つ―WHO報告書、グローバルな進展にもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: WHO公式報告書による既知の疾患負荷の定期的な評価であり、新規の急性発生イベントではない。複数の対象国（インド、中国）が関与するが、国際的な感染拡大リスクは低い。情報は十分だが、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本件はWHO Global Hepatitis Report 2026の定期公表に基づくもので、新規の感染症クラスターや異常な発生ではなく、既知の慢性疾患の継続的な疾病負荷に関する報告である。記事サマリーに「Pakistan」の言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。スクリーニング基準2つ該当するが、異常性・予想外性の欠如と、既知の慢性疾患であることから、RRA優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ntungamo, Rukiga shut animal markets over FMD outbreak
article.articleSummary: Foot and Mouth Disease outbreak in Ntungamo District, Uganda, with confirmed cases in Ngoma Sub-county near the Rwanda border; some contacts in Rukiga District. Authorities suspend all animal markets, milk and milk products, and movement of cattle, goats, sheep, and pigs and their products within and outside Ntungamo and Rukiga, effective immediately and planned for about one month, with a closure until May 27, 2026. A quarantine restricts sale, slaughter, and transport; slaughter slabs, butcheries, dairies, milk coolers, and meat roasting centers will close; hotels barred from cooking/serving such products. Patrols and road checkpoints will monitor compliance; movement licenses may be required for meat/product movement from outside the quarantine area. Farmers and traders anticipate economic impact; officials warn that delaying containment could broadcast outbreaks across the country.

triage.headline_ja: ンツンガモ、ルキガが口蹄疫の発生に対して動物市場を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダで確認された口蹄疫の発生であり、ルワンダとの国境付近での症例確認、隣国への拡大リスク、および積極的な封じ込め措置の実施が報告されている。IHR基準で最低2項目該当の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾患だが、公衆衛生への影響（食肉供給の減少、経済的影響）、国境を跨ぐ拡大リスク（ルワンダとの境界での症例確認）、および地域内での積極的な移動制限措置が報告されている。記事ではウガンダの発生が主題であり、DRC、ルワンダ、ウガンダの位置情報が付与されているが、サマリーの重点はウガンダ（特にンツンガモ地区）での発生と対応である。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades deben resolver la grave situación de tuberculosis en las cárceles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities must address the serious tuberculosis situation in prisons
article.articleSummary: Paraguay faces a severe TB crisis in its prisons. At the Penitentiary of Concepción, eight inmates have died this year from respiratory illnesses, four of them tuberculosis, prompting authorities to close the facility to prevent further spread. Concepción, with capacity for 700, currently houses about 1,900 inmates. Nationally, more than 20,000 prisoners are held across 19 penitentiaries, with TB reported in 15 centers; Concepción, San Pedro, and Emboscada show the highest incidence. The Mecanismo Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura (MNP) links the transmission to overcrowding and infrastructural deficiencies, noting 56 confirmed TB cases in Concepción. The issue calls for interagency action among Justice, prison authorities, Health, and regional health services, addressing corruption, food and hygiene gaps, and mental health needs. A Lancet regional study estimated Paraguay’s TB incidence at 48/100,000 nationwide but over 3,000/100,000 in prisons, underscoring stark inequalities.

triage.headline_ja: 当局は刑務所における結核の深刻な状況に対処する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高い発生率、国内拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはパラグアイの刑務所における結核危機に焦点を当てており、フィリピンはBluedot APIの地域識別エラーと考えられる。パラグアイの刑務所での結核発生率（3,000/100,000）は全国平均（48/100,000）の60倍以上であり、過密と衛生不備が直接的な原因として指摘されている。複数の刑務所施設（15/19）での報告、死亡事例（4件）、および政府間協力の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: हाउसफुल के सेट पर इस एक्ट्रेस को था मलेरिया, तेज बुखार और कंपंकपी के बाद भी की एक्टिंग, 30 करोड़ के बजट में फिल्म ने कमाए थे 124 करोड़
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the set of Housefull, this actress had malaria, high fever and kampankpi, but she still acted; the film, with a budget of ₹30 crore, grossed ₹124 crore.
article.articleSummary: Malaria struck Deepika Padukone during the Housefull shoot, with high fever and chills, yet she kept working through the night under a fixed schedule and delivered performances, including emotional scenes. Lara Dutta revealed Padukone was seriously ill and required medical treatment, but remained a consummate professional, not letting illness affect her work. Dutta highlighted Padukone's discipline and focus on her craft. Housefull, which began on April 30, 2010, had a budget of ₹30 crore and grossed ₹124 crore. Padukone's upcoming projects include Raka with Allu Arjun and King with Shah Rukh Khan. The story is from New Delhi via NDTV.in.

triage.headline_ja: ハウスフルのセットでこの女優はマラリアにかかっていた、高熱と悪寒があったにもかかわらず演技を続けた。予算30クローレの映画は124クローレを稼いだ
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2010年の映画製作中における個人の病歴に関するエンターテインメント記事であり、公衆衛生上の現在の感染症アウトブレイク、流行、または疫学的シグナルを報告していない。歴史的な個人事例であり、対応が必要な感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2010年の映画製作中における個人俳優の過去の病歴に関するエンターテインメント・ニュースである。感染症の現在の発生、流行、またはアウトブレイクを報告していないため、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては適切ではない。Bluedot APIがマラリア関連キーワードで検出したが、公衆衛生上の関連性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Gold Fields Ghana Foundation Marks World Malaria Day With Strong Push Against Disease - The Ghanaian Chronicle
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a major public health challenge in Ghana’s Tarkwa-Nsuaem and Prestea/Huni-Valley Municipalities. In 2025, health facilities logged 160,474 suspected malaria cases, with 53,037 testing positive; among pregnant women, 628 were tested and 224 positive. Malaria accounts for about 40% of outpatient visits, and there have been no malaria-related deaths in the past five years. On World Malaria Day 2026, Gold Fields Ghana Foundation, with the Tarkwa-Nsuaem Municipal Assembly and Municipal Health Directorate, marked the observance under the theme “Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must,” launching a large community engagement. The Foundation committed GH¢320,000 for radio programs, public education campaigns, and related interventions, plus practical measures like environmental sanitation (weed-slashing) and larviciding at breeding sites. Emphasis remains on insecticide-treated nets and intermittent preventive treatment for pregnant women to reduce transmission; residents with fever, headache, weakness or loss of appetite are urged to seek care.”}{

triage.headline_ja: ゴールドフィールズガーナ財団、世界マラリアデーを機にマラリア対策を強化 - ガーナニュース
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはガーナで周知の公衆衛生課題であり、新規の異常/異変なく、死亡例もない。世界マラリアデー記念行事の報道であり、シグナル性なし。
triage.notes: 世界マラリアデー記念イベントの報道。感染症の新規勃発や異常な増加傾向は示されておらず、既知の課題への啓発活動の記事。過去5年間の死亡例ゼロで、陽性率も管理可能範囲。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Un parásito originario de México aparece en un orinal romano del siglo II y eso debería ser imposible
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A parasite native to Mexico appears in a second-century Roman urinal, and that should be impossible.
article.articleSummary: Cryptosporidium parvum DNA and ELISA-confirmed proteins were detected in mineralized sediments from Roman ceramic urinals in Novae and Marcianopolis along the Danube (present-day Bulgaria), dating to the 2nd century AD. The mineralization process preserved remains better than typical latrine deposits. The findings, published in NPJ Heritage Science, show the parasite coexisted with Ancient Rome earlier than previously thought, challenging the view that C. parvum originated in Mexico and was introduced to Europe by later colonial contact. In addition to C. parvum, researchers found Taenia eggs and Entamoeba histolytica, indicating concurrent intestinal infections and suboptimal sanitation near Danubian settlements with water supplied from castellum aquae, underscoring waterborne transmission. The study highlights how ancient DNA and immunoassays can rewrite medical history and biogeography, raising questions about Eurasian origins and prompting calls for further research on early parasite spread and transmission vectors.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ原産の寄生虫が2世紀のローマの便器に現れ、それは不可能なはずだ
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは2世紀の古代ローマ遺跡からの古病理学的発見であり、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威や流行の証拠ではない。考古学的・歴史的関心は高いが、現在の感染症危機管理の観点からはシグナルの対象外。
triage.notes: このイベントは古代ローマ時代（2世紀AD）の考古学的遺物分析による古病理学的発見であり、現在の感染症イベント監視の対象外。Bluedot APIが提示した地域（ブルガリア、ブラジル、メキシコなど）は歴史的背景や参考情報としてのみ関連しており、現在進行中の感染症発生ではない。対象国リストに含まれるBrazil (3469034) も、同様の理由で記事の主題となる現在の感染症イベントではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 广东今年已出现基孔肯雅热本土病例_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong has already reported locally transmitted chikungunya fever cases this year.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong reports locally transmitted chikungunya fever this year—3 total cases as of April 19, 2026, including 2 imported and 1 locally acquired. Dengue fever is also increasing: 7 dengue cases in Week 16 (April 13–19), all imported, with Guangdong total dengue cases reaching 69 (63 imported from abroad, 2 from other provinces, 4 locally transmitted). Hong Kong also reported 2 imported chikungunya cases this year. Global context: since early 2025, over 40 countries/regions have reported 502,264 chikungunya cases and 186 deaths by December 10, 2025. Authorities warn that climate warming and growing travel raise risk of local spread in China; Guangdong and neighboring regions emphasize reinforced surveillance, reporting within 24 hours for chikungunya under Class B infectious disease, entomological control, and public guidance on reducing Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Environmental preventive measures advised: drain standing water, inspect water containers, report mosquito surges.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省は今年既にチクングニア熱の本土症例を報告している
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とデング熱の複合流行が中国（広東省・香港）で報告され、本土感染例が確認されている。IHR基準は異常性（予想外の本土感染）と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準は異常性・流行リスク・管理対応の強化が該当。シグナルとして認識すべき。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の広東省および香港での2つのウイルス性疾患（チクングニア熱とデング熱）の複合流行を報告。本土感染例の出現は懸念事項。当局は24時間以内の報告義務化、蚊媒介制御強化など対応を実施中。グローバル背景として2025年初期以降502,264例の国際的チクングニア熱流行があり、リスク文脈が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Obuasi Marks World Malaria Day With Durbar And Mini Clinic - The Ghanaian Chronicle
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day events in Obuasi, Ghana, featured a Durbar and a free mini clinic at Len Clay Sports Stadium forecourt, funded by AngloGold Ashanti Obuasi Mine. More than ten doctors provided free malaria screening and treatment to a large turnout. The program, AGAMAL, has protected about 1.4 million people across 16 districts and created about 1,450 direct jobs over its two-decade run. In Obuasi and environs, the mini clinic has benefited over 7,000 people with free health screening in the past four years. Partners include Otumfuo Osei Tutu Foundation, AGA Health Foundation, Ghana Health Service, and Underground Mining Alliance. Health officials urged households to allow Indoor Residual Spraying and to sleep under treated nets. Obuasi Municipal Chief Executive Faustilove Appiah Kannin praised AngloGold for bringing healthcare closer to residents.

triage.headline_ja: オブアシがマラリア世界デーをドゥルバーとミニクリニックで記念 - ガーナ・クロニクル
triage.triage_reason: 記事はガーナのマラリア啓発・予防活動の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクやイベント検知に該当しない。既存のマラリア管理プログラムの成果報告であり、緊急性なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界マラリアデー（4月25日）のイベント報道であり、マラリア啓発・予防キャンペーンの一環。AngloGold Ashanti Obuasi Mineが実施するAGAMALプログラムの2年間の成果（140万人保護、7,000人以上への無料検診）について述べており、新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、異常発生）ではない。シグナル検知対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerte sanitaire au Sénégal sur le " virus des crevettes " qui rend aveugle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert in Senegal over the "shrimp virus" that causes blindness.
article.articleSummary: Senegal issues a health alert over Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV), a marine virus nicknamed the 'shrimp virus,' linked to ocular disease and potential blindness in humans. First human cases were reported in Qingdao, China, where CMNV was found in ocular tissues of patients with persistent anterior uveitis (Poh-Vau), causing redness, irritation and raised pressure. A March 26, 2026 Nature Microbiology study notes about one-third of cases required surgery and one irreversible vision loss; genetic analyses show a 99% match with marine strains. Epidemiology indicates 71% of cases involve people in direct contact with aquatic fauna—fishers, fishmongers, cooks, and raw seafood consumers—with possible transmission by hand-to-eye contact; human-to-human transmission remains unconfirmed. CMNV has been detected on multiple continents, including the Atlantic, in at least 49 marine species; climate change and coastal pollution may amplify spread. One Health surveillance and prevention—handwashing, gloves, eye protection when handling seafood—are advised; no WHO alert yet.

triage.headline_ja: セネガルの「エビウイルス」による失明衛生警報
triage.triage_reason: 未知の病原体（CMNV）による新規人感染症、複数大陸での検出、眼疾患・失明の重症化、One Health関連イベント。IHR基準3つ以上該当、スクリーニング基準複数該当、国際的懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な医学的発見は中国青島での初期人感染例に関するもの。セネガルは当該ウイルスの衛生警報を発令しているが、確認された患者事例は中国が主。多大陸での海洋検出と人-動物接触リスク、重症度（手術1/3、失明事例有）、One Health懸念が際立つ。WHO警報未発出だが医学誌掲載（Nature Microbiology 2026年3月26日）。対象国リストに含まれるセネガルは該当なし（対象国外）。

article.articleHeadline: Ikhtiar atasi malaria di Jayapura (1) - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Efforts to overcome malaria in Jayapura (1) - ANTARA News.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a leading mosquito-borne killer in Indonesia, despite the overall national death toll averaging about 130 fatalities per year and ranking above dengue fever, Japanese encephalitis, and chikungunya. Across 514 districts, 476 (about 79%) have achieved elimination status, yet more than 93% of the national malaria burden is concentrated in Papua, including Jayapura. The Indonesian Ministry of Health is implementing a comprehensive nationwide elimination plan with a targeted Papua focus. Key measures include environment-based prevention to reduce Anopheles mosquito habitats, protection of communities through distribution of insecticide-treated nets, and engagement of malaria cadres to sustain local interventions. The effort underscores Papua as the critical battleground in achieving Indonesia’s malaria elimination goals, combining vector control, community protection, and local capacity building.

triage.headline_ja: ジャヤプラでマラリア対策に取り組む（1） - ANTARAニュース
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（パプア州）でのマラリア対策についての報道。重症度や公衆衛生への影響は示唆されているが、新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、進行中の慢性的課題の対策状況報道であるため、情報不足の状況での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクやエスカレーションではなく、インドネシア保健省が実施中のマラリア排除計画の進捗状況を報道している。パプア州が国家マラリア負担の93%以上を占める慢性的な高流行地域として描写されており、管理可能性に関する外部支援ニーズは明示されていない。複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、日本脳炎、チクングニア）が言及されているが、主題はマラリア対策。
