article.articleHeadline: Quelle est l'origine de la peste noire ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the origin of the Black Death?
article.articleSummary: Black Death, the plague that struck Eurasia and North Africa from about 1347–1353, caused fever, exhaustion, and painful buboes, and included bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic forms. The causative agent is Yersinia pestis, circulating in animal reservoirs (notably rodents) and transmitted to humans mainly by infected fleas. Origin likely lies in East Asia, with the pandemic spreading to the Black Sea and into Europe via maritime and overland routes amid dense trade and urban crowding. Notable monarchs fell to the disease, including Alphonse XI of Castile, who died in 1350 during the siege of Gibraltar. The Black Death did not vanish abruptly; it recurred for centuries. Decline linked to quarantines and cordons sanitaires, improved hygiene and isolation, changes in housing and storage, and ecological shifts in rats and fleas. Today plague persists in some foci but is treatable if diagnosed quickly.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病の起源は何か？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は14世紀の歴史的な黒死病パンデミックについての歴史解説であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域（Bangkok、Shanghai、Castile、New York等）は記事の歴史的文脈（14世紀の黒死病）に基づくもので、現在の感染症イベント発生地を表していない。本記事は純粋な歴史・医学教育コンテンツであり、現在のサーベイランス対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : quatre décès et dix-sept cas suspects de Choléra enregistrésà Mutongo-Walikale. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: four deaths and seventeen suspected cases of cholera recorded in Mutongo-Walikale. - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 April 2026, four deaths and 17 suspected cholera cases have been reported in Mutongo, Pinga Health Zone, Walikale Territory, North Kivu, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak is linked to mass displacement from Masisi, notably Nyabiondo, Lukweti and Misheeshe, where residents lack potable water and sanitation and live in crowded conditions. The disease has spread to Mutongo, raising fears of rapid transmission across the already fragile Pinga zone. An emergency meeting was held on 29 April in Pinga, with a field supervision mission deployed. Urgent needs include medicines, medical inputs, and logistics; requests include cholera treatment kits, IV fluids, and antibiotics. Authorities and humanitarian partners are urged to provide immediate medical assistance and rapid water, sanitation, and community-awareness measures to prevent a large-scale epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ワリカレ・ムトンゴで4人の死亡と17人のコレラ疑い患者が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5つ全て該当。DRC東部でのコレラ流行により、短期間に複数死亡と多数の疑い患者が報告され、人口移動に伴う急速な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域はDRC北キブ州ワリカレ地区のムトンゴで確認。マシシからの大規模人口移動に関連。飲料水とサニテーションの不足、密集生活という悪化要因が存在。医療資源の不足が報告され、国際的な人道支援が緊急に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ikhtiar atasi malaria di Jayapura (2) - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Efforts to Overcome Malaria in Jayapura (2) - ANTARA News
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains the leading infectious disease in Jayapura, Papua, Indonesia, with the city’s Health Office reporting the highest number of malaria cases though no exact counts are provided. Geographic challenges include mountainous terrain, remote settlements, and limited access to modern health facilities, complicating prevention and treatment. The Jayapura City Health Office is actively distributing insecticide-treated bed nets (ITNs) both routinely and in mass campaigns to curb transmission. In 2025, 115,427 ITNs were distributed to 14 kelurahan/villages as part of these efforts. Ongoing malaria control in Papua centers on vector prevention and improved access to care, amid logistical barriers. These measures aim to reduce incidence and malaria-related mortality in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ジャヤプラのマラリア対策の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは地風土病であり、ジャヤプラではマラリア対策が既に実施されている既知の状況。異常性や予想外性に乏しく、新規シグナルとして識別されない。
triage.notes: 記事はジャヤプラ（インドネシア・パプア州）におけるマラリア対策の進行中の取り組みを説明している。正確な症例数が記載されておらず、新規発生や異常な拡大についての記載もない。地風土病としてのマラリア対策は既知の状況であり、スクリーニング基準2項目該当するが、IHR基準に該当せず、社会政治的関心も低いため、フルRRAの必要性は判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều bệnh truyền nhiễm gia tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many infectious diseases are on the rise.
article.articleSummary: From 18 March to 18 April, Vietnam reports rising dengue fever and hand‑foot‑and‑mouth disease nationwide. Dengue: 6,408 cases and 1 death; cumulative since 14 December 2025: 44,965 cases, 5 deaths, up 1.8× vs 2025. HFMD: 11,808 cases and 3 deaths; cumulative 34,432 cases, 8 deaths, about 2.5× higher than a year ago. COVID‑19: 302 new cases, 0 deaths; cumulative 356 cases, 1 death since 14 December 2025, up 4.4×. Influenza: 17,894 cases, 0 deaths; by end‑March 2026, 52,865 cases, 0 deaths, down 15.1% vs 2025. Meningococcal meningitis: 5 cases, 2 deaths; cumulative 26 cases, 4 deaths. HIV/AIDS: 763 new positives and 232 deaths (18 March–18 April); 2,766 new positives in 2026 by April. Food poisoning: 7 outbreaks, 349 affected; 27 outbreaks, 849 affected, 3 deaths since 18 December 2025. Notable outbreaks include school canteens in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, a Dak Lak bakery, Son La canteen, with Salmonella and Staphylococcus aureus detected; 46 suspected cases in a Ho Chi Minh City primary school.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの感染症が増加している
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム全国で複数の感染症（デング熱、手足口病、インフルエンザ、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎）の報告増加があり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性、WPROs基準の重症度・流行しやすさを満たす。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムは複数の感染症の同時的増加を報告。デング熱は前年比1.8倍、手足口病は前年比2.5倍、COVID-19は4.4倍増加。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（5例、死亡2）と食中毒（ホーチミン市とハノイの学校給食施設での複数発生）も検出されている。複数疾患の同時増加パターンはシグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ancient animal reservoirs of zoonotic diseases
article.articleSummary: 346 zooarchaeological specimens from domesticated animals across 34 Eurasian sites (Bronze Age) were tested for preserved ancient pathogen DNA. Specimens were prioritized based on paleopathological lesions (215 skeletal elements, 188 with lesions) and 131 teeth to sample dental pulp for systemic infections. Clean-room ancient DNA extraction and computational screening revealed multiple zoonotic pathogen signatures; two pathogens, Streptococcus lutetiensis and Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae, yielded sufficient fragments for comparative analysis, confirming ancient authenticity. Lesion-based prioritization enriched positives, though varied skeletal-element sampling remains crucial. The study provides a proof-of-concept for using zooarchaeological ancient DNA to trace reservoirs, geographic spread, and spillover mechanisms of prehistoric zoonoses, situating Bronze Age pastoralism in Eurasia (Poland, Germany, Czech Republic, Romania, Uzbekistan) as a context for early zoonotic emergence.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症の古代動物貯蔵宿主
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは古代DNA研究に基づく学術論文報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。歴史的な病原体検証であり、公衆衛生上の現在の脅威は存在しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は考古学的な古代DNA分析研究報告であり、現代の感染症イベントではない。Bluedot APIが検出したStreptococcus関連キーワードは学術コンテキストであり、進行中の疾患発生ではない。対象国はタイのみ該当するが、記事内容上タイは地理的言及に留まり、主要な研究対象はポーランド・ドイツ・チェコ共和国・ルーマニア・ウズベキスタンである。

article.articleHeadline: 永州疾控：远离小儿麻痹症 守护儿童健康成长_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yongzhou CDC: Keep poliomyelitis at bay, safeguard children's healthy growth - Health - Yongzhou Station
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis (polio) is an acute enteric infection Yongzhou, China aims to keep at bay as wild poliovirus remains in Afghanistan and Pakistan, posing importation risk. Transmitted mainly via the fecal-oral route, polio can cause irreversible paralysis, especially in children under five. Historically, China faced 20,000–40,000 paralysis cases annually in the 1950s; the United States reported about 58,000 cases in 1952. The sugar-pill oral polio vaccine contributed to China’s decline, and the WHO certified China polio-free in 2000. As of 2026-04-30, Yongzhou CDC offers two vaccination schemes. Scheme 1 (free 2+2): inactivated polio vaccine (IPV) at 2 and 3 months; oral bivalent OPV (bOPV) at 4 months and 4 years. Scheme 2 (full IPV): IPV at 2 and 3 months free; at 4 months and 4 years IPV or IPV-containing vaccines, with physician guidance if bOPV is unsuitable. Vaccination remains the core preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: 永州疾控：小児麻痺症を遠ざけ、子どもの健全な成長を守る
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは高い公衆衛生脅威を持つ疾患だが、本記事は中国の予防啓発・ワクチン情報が主体であり、中国内での実際の患者発生は報告されていない。隣接地域（アフガニスタン、パキスタン）の野生ポリオウイルス存在による「輸入リスク」の言及がされているため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国（永州）の公衆衛生当局によるポリオ予防啓発・ワクチン接種スキーム情報が主体。中国は2000年にWHOによってポリオ撲滅認定国。現在のリスクはアフガニスタン・パキスタンの野生ポリオウイルスからの輸入リスク。発生地域にはUSやAfghanistan、Pakistanも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主体は中国内での予防対策であるため、verified_locationsはChina(1814991)のみとした。Bluedot APIが付与した他地域は参考情報または歴史的背景として機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Tây Ninh quyết liệt triển khai nhiều giải pháp phòng, chống bệnh dại lây từ động vật sang người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tay Ninh Province vigorously implements a range of measures to prevent and control rabies transmitted from animals to humans.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, caused seven deaths in early 2026 after bites from dogs or cats. By April 2026, the province had 192,700 pet dogs and cats, but vaccination and pet management remain weak. Localities including Luong Hoa, Hung Dien, My Hanh, Duc Lap, My An, and Thanh Dien Ward recorded seven deaths. Cases include P.V.H., 55, of My An, bitten in 2025 but receiving only one vaccine dose; by April 2026 he developed fever, hydrophobia and dysphagia and died. Phan Van Dol, 66, of Loc Ninh, bitten by a dog, did not vaccinate and relied on folk remedies; he developed hydrophobia and seizures and died at home. The 2026 vaccination target is over 160,600 doses; by end-April about 40,000 were delivered. Authorities urge full animal vaccination, prompt post-bite medical care, stricter pet control, and stronger public information. Fines of 1–2 million VND apply for non-compliance.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省、動物から人への感染が起こるぎっこう病の予防・制御のための複数の対策を積極的に展開
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による複数死亡事例（2026年初期までに7件）が確認されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。また、ワクチン接種率の低さと動物管理の脆弱性により、引き続き感染リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は通常疾患であるが、複数死亡例と継続的な暴露リスク（ワクチン接種率40%程度、動物管理不十分）が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・継続的曝露・流行リスクの3基準に該当。地方当局が積極的に予防対策を展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Ikhtiar atasi malaria di Jayapura (3) - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Efforts to overcome malaria in Jayapura (3) - ANTARA News.
article.articleSummary: Jayapura, Indonesia: The City Health Office has deployed 245 malaria cadres to screen residents using rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) on blood to determine malaria infection. The RDT-based testing enables rapid diagnosis and prompt treatment, aiming to curb transmission. The program places special emphasis on protecting residents, particularly pregnant women, since maintaining maternal health is seen as safeguarding the future generation from malaria. The report does not provide current case or death counts or describe an active outbreak, but highlights ongoing, community-level malaria screening and swift diagnosis as core to local control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ジャヤプラにおけるマラリア対策の取り組み（3）
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは風土病であり異常ではなく、記事は公衆衛生対策の実施状況報告である。重症度や死亡例の言及がなく、国際的拡大リスクも認識されない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ジャヤプラの当局による予防的なマラリア検査キャンペーンの報道。感染症の急性な流行や危機的状況ではなく、定着性感染症への日常的対策の範囲内。症例数や死亡例の報告がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Manggarai Timur KLB Rabies, PMI Bersama Disnak Vaksinasi HPR di Sepuluh Desa - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Outbreak in East Manggarai, PMI Together with the Department of Animal Husbandry Vaccinate Rabies-Transmitting Animals in Ten Villages - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak declared in East Manggarai Regency (Manggarai Timur), prompting vaccination of rabies-transmitting dogs in ten villages as part of an outbreak response. The Matim Government, through the Department of Animal Husbandry (Disnak Matim), prepared 2,000 dog rabies vaccines (HPR) to be administered with PMI Matim in ten villages: Tana Rata, Pong Ruan, Golo Tolang, Golo Ros, Colol, Wejang Mawe, Bangka Arus, Lamba Keli, Sita, and Gurung Liwut. The effort follows a 10,000-dose supply obtained from the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) via the Ministry of Agriculture. The vaccination campaign runs under the KLB Rabies response from January to May 2026. Monitoring and evaluation are conducted by PMI Central together with the American Red Cross at the Bupati Matim’s residence in Golo Lada Borong (29 April 2026). Attendees included the Bupati Agas Andreas, PMI Manggarai Timur leadership, and partner health and animal health agencies. No outbreak case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 東マンガライ県の狂犬病流行、動物衛生局とPMIが10村で狂犬病媒介動物にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける狂犬病のアウトブレイク宣言であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行リスク）に該当する可能性があるが、症例数、人間への感染数、重症度などの重要情報が記事に記載されていない。動物対象のワクチン接種キャンペーン段階であり、詳細情報の続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は動物対象のワクチン接種キャンペーンに焦点を当てており、人間への影響（感染者数、死亡者、重症度）に関する具体的な情報が完全に欠落している。WOAHおよび農業省からのワクチン供給があり、政府対応が進行中である。続報で人間への感染状況が明確になることで判定が変わる可能性がある。マレーシア（Pahang州など）も発生地域として登録されているが、記事サマリーはインドネシアの東マンガライ県のみを主題としているため、verified_locationsにはインドネシアのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: バングラデシュではしか大流行、子ども２２７人死亡 感染疑い例３万５０００件：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh: 227 children died, 35,000 suspected cases — Jiji.com
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh, the worst in decades, has killed 227 children and produced about 35,000 suspected cases, government data released on April 29, 2026 show. The Kurukpata region of the Chittagong Hill Tracts, near the Myanmar border, is among the hardest hit, with minority communities disproportionately affected. Many children in border areas miss routine vaccinations, and fear drives vaccination avoidance in some families. The World Health Organization notes measles is highly infectious, spreading via coughs and sneezes. While it can affect all ages, young children bear the brunt, and complications such as encephalitis and severe respiratory disease can occur. Since March 15, the nationwide number of suspected cases reached 34,980, with most patients aged 6 months to 5 years. The situation underscores gaps in vaccination coverage and access in remote areas within Bangladesh.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュではしか大流行、子ども２２７人死亡 感染疑い例３万５０００件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。数十年で最悪のはしか流行、227人の死亡、35,000件の疑い例、国境地帯での多数発生により国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: バングラデシュはBluedot APIで発生地域として特定されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただしミャンマー国境地帯での発生が記述されており、また記事サマリーに『Unknown Encephalitis』の合併症言及あり。インドは対象国リストに含まれるが、この記事では主題ではなく、バングラデシュ-ミャンマー国境地帯が主焦点である。記事の主たる発生地がバングラデシュ（対象国外）のため、verified_locationsは空配列とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose volta a crescer em Minas Gerais e preocupa autoridades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis is rising again in Minas Gerais and concerns health authorities.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis is rising again in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 2023–2024 case counts exceeding 5,000 annually—the highest since 2008. Caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Koch bacillus), it is airborne and mainly affects the lungs but may involve bones, kidneys, meninges, or lymph nodes, especially in the immunocompromised. Transmission occurs when an active TB patient expels infectious particles by coughing, sneezing, or talking; a single untreated case can infect up to 15 people per year. Close, poorly ventilated spaces increase risk; transmission via shared objects is not supported. Symptoms include persistent cough for three weeks or more, low-grade afternoon fever, night sweats, weight loss, and fatigue. Treatment is free through SUS for at least six months with rifampicin, isoniazid, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol. Adherence prevents resistance. Prevention emphasizes BCG vaccination, ventilation with sunlight, avoiding crowds, and proper coughing etiquette. Officials cite social factors and pandemic-related delays, urging stronger policies and access.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのミナスジェライス州で結核が再び増加し、保健当局が懸念
triage.triage_reason: 結核の増加（2023-2024年に年5000例以上、2008年以来の高水準）は異常かつ懸念される傾向を示しているが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当を確定するには国際的拡大リスクや現在の管理状況に関する情報が不足している。引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから判断すると、ブラジルでの結核増加は明確で、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響と異常性）を満たすように見えるが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限のリスクについては言及がなく不明。WPROスクリーニング基準は全て該当する。情報が十分であればPICKUP相当となる可能性が高いため、WATCHとして続報を注視することが適切。ブラジルが対象国リストに含まれているため、本イベントは追跡価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 加强防范手足口病和食源性疾病 重庆疾控发布五月健康风险提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen prevention of hand-foot-and-mouth disease and foodborne diseases; Chongqing CDC issues May health risk advisory.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and malaria are the focus of Chongqing CDC’s May health risk advisory. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, with a 5–9 day incubation and sudden high fever (often >39°C), severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, rash, and occasional bleeding. Chikungunya, also spread by Aedes, incubates 3–7 days and presents fever, rash, and prominent joint pain that may last months to years for some. Malaria (falciparum) transmitted by Anopheles causes cycles of chills, fever, and sweating; Chongqing has been free of local malaria for years, but imported cases occur amid cross-border travel. Prevention emphasizes personal protection (screens, repellents, long sleeves) and breeding-site reduction (regular water changes in plant containers, cleaning hidden water). Outbound travelers should review destination risks, and returnees with fever, joint pain, or rash should seek prompt medical care and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病と食源性疾病の予防を強化；重庆CDCが5月の健康リスク警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリアについての公式な健康リスク警告で異常性・予想外性は認められるが、具体的な患者数、重症度、国際的拡大リスクの情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 本記事は重庆CDCによる予防啓発であり、具体的な患者報告ではない。デング、チクングニア、マラリアはいずれも媒介昆虫（蚊）によって伝播し、クロスボーダー旅行による輸入症例のリスク言及がある点で国際的関心が存在する。ただし患者数、死亡例、重症度などの具体的データが記事に記載されていないため、フルリスク評価に進む前に追加情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố vụ án giết mổ, tiêu thụ lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indictment in the case of slaughtering and consuming pigs infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Three individuals were indicted on 28 April 2026 in Thanh Hoa province, Vietnam, for violating food safety regulations after slaughtering and marketing pigs infected with African swine fever (ASF). Suspects: Nguyen Van Chien, Le Van Trung, and Nguyen Khac Nguyen. On 31 March 2026, authorities inspected a pig slaughter facility in Hamlet 3, Hoang Loc Commune, owned by Chien, uncovering 3 slaughtered pigs totaling 384.5 kg and 8 live pigs showing illness. Chien admitted that despite illness signs he ordered slaughter to sell, and he also purchased eight more diseased pigs to slaughter. The infection source was traced to Nguyen Khac Nguyen, a pig farmer in Hoang Hoa Commune, who did not report the illness and attempted to liquidate stock. Laboratory tests by the National Center for Veterinary Diagnostics and Testing, Center I, confirmed ASF virus in meat and blood. Authorities seized 384.5 kg of meat and culled the eight diseased pigs; the case remains under legal processing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染豚の屠殺・消費事件で起訴——ベトナム・タインホア省
triage.triage_reason: ASFは動物感染症で公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は限定的だが、食品安全違反と畜産への脅威が存在する。情報不足により確定的なシグナル判定は保留し、動向監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントはASFの動物感染症であり、人間への直接的な感染リスクは記事上では指摘されていない。ただし、タインホア省での複数の個体における確認、食品安全違反、および継続的な畜産への曝露リスクが存在する。ベトナムのASF対応能力は確立されているが、違反個案の継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 五一出游健康提醒：谨防蜱虫叮咬，勿食用野生食材
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: May Day travel health tips: Be vigilant against tick bites, and do not eat wild foods.
article.articleSummary: On 30 April 2026, Quanzhou City CDC urges May Day travelers to guard against tick bites and avoid wild foods. Ticks can transmit babesiosis, Lyme disease, tick-borne encephalitis, and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome; babesiosis may cause high fever, severe anemia, jaundice, kidney failure, and death. Prevention emphasizes camping in dry, open areas away from dense grass; use a groundsheet; wear light long sleeves and pants; tighten cuffs and collars; wear a hat and closed shoes; post-trip showering and thorough skin inspection, with hot-water laundry. If fever or weakness follows a tick bite, seek medical care and inform the clinician. Do not collect or eat wild mushrooms; poisonous mushrooms resemble edible ones and have no antidote. Buy seasonal greens (spring bamboo shoots, Chinese toon, shepherd’s purse) from regular channels, wash and boil; stop consumption and seek care if poisoning occurs.

triage.headline_ja: ゴールデンウイーク旅行時の健康注意：ダニ刺傷に警戒し、野生食材の摂取を避ける
triage.triage_reason: 泉州市CDC による予防啓発記事であり、蜤虫媒介感染症（バベシア症、ライム病、ダニ媒介脳炎、SFTSなど）の複数疾患が言及されている。しかし現在の流行報告ではなく、季節的予防勧告の性質であり、情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国福建省泉州市CDCによるゴールデンウイーク期間中の予防啓発であり、確認された流行やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、季節的リスク注意情報である。バベシア症、ライム病、ダニ媒介脳炎、SFTSなど複数のダニ媒介感染症が関連しており、長期曝露と流行易性のリスク基準に該当するが、具体的な患者数、重症度、異常事象の報告がなく、情報が限定的。続報のスキャンが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'She was shivering all night': Lara Dutta reveals the 'wiped out' reality of Deepika Padukone filming Housefull with Malaria; a doctor reveals whether this is safe
article.articleSummary: Malaria affected Deepika Padukone during the Housefull shoot in India; she ran a high fever, was shivering, and required medical treatment while continuing a demanding fixed schedule. Dr. Pankaj Khatana explains malaria fatigue and weakness arise from hemolytic anemia, as red blood cells are destroyed reducing oxygen delivery to tissues, with cytokines causing malaise. Even uncomplicated malaria often requires prompt treatment with oral antimalarials; full recovery typically takes 1–2 weeks or longer, with lingering fatigue that can last weeks. Recovery entails completing the full course, allowing time to heal, and gradually resuming daily activities; severe malaria or infections with P. vivax or P. ovale can lead to relapses and extended weakness. Location: India; Gurugram-based clinician referenced; no case/death counts or outbreaks are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 「一晩中震えていた」ラーラ・ダッタが明かす、マラリアで「疲弊した」ディーピカ・パドゥコーンのハウスフル撮影の現実；医師が安全性について言及
triage.triage_reason: 個人患者のマラリア症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生、異常な流行、国際的拡大の兆候がなく、医学教育的な記事。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内の有名人（Deepika Padukone）がマラリアに罹患した個別事例とその医学的説明（医師Dr. Pankaj Khana解説）を扱っている。「no case/death counts or outbreaks are reported」と明記されており、感染症イベント（集団発生）ではなく個人患者事例である。エンターテインメント関連メディアの健康情報記事として機能しており、EBS監視対象のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 716 Kasus TBC Ditemukan di Sumenep Awal Tahun 2026, Didominasi Usia Produktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 716 TB cases detected in Sumenep in early 2026, dominated by the productive-age group
article.articleSummary: 716 tuberculosis (TB) cases have been detected in Sumenep Regency, Madura, Indonesia, since January 2026, with the productive-age group (25–56 years) forming the majority. This age pattern repeats annually, linked to high daily activity and mobility that increase social contact and transmission when undetected cases exist. TB can affect all ages, though surveillance shows more cases among working-age adults. The Sumenep Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Pengendalian Penduduk dan Keluarga Berencana, Dinkes P2KB) uses the SITB monitoring system to track distribution. Case finding combines active screening at health facilities—puskesmas (community health centers), hospitals, clinics, and private practitioners—with passive detection from patients presenting with TB symptoms. The report underscores ongoing surveillance and screening efforts to identify cases and curb transmission in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年初頭にスメネップで結核716例が検出、生産年齢層が大多数を占める
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・スメネップでの結核集積報告だが、死亡や重症化の記述がなく、症例数のみの報告。異常性・重症度の明確な記述が不足しており、更なる情報を要注視。
triage.notes: スメネップ保健所がSITB監視システムで継続追跡中であり、能動的・受動的スクリーニングを実施している。結核は人口流動性の高い生産年齢層(25-56歳)で多く見られており、長期曝露・流行可能性の基準に該当。ただし致死率・重症度・異常性の明記がないため、トリアージはWATCH段階。インドネシアは対象国に含まれるため地域検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Fortaleza usa nova tecnologia que 'envenena' mosquito da dengue; saiba como funciona
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortaleza uses new technology that 'poisons' the dengue-carrying mosquito; learn how it works.
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza, Brazil, is deploying Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida (EDLs) to combat Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector, in 2026. In partnership with Fiocruz, the municipal Health Secretariat began installing EDLs in April, with an initial 2,240 units out of 11,740 total planned. The device coats a screen with larvicide; when female mosquitoes land to lay eggs, their legs pick up microparticles and, after moving to other breeding sites, transfer the larvicide, hindering egg hatching and larval development. Expansion will target high-risk areas identified by LIRAa, which currently classifies 65 neighborhoods as Satisfactory (<1%), 55 as Alerta (1–4%), and only Parreão as Risco (>4%) in the first cycle. Four annual cycles will guide interventions, prioritizing strategic points such as junkyards, public buildings, and construction sites, advancing biological control to curb proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザ、デング蚊を「毒する」新技術を導入。その仕組みを学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルのフォルタレザにおけるデング・ジカ・チクングニア対策の新しい予防技術（幼虫制御装置）の展開に関するもので、新規感染症の発生ではなく、既存のベクター媒介感染症に対する予防・制御イニシアティブの報道。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: この記事は感染症の新規発生や急増を報じるものではなく、ベクター制御のための革新的な予防技術（Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida: EDL）の導入に関する正常な公衆衛生対策の報道である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Elephant Suspected To Have Died Of Anthrax In Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve
article.articleSummary: On 30 April 2026, a female elephant named Gayatri (four-and-a-half years old) died at Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve, Umaria, after a prolonged illness. She exhibited diarrhea with anal bleeding and was unable to move due to extreme stress and exhaustion. Wildlife medical teams from Jabalpur and doctors at Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve report preliminary signs pointing to a possible Anthrax outbreak in the area. Anthrax, caused by Bacillus anthracis, is rare but serious and occurs naturally in soil, affecting domestic and wild animals such as cattle, sheep, and goats. Transmission occurs through contact with infected animals and can cause high fever, respiratory distress, and bleeding from the mouth, nose, and anus, leading to sudden death. Humans can contract the disease through contact with infected animals or contaminated animal products, but it is not contagious between people.

triage.headline_ja: バンダヴガルタイガーリザーブでゾウが炭疽病で死亡した可能性
triage.triage_reason: 動物での炭疽病の死亡報告で、人への感染リスクは低いが、土壌由来の自然発生病原体であり、動物から人への伝播可能性がある。現時点では人の患者報告がなく、情報が限定的であるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 動物での炭疽病死亡は報告されているが、人の患者はまだ確認されていない。Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserveはマディヤプラデシュ州(Umaria)に位置する。人への伝播の可能性は接触経由に限定される。地方の野生動物医療チームが対応しており、現時点で国際的支援の必要性は不明確。追加の患者発生情報が得られるまでは注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Alagoinhas intensifica combate à dengue, mas imóveis inacessíveis dificultam o trabalho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alagoinhas City Hall intensifies the fight against dengue, but inaccessible properties hinder the work.
article.articleSummary: Alagoinhas, Brazil – In 2026, the city hall intensified dengue control targeting Aedes aegypti. In the first four months, 53 endemic agents covered 1,725 city blocks, prioritizing Petrolar and Centro, yet nearly 29,000 of about 60,000 properties could not be inspected due to closures or residents refusing visits. Claudine Ramos, director of Health Surveillance, notes that 128 strategic points were reinforced; agents removed mosquito breeding deposits from around 31,000 properties, but access remains essential. Despite anti-mosquito measures, case numbers are rising; the Domestic Infestation Index (IIP) reached 1.97%, placing Alagoinhas in a state of alert for dengue, Zika and Chikungunya, with most breeding sites in homes. To reverse the trend, residents are urged to seal water storage containers, clean gutters, remove plant tray accumulations, store bottles mouth-down, and minimize trash and stagnant water in backyards.

triage.headline_ja: アラゴイニャス市がデング対策を強化、しかしアクセス不可能な物件が業務を困難にしている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱・ジカ・チクングニア熱の流行兆候を示すが、現時点では局所的な市レベルの対応報告であり、IHR基準に複数該当する重篤な公衆衛生緊急事態の直接的証拠に欠ける。情報収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアラゴイニャス市（バイア州）における2026年のデング対策の実状を報告するもので、IIP 1.97%到達という警告状態、約48,000件の物件アクセス不可による対策の制限、ジカ・チクングニアとの同時流行状況を指摘している。WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、死亡例や重症化の記述がなく、重症度の情報が不足している。他地域への拡大やブラジル全体への影響についても記事に記載されていない。続報による更新を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Balikpapan Waswas PMK, DKP3 Didesak Lakukan Pengambilan Sampel Hewan Kurban Menyeluruh - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balikpapan residents anxious about foot-and-mouth disease, DKP3 pressured to conduct comprehensive sampling of sacrificial animals
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), known locally as PMK, is raising alarm in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan, as Idul Adha 2026 approaches. Cattle and goats are being sold at roadside stalls and vacant lots, with animals largely imported from outside the city, prompting concerns about health status despite health certificates. Residents urge the Balikpapan City Food, Agriculture and Fisheries Service (DKP3) to conduct on-site veterinary checks and comprehensive sampling of sacrificial animals, not solely rely on paperwork. Rudi Hartono warns certificates may be formalities and buyers need true disease-free assurance, while Nur Aini calls for transparent surveillance and public disclosure of which animals pass tests. The Balikpapan DPRD also pressures DKP3 to ensure all animals are healthy and fit for sale, with strict health inspections and complete origin certificates, addressing crowded, unsanitary stalls that could affect welfare and public confidence.

triage.headline_ja: バリクパパン住民が口蹄疫（PMK）に不安、DKP3は犠牲動物の包括的なサンプリングを実施するよう求められている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで口蹄疫の懸念が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も確認されるため。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾病であり、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は限定的だが、イドゥル・アドハ（2026年）の犠牲祭に向けて多数の家畜が取引されており、衛生管理と疾病リスクに関する社会的・政治的関心が高い。当局への圧力と包括的なサンプリングの要求から、管理体制の強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: 3 indicted in Vietnam's Thanh Hoa for selling ASF-infected pork
article.articleSummary: Three individuals indicted in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, for violating food safety regulations after authorities raided a livestock slaughter facility in Hoang Loc Commune on March 31. Nguyen Khac Nguyen, 60; Nguyen Van Chien, 42; and Le Van Trung, 44, are accused of handling ASF-infected pork for profit. During the inspection, investigators found three slaughtered pigs (384.5 kg total) and eight live pigs in pens (452 kg) showing ASF signs. Laboratory tests confirmed infection with African swine fever, tracing all pigs to Nguyen, who raised them on his farm. Despite signs of ASF, Nguyen allegedly did not report to authorities and sold the pigs cheaply to Trung, who resold them to Chien, who allegedly arranged slaughter and sale on the market. ASF-infected pork is banned from the food supply and must be destroyed. The case remains under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのタインホア省で、アフリカ豚コレラ感染豚肉販売で3人が起訴
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は動物感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性がないため重度の公衆衛生上の影響は限定的。ただし、食品安全違反と不正販売の容疑であり、地域の動物衛生管理と食品流通の異常が認識される。
triage.notes: 本件は動物のASF感染事例であり、ヒト感染リスクはない。ただし、食品安全違反と疫病の不報告・隠匿が存在し、地域の疾病管理体制の脆弱性が示唆される。動物衛生当局の対応と食品流通の透明性向上が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PAM Batang memasang 33 terminal sanitasi air dapur MBG untuk mencegah E-coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Batang Drinking Water Company installs 33 MBG kitchen water sanitation terminals to prevent E. coli.
article.articleSummary: Batang Regency, Central Java, Indonesia — PAM Sendang Kamulyan installs 33 water-sanitization chlorinator terminals at Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) kitchens to safeguard drinking water and prevent Escherichia coli contamination. Latest Health Office labs report E. coli level at 0%, indicating water meets safety standards for kitchen use. The initiative follows improvements to the water treatment system, including distribution-pipe chlorinators delivering water directly to MBG kitchens to maintain quality at the point of use. Ongoing surveillance uses chlorine checker devices to keep residual chlorine within recommended limits. Each MBG kitchen consumes roughly 200–300 cubic meters of clean water per month. PAM urges more MBG kitchens to switch to official clean-water services to ensure food safety and water quality.

triage.headline_ja: バタン飲料水公社、E.coli予防のため33台のMBG台所用水衛生化ターミナルを設置
triage.triage_reason: 記事は予防的な水処理インフラ整備に関するもので、実際のE.coli集団発生や患者発症を報告していない。最新の検査結果はE.coli 0%で安全基準を満たしており、公衆衛生上の危機を示していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はE.coli感染症の発生報告ではなく、バタン県（中部ジャワ）における給食プログラム（MBG）のための水処理インフラ整備に関する情報記事である。検査結果でE.coliレベル0%と報告されており、実際の感染症イベントを示していない。予防的な公衆衛生施策に関する通常のニュース報道と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas inicia vacinação contra a dengue em novos grupos prioritários
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas Begins Dengue Vaccination in New Priority Groups.
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccination in Campinas, Brazil expands to health-care workers in both public and private facilities and to residents aged 59, with immunization at all health centers starting Monday, May 4, 2026. The vaccine arrived in February 2026, and since then 2,090 people have been vaccinated, initially limited to Primary Care professionals in the public network. Currently, Campinas has about 1,000 doses available and has requested a new shipment from the state government, awaiting delivery. The expansion builds on the initial rollout focusing on frontline public workers and aims to broaden protection against dengue amid ongoing immunization efforts in the city.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナスが新しい優先グループに対するデング熱ワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本件はデング熱の予防接種キャンペーン開始に関するニュースであり、感染症の流行拡大やアウトブレイク報告ではない。IHR基準及びWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱ウイルスの感染拡大やアウトブレイクではなく、市民への予防接種プログラムの拡大に関する行政ニュースである。シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: A single swab is sufficient: Study paves the way for simplified tuberculosis diagnosis
article.articleSummary: TB diagnostic study shows tongue-swab molecular test delivering rapid near-point-of-care TB detection without laboratory infrastructure. In a multicenter NEJM study (2026), 1,380 individuals with suspected pulmonary TB in India, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, Vietnam, Zambia, and the Philippines provided tongue swabs and sputum. Tongue-swab testing identified TB with 80% sensitivity and 99.5% specificity; sputum-based molecular diagnostics showed comparable performance. The test uses two portable devices: one to lyse bacterial cells to release DNA, the other to perform molecular detection with a visual positive/negative signal, delivering results in under 35 minutes. The method is usable by minimally trained personnel and broadens sampling to non-sputum cases, including children and people living with HIV. WHO recommended it as the first near-point-of-care molecular TB diagnostic, with pilot implementations planned in high-burden settings; funding from NIH/NIAID, Gates Foundation, U.S. Department of State (formerly USAID), EDCTP, Global Fund, and the Children’s Investment Fund Foundation. Advantages include battery-powered operation and lower costs.

triage.headline_ja: 単一の綿棒で十分：研究が結核診断の簡素化への道を開く
triage.triage_reason: 本件は結核診断技術の開発・臨床研究に関する医学的進展であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核診断技術（舌綿棒分子検査）の多施設共同臨床研究（NEJM 2026）に関する医学的進展を報じている。新規アウトブレイク、異常事象、または危機的な公衆衛生事象ではなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。記事の主題は診断法の開発であり、流行や緊急事態とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ein Abstrich genügt: Studie ebnet Weg für einfacheren Tuberkulose-Nachweis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One swab is enough: a study paves the way for easier tuberculosis detection.
article.articleSummary: International study led by Heidelberg and UCSF demonstrates a rapid TB diagnostic using a tongue swab. Mycobacterium tuberculosis is detected at or near the point of care in under 35 minutes with two portable devices: one to liquefy the swab sample and a second to detect bacterial DNA, signaling positive/negative results. The NEJM study enrolled 1,380 individuals with suspected pulmonary TB across India, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, Vietnam, Zambia and the Philippines, comparing tongue-swab results with sputum-based testing. Tongue swabs showed 80% sensitivity and 99.5% specificity, mirroring sputum performance and meeting WHO expectations for near-point-of-care TB diagnostics. The approach increases accessibility for patients who cannot produce sputum (children, severely ill, HIV-positive) and can be operated by lay personnel, with battery-powered devices and lower costs, facilitating pilot deployment in high-burden settings.

triage.headline_ja: 一つの綿棒で十分：研究が結核の簡単な検出への道を開く
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核診断法の技術開発・臨床研究成果に関するもので、流行の発生・拡大を報告するイベントではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNEJMに掲載された診断技術の臨床研究レポートであり、新規感染症イベントやアウトブレイク報告ではない。複数国での臨床試験実施地が列挙されているが、これらは疾患流行の証拠ではなく研究参加国である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Deepika Padukone Shot Housefull While Battling Malaria, Reveals Lara Dutta | Filmfare.com
article.articleSummary: During the filming of Housefull, Deepika Padukone was diagnosed with malaria and was extremely unwell, Lara Dutta revealed in an interview cited by Filmfare and NDTV. She endured high fever and shivering, required a doctor and medication overnight, yet returned to a fixed schedule to shoot emotionally demanding scenes. Despite being drained, Padukone delivered her performance with no drop in quality, demonstrating notable professionalism. The disclosure, shared by Dutta in a conversation with NDTV, frames malaria as the illness and Housefull’s on-set filming as the context. Published 2026-04-30, the report highlights malaria’s impact on set and the actor’s perseverance.

triage.headline_ja: ディーピカ・パドゥコーンはマラリアと闘いながらハウスフルを撮影した、ララ・ダッタが明かす
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はボリウッド女優の個人的な健康問題（マラリア罹患）に関する娯楽ニュースであり、感染症の流行・集団発症・公衆衛生上の危機を示す証拠がない。単一事例の報道に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、いずれの基準も満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はエンターテインメント関連メディア（Filmfare）の発行源であり、ボリウッド俳優の個人的な疾患エピソードについての人物記事である。感染症監視システムのシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 隨父母到巴基斯坦近3個月　14個月大男B染麻疹列輸入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14-month-old boy (Case B) with measles, listed as an imported case after staying in Pakistan with his parents for nearly 3 months.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Hong Kong: A 14-month-old boy (Case B) is an imported measles case after spending nearly 3 months in Pakistan with his parents. He is hospitalized at Kwong Wah Hospital and stable. Travel to Pakistan occurred Jan 19–Apr 17; he received his first measles vaccine on the day of onset, but protection typically develops 14 days later and a second dose has not yet been given. During the infectious period from Apr 22 onward, he visited Kowloon City Maternal and Child Health Centre, a private clinic, and Kwong Wah Hospital emergency department. The Centre for Health Protection has identified 95 close contacts under medical surveillance; two household contacts with mild upper respiratory symptoms tested negative for measles. CHP continues free measles vaccination for eligible airport workers to bolster herd immunity; no further transmission linked to earlier airport staff clusters has been detected.

triage.headline_ja: 14か月の男児（Case B）が麻疹感染、パキスタンからの輸入症例として報告
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例であり国際移動に関連し、公衆衛生上一定の重要性があるが、現時点では限定的な発症（1症例）であり、地域への二次感染も限定的。情報の充実を待つべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はホンコンでの輸入麻疹症例。発生地域にパキスタンが含まれているが、パキスタンはサマリー上での流行地背景情報として言及されており、現在のアウトブレイク主題はホンコン（中国）である。ホンコン・マカオは中国に包含するルールに従いChinaのみを verified_locations に含める。現在、95名の濃厚接触者が監視中だが、確認された二次症例はない。麻疹は高伝播能だが、現段階では限定的な症例数のため WATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes terapkan strategi TOKEN tekan kasus malaria di Papua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health implements the TOKEN strategy to curb malaria cases in Papua.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health is implementing the TOKEN strategy (Find, Treat, Control) to accelerate malaria elimination in Papua. The plan notes that 95% of Indonesia’s malaria cases are in Papua, guiding elimination efforts in Tanah Papua. It aims to raise case detection from about 700,000 last year to 800,000 this year through intensified passive case detection at puskesmas. It strengthens community involvement by delegating screening and treatment in difficult areas to trained cadres, forming village malaria teams, enacting village regulations, and training key figures. A forest-intervention package targets about 20% of cases among migrants, including mass drug administration, prevention kits, and routine screening for forest entrants. Challenges include funding, low case finding, and geographic barriers. Globally, malaria cases total ~282 million; Western Pacific ~2.4 million; Indonesia ranks second in the region after Papua New Guinea. As of 30 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省がパプアでマラリア症例を抑制するためにTOKEN戦略を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（パプア州）でのマラリア症例は深刻な公衆衛生課題であり、スクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）で複数該当。ただし、記事は対症療法的な管理戦略の発表であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではないため、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスクの判断は保留。続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、イベントはインドネシア（パプア州）で発生。パプアニューギニアはGeoNames対象国外のため除外。マラリアは地域的な長期的課題であり、急性なアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし、スクリーニング基準で複数該当し、政府・社会的関心も高いため、監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Madárinfluenza: angol pulykateszt, lengyel exportpánik - Agrárágazat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: English turkey test, Polish export panic - Agrárágazat
article.articleSummary: United Kingdom begins field testing high-pathogenic avian influenza vaccines in turkeys in March, a 24-week trial with a small, controlled flock using approved UK and EU vaccines. The aim is to assess whether vaccination adds a protective layer alongside biosecurity, not to replace it, with export market protection a key concern. In Poland, dozens of outbreaks since the year's start have prompted culling of about 7.5 million hens since autumn 2025, roughly 15% of the laying flock, risking export since Poland sends 35-45% of its eggs. March restrictions affected niche markets like North Macedonia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Kyrgyzstan, while the EU position could weaken amid competition from Ukraine, Turkey, and Brazil. The shared lesson: biosecurity alone isn't enough; vaccination strategy, export preservation, and rapid restocking will determine competitiveness. In Hungary, bird flu restrictions have been lifted domestically.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：イギリスの七面鳥試験、ポーランドの輸出パニック
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの高病原性株が複数国で拡大し、畜産業に重大な経済的影響を与えているが、対象国ではブラジルのみが該当し、記事の主要な焦点はポーランド・イギリスなど対象外の地域。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はポーランド、イギリス、ハンガリー、ウクライナ、トルコなど対象国外での鳥インフルエンザの状況に焦点を当てており、対象国ではブラジルのみが言及されている（EU競争相手として）。IHR基準3項目該当し国際的な貿易・輸出への影響は顕著だが、対象国での人間感染（Human Infection with Avian Influenza）の確認がないため、現段階ではWATCHとする。ただし、ブラジルでの動向や今後の人間感染の報告により判定が変わる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Morre de raiva humana adolescente de 17 anos mordido por sagui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17-year-old dies of human rabies after being bitten by a sagui
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Piauí, Brazil: a 17-year-old boy, Marlon Caique da Silva, died on April 17 from rabies contracted after a bite from a sagui (small New World monkey) in rural Oeiras. Laboratory tests confirmed infection with the rabies virus. Rabies is highly lethal and transmitted via the saliva of infected animals; incubation can be lengthy, and early symptoms (disorientation, fever, vomiting) may mimic other illnesses, hindering prompt diagnosis. The Secretaria de Estado da Saúde do Piauí urged immediate post-bite measures: wash the wound with running water and soap, seek medical care quickly for assessment and potential post-exposure prophylaxis, do not attempt to capture the animal, and keep dogs and cats vaccinated. The case emphasizes prevention and rapid treatment in rural areas with frequent wildlife contact to avert further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: サグイに噛まれた17歳の少年がヒト狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「予想外の死亡事例」「重症度（致死）」に該当し、ブラジルにおける狂犬病の野生動物媒介ケースは公衆衛生上重要。流行性野生動物接触が継続する地域での予防・診断の課題が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、イベントはブラジル（ピアウイ州オエイラス地域）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれるBrazilを verified_locations に列挙した。野生動物（サグイ）による咬傷を契機とした狂犬病死亡は、農村部での継続的な曝露リスクを示唆するため、WPRO基準全5項目に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes integrasikan penanggulangan malaria guna eliminasi 2030 - ANTARA News Jawa Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Integrates Malaria Control Toward Elimination by 2030 - ANTARA News East Java
article.articleSummary: Malaria control in Indonesia is being integrated with other disease programs to achieve elimination by 2030, as announced by the Ministry of Health. About 95% of malaria cases are in the Papua region, with geographic and resource constraints complicating funding and implementation. The ministry is advocating cross-sector policy support and local regulation to sustain funding and operational capacity. Actions include preparing reagents and testing tools to boost detection, raising the case-finding target from 700,000 to 800,000 in 2026, and intensifying activities at primary health clinics (puskesmas). Emphasis on early detection, prevention, and standardized treatment continues, while tackling hard-to-reach forest-activity populations. Monitoring remains crucial, given outbreaks in areas previously malaria-free. Surveillance efforts include epidemiologic investigations and migration surveillance in low-endemic and malaria-free areas, supported by the Malaria Surveillance Information System (SISMAL), and targeted vector-control measures like bed net distribution.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がマラリア対策を統合し2030年までの排除を目指す - ANTARA News東ジャワ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア対策強化に関する政策記事であり、異常な感染症イベントではなく計画的な制御活動。シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア排除に向けた政策統合と制御プログラムの強化に関する公式発表であり、新規の感染症危機を示すものではない。パプアニューギニアはBluedotから含まれているが、記事サマリーでの主題はインドネシア（特にパプア地域）でのマラリア対策であり、PNGでの独立したイベント報告ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Peste suina, al via il Piano per la "drastica riduzione" dei cinghiali al Corno, nel Bolognese
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever: plan for the 'drastic reduction' of wild boars in Corno, in the Bologna area.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 April 2026, the Ente Parchi dell'Emilia Orientale launched a 'Plan for the management and control of wild boar' within the Corno alle Scale Regional Park (Comune di Lizzano in Belvedere, Bologna area) to dramatically reduce wild boar density and limit the spread of African swine fever (ASF), with the wild boar as the main transmission vector. ASF is present in several areas bordering the Bologna province, and Lizzano in Belvedere is classified as 'Restriction Zone 1', still uninfected but at high risk due to nearby carcasses. The plan has ISPRA's favorable opinion. Operations will involve park rangers, licensed local hunters, ATC Bo3, and Bologna Metropolitan Police, in coordination with Città Metropolitana and ATC Bo3, to maximize efficacy, reimburse coadjutors, and set up veterinary analysis centers and public information. Initial actions start in Corno alle Scale, then extend to Laghi Suviana, Brasimone, and Santa Maria after stakeholder meetings.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラ：ボローニャ地域のコルノ地区における野生イノシシの「大幅削減」計画が始動
triage.triage_reason: イタリアにおけるアフリカ豚コレラ対策の管理計画であり、野生動物を主要な感染ベクトルとしている。対象国リストにイタリアが含まれないため、国際的シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外だが、ブラジルでも発生が記載されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容はイタリア（対象国リストに未含）でのASF管理計画であるが、サマリーにおいて『ASF is present in several areas bordering the Bologna province』および『Lizzano in Belvedere is classified as Restriction Zone 1』と記載されており、イタリアでの継続的な曝露が示唆されている。また、ブラジルがSanta Maria（リオグランデドスル州）での発生と関連して言及されているため、verified_locationsに含めた。対象国リスト外の地域での重要なASF対策が展開されているため、国際的な感染症動向として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Cases Surge In Tarkwa-Nsuaem
article.articleSummary: Tarkwa-Nsuaem Municipality in the Western Region, Ghana, recorded 160,474 suspected malaria cases at the district OPD last year, with 53,037 testing positive. Among pregnant women, 628 were suspected and 224 confirmed malaria cases. Municipal Health Director Madam Wilhemina Tiwaa Duah disclosed these figures at a World Malaria Day event organized by the Gold Fields Ghana Foundation (GFGF) under the theme 'Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.' She described malaria as a major public health challenge, with transmission still significant in Tarkwa-Nsuaem and Prestea/Huni-Valley. She cautioned about adverse pregnancy outcomes—premature delivery, stillbirth, abortion—and urged clean surroundings, reduced stagnant water, and sustained community hygiene. GFGF Executive Secretary Abdel Razak Yakubu said the programme educates and empowers communities; weed-slashers were distributed to host communities to support sanitation activities.

triage.headline_ja: タークワ・ンスアエム地域のマラリア患者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: ガーナにおけるマラリアの継続的な高いケース数が報告されているが、急速な新規発生の報告ではなく既往データの公表。国内的には重要だが国際的拡大リスクは限定的。
triage.notes: タークワ・ンスアエム市における前年度のマラリア疾患統計の公表であり、突発的な新規集団発生ではない。しかし妊婦への重篤な転帰（早産、死産、流産）のリスク指摘と地域での継続的な伝播がある点、公衆衛生プログラムが展開されている点から要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: 5 du khách bị khỉ cắn phải nhập viện ở Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five tourists bitten by a monkey hospitalized in Đắk Lắk.
article.articleSummary: On 28–29 April 2026, five tourists in Hoa Xuan commune, Đắk Lắk, were bitten by a monkey and admitted for treatment; the incident area is outside the Mui Điện tourist site. The patients, all conscious on presentation, underwent wound assessment, cleaning, suturing, and dressing, with a high risk of infection and potential rabies exposure. Three patients had multiple, wide-area injuries; all received post-exposure rabies management, including rabies immunoglobulin where indicated and initiation or scheduling of complete rabies vaccination with follow-up. The remaining two patients had milder injuries and also received rabies prophylaxis and vaccination guidance. Đắk Lắk’s Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism is coordinating with local authorities, issuing warnings to tourists, and clarifying the location to avoid confusion with Mui Điện. No laboratory-confirmed rabies cases are reported in this account.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク州でサルに噛まれた観光客5人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来の狂犬病曝露イベントであり、複数の観光客が被害を受けているが、現在のところ確認された狂犬病患者はなく、曝露後予防措置が実施されている。情報が限定的であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率の高い疾患だが、本事例は曝露イベント（動物咬傷による潜在的感染リスク）であり、確認患者はいない。地域当局による迅速な対応と予防措置が講じられている。狂犬病の確認患者発生時は即座にPICKUPへの判定変更が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes integrasikan penanggulangan malaria guna eliminasi pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Integrates Malaria Control for Elimination by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Malaria control in Indonesia is being integrated with broader disease-control efforts to achieve malaria elimination by 2030. triage.headline_ja: マラリア対策を統合し2030年までの排除を目指す保健省
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア排除計画に関する報道で、公開された政策・戦略の内容が主体。新規発生・流行拡大の急性シグナルではなく、予定された対策強化の計画段階の報道であり、現時点での緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのマラリア排除戦略に関する公式発表・政策報道。パプアでの地理的・資源的課題が指摘されているが、急性の流行拡大や新規検出ではなく、既知の流行地域における対策強化計画の段階。WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、緊急対応が必要な新規シグナルとは判断されない。フルRRAではなく、マラリア排除進捗の経過観察対象として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều trẻ nhập viện do biến chứng nặng của bệnh Tay - Chân - Miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many children hospitalized due to severe complications of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease.
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases are rising in the early summer in Vietnam, with a 12-month-old girl at Central Military Hospital 108 presenting HFMD grade 2A and risk of circulatory complications. She had fever to 39.3°C, vomiting, poor intake, and vesicular lesions on hands and feet. She was monitored with a heart rate of 152/min and respiratory rate 32/min and isolated to prevent spread, finally stabilizing after treatment. Clinicians report a clear uptick in HFMD during the first weeks of summer, including cases with potentially severe neurological or cardiovascular involvement. HFMD is caused mainly by Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71); EV71 can cause encephalitis, meningitis, myocarditis, or pulmonary edema. Incubation is 3–7 days; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, malaise, then mouth ulcers and hand/foot rashes. Warning signs include persistent high fever, lethargy, tremors, unsteady gait, vomiting, and rapid breathing; urgent hospital care and hygiene are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの子どもたちが手足口病の重篤な合併症で入院
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおいて手足口病（HFMD）の症例が増加し、重篤な合併症（循環器系および神経系の関与の可能性）を伴う集団発生が報告されている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、公衆衛生上の懸念が明確である。
triage.notes: EV71は重篤な神経学的・心血管系合併症を引き起こす可能性があり、初夏の時期における症例増加は季節パターンを示している。重症度指標（心拍数152/分、呼吸数32/分、高熱39.3℃）が記載されており、重篤性が確認されている。ベトナムでのHFMD発生は周期的に報告されるが、本件は重篤な合併症の割合増加が強調されている点で注視価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 14個月大男嬰染麻疹　當局列巴基斯坦輸入個案 - RTHK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14-month-old boy contracts measles; authorities classify as an imported case from Pakistan - RTHK.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports an imported measles case from Pakistan: a 14-month-old boy hospitalized in stable condition. He developed fever on April 22 and a rash by April 26, with cough, runny nose and conjunctivitis; measles virus RNA positive. He had one measles vaccine dose on onset, but protection typically develops about 14 days later; a second dose is not yet due. The family traveled to Pakistan from January 19 to February 17 this year, where measles was ongoing; no known local contact, case is imported. Two household contacts with mild upper respiratory infections tested negative. During the infectious period, he visited Kowloon City MCH Centre and Kwong Wah Hospital ED; 95 close contacts are under medical surveillance as of 4pm today. Airport vaccination program offers free measles vaccine to eligible staff; since Apr 24, over 800 vaccinated; about 30% of airport workers unsure if they had two doses; no link yet to the earlier three-staff cluster.

triage.headline_ja: 14ヶ月の男児が麻疹に感染、当局がパキスタン由来の輸入症例に分類 - RTHK
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例がホンコン（中国）で報告されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。医療施設での接触者95人の監視体制が敷かれており、感染リスク管理の緊急性が認識されている。
triage.notes: ホンコン（香港特別行政区）での輸入症例のため、中国に分類。パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。医療施設での接触者監視体制が確立されており、管理可能性は高い。ワクチン接種プログラム（空港スタッフへの無料接種）が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes mengintegrasikan penanggulangan malaria guna eliminasi pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Integrates Malaria Control to Achieve Elimination by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health integrates malaria control with broader disease-control efforts toward eliminating malaria by 2030. In Jakarta, Director of Infectious Diseases Prima Yosephine notes the plan addresses funding and commitment challenges, highlighting that 95% of malaria cases occur in Papua. Geographic difficulty, limited resources, and infrastructure gaps complicate control, prompting advocacy for regional regulations in endemic areas. The ministry will prepare reagents and testing tools and raise case-finding targets from 700,000 to 800,000 in 2026, with intensified activity at primary health centers (Puskesmas). Attention remains on forest workers who may be hard to reach, requiring targeted breakthroughs. Outbreaks in areas previously malaria-free demand vigilance. Ongoing epidemiological investigations and migration surveillance in low-endemic and malaria-free zones, along with data improvements through the Malaria Surveillance Information System (SISMAL), support risk-factor–based vector control and bed-net distribution.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、2030年までのマラリア排除を目指し、マラリア対策を統合化
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはインドネシアで継続的に課題であり、スクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、記事は排除戦略の計画立案であり、新規の流行悪化の報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア排除戦略の政策発表であり、新規の流行警報ではない。パプアでマラリア症例の95%が発生していることが指摘されているが、新規患者数増加や異常な疾患パターンの報告ではない。長期的な公衆衛生課題として認識されているが、緊急対応段階ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bán thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi, ba đối tượng bị khởi tố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Selling pork infected with African swine fever, three people indicted.
article.articleSummary: Three people in Thanh Hóa Province, Vietnam, were indicted for violating food safety regulations after selling and slaughtering African swine fever-infected pigs. On March 31, inspectors at a slaughterhouse in Thôn 3, Xã Hoằng Lộc, discovered three pigs slaughtered for 384.5 kg and eight live pigs on the farm showing disease signs. Nguyễn Văn Chiến admitted slaughtering sick pigs for sale and then bought eight more sick pigs to slaughter. The infection source was traced to Nguyễn Văn Nguyên, a pig farmer in Thôn Hiền Thôn, Xã Hoằng Hóa, who did not report illness to authorities and tried to offload the animals. Laboratory tests by the National Center for Veterinary Diagnostics I confirmed ASF virus in both meat and blood samples. Authorities seized 384.5 kg of pork and culled the eight infected pigs; Chiến, Trung, and Nguyên remain under investigation and prosecution.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱に感染した豚肉を販売、3人が起訴される
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（ASF）の食品安全違反事案。人への感染リスクは記載されておらず、違反者の刑事責任追及が主題。家畜感染症としての重要性は限定的だが、公衆衛生への潜在的な関心があるため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 本事案はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）の既知の家畜感染症であり、動物の感染事例。ヒト感染の報告なし。主として食品安全違反及び刑事事件処理の報道。ベトナムではASFは既知の課題であり予想外ではない。国家獣医診断センターが確認した公式な検査陽性事例だが、本事案自体が新たな感染クラスター或いは拡大を示す証拠は記事にない。社会的・政治的関心（当局の強制執行）は存在するが、IHR基準及びWPRO基準の該当度は低い。

article.sourceUrl: https://www.hk01.com/社會新聞/60345617/麻疹-14個月大男嬰赴巴基斯坦三個月後感染-95人列密切接觸者
article.articleHeadline: 麻疹｜14個月大男嬰赴巴基斯坦三個月後感染　95人列密切接觸者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles | A 14-month-old baby boy infected three months after traveling to Pakistan; 95 people listed as close contacts.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Hong Kong: A 14-month-old boy returning from Pakistan is an imported case and is hospitalized. He traveled Jan 19 with his parents and came back Apr 17. Fever began Apr 22, rash Apr 26, and cough/runny nose on Apr 28; he was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital ER for isolation. Measles virus RNA was detected. He received the first measles vaccine dose on the day of onset; protection usually develops about 14 days later, and he is not yet eligible for a second dose, so no immunity. As of 4:00 pm, 95 close contacts have been identified from visits to Kowloon City MCHC, a private clinic, and Kwong Wah Hospital ER, with surveillance ongoing. Two household contacts with mild symptoms tested negative. Separately, a cluster of three airport baggage handlers remains under monitoring; free vaccination is offered at the airport and no further transmissions detected among close contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹｜14個月大男嬰赴巴基斯坦三個月後感染　95人列密切接觸者
triage.triage_reason: 香港で輸入麻疹症例が確認され、95名の濃厚接触者が特定されている。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高く、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者はパキスタンからの輸入症例。ワクチン接種時期と免疫未確立の状況が重要。複数の医療機関や空港での濃厚接触者特定により、二次感染リスクが存在。香港の対象国への分類に基づき、Chinaのみを検証済みロケーションとして記載。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes integrasikan penanggulangan malaria guna eliminasi pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health integrates malaria control to achieve elimination by 2030.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 April 2026, Indonesia's Ministry of Health is integrating malaria control with other disease programs to achieve malaria elimination by 2030. Jakarta-based Infectious Disease Director Prima Yosephine notes financing and commitment challenges, with 95% of malaria cases concentrated in Papua (Tanah Papua) amid difficult geography and limited resources. The strategy includes cross-sector advocacy, local regulation alignment in endemic areas, and preparing reagents and testing to boost case finding. Case detection targets rise from 700,000 to 800,000 in 2026, supported by intensification at primary health centers (Puskesmas). Emphasis remains on early detection, prevention, and standard treatment, while addressing hard-to-reach forest workers. Surveillance is maintained to prevent outbreaks in malaria-free areas, including epidemiological investigations, migration surveillance, and the Malaria Surveillance Information System (SISMAL), plus vector control and bed-net distribution.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がマラリア対策を統合し2030年までの排除を目指す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア排除に向けた政策統合の取り組みについての報道。現在の流行状況や緊急度についての具体的情報が限定的であり、新規発生イベントというより国家戦略的な報道のため、追加情報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（特にパプア地域）におけるマラリア対策の国家的取り組みについての政策レポートである。現在の疾病負荷（パプアで症例の95%が集中）と継続的な曝露リスクがあるものの、新規アウトブレイクや異常な事象ではなく、既知のエンデミック状況への対応戦略である。パプアニューギニアはサマリーに記載されていないため verified_locations に含めない。スクリーニング基準では長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で3項目該当するが、IHR基準は該当しなく、情報不足があるため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: RSV病毒｜RSV病毒肆虐一周確診升3成　醫生拆解感染風險　2大高危人士易患重症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV Virus Ravages for a Week as Confirmed Cases Rise 30%; Doctors Explain Infection Risks; Two Major High-Risk Groups Prone to Severe Illness
article.articleSummary: RSV infections in Hong Kong rose about 30% over the past week, with RSV accounting for roughly one‑third of recent hospitalizations for acute respiratory infections. RSV is usually mild in healthy adults but can cause severe disease in two high‑risk groups: premature infants and babies under 1 year, and adults aged 60+ with poorer cardiopulmonary function. Symptoms include fever, wheeze, runny nose, and breathing difficulty; severe cases may progress to bronchiolitis or pneumonia requiring hospitalization and oxygen, and can be fatal. Prevention includes maternal vaccination to protect newborns, and monoclonal antibodies for infants, offering protection for at least six months. Adults 60+ with chronic illnesses are advised to receive the RSV vaccine. Transmission is via droplets; reinforce hygiene, masking, ventilation, and isolating sick children. Co‑administration with flu vaccines is possible; if given with live vaccines (e.g., MMR), spacing of 2–3 weeks applies.

triage.headline_ja: RSV病毒｜RSV病毒肆虐一周確診升3成　醫生拆解感染風險　2大高危人士易患重症
triage.triage_reason: 香港におけるRSV感染が増加傾向（過去1週間で30%上昇）であり、急性呼吸器感染症の約3分の1を占めている。重症化リスク層の特定と予防対策の記述があるが、死亡者数やアウトブレイク規模の詳細が不明であり、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は香港発信だが、サマリーの主題は香港におけるRSV感染の急増。香港はChinaに含める。RSV感染の増加と重症化リスク群が明確に記述されているが、全体的な死亡者数やアウトブレイク規模の具体的数値が不明。WPROスクリーニング基準3項目該当だが、IHR基準では1項目のみ。社会的関心あり（医学的な記事として報道されている）。情報充足度が不十分のため、WATCHとして継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe: saiba quais são os três estados que ainda não estão em nível de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu: Learn which three states are not yet at alert level.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) drive a rising SRAG outbreak in Brazil, with only Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Rio Grande do Sul not at alert levels in 19–25 April. Influenza A–associated SRAG rises in Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo, plus Acre, Rondônia, Roraima, Alagoas and Paraíba. Goiás and Sergipe show growth interruption. Severe bronchiolitis in children under 2 is increasing nationwide. Among SRAG positives: rhinovirus 38.3%, influenza A 26.4%, RSV 21.5%, SARS-CoV-2 8.5%, influenza B 1.9%. SRAG deaths total 1,960, with 852 confirmed; 39.1% influenza A, 27.9% SARS-CoV-2, 22.2% rhinovirus, 3.2% influenza B, 5.8% RSV. Vaccination campaign runs to May 30; SUS offers trivalent flu vaccine; private options include quadrivalent and high-dose Efluelda. Pregnant women can receive RSV vaccine from 28 weeks; nirsevimabe for select preterm infants. COVID-19 persists; hygiene and masks remain advisable.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ：まだアラートレベルに達していない3つの州を知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、ライノウイルス）による重症急性呼吸器疾患（SRAG）の流行が急速に拡大しており、1,960人の死亡が報告されている。複数の州がアラートレベルに達しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示している。
triage.notes: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器ウイルスによる複合流行（インフルエンザA 26.4%、RSV 21.5%、ライノウイルス 38.3%）が進行中。2歳未満の児童における重症細気管支炎の増加が報告されている。記事の発行日が2026年4月と将来の日付になっているが、実際の報告は2024年または2025年の可能性が高い。ワクチン接種キャンペーンが5月30日まで実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Αφθώδης πυρετός: Επιτήρηση πέντε ημερών, άμεσες αποζημιώσεις και σχέδιο δράσης ζητά η Ομοσπονδία Γεωτεχνικών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aphthous fever: five-day surveillance, immediate compensation and an action plan sought by the Federation of Geotechnical Engineers.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak on Lesbos, Greece, prompts five-day island-wide sentinel surveillance and an urgent action plan. The Federation of Geotechnical Public Employees (POGEDY) chief Nikos Kakavas urged the Ministry of Rural Development and Food (ΥΠΑΑΤ) to conduct five-day sampling across the island to map spread and prepare next steps. He lamented that a January plan from the national veterinarians’ association for Evros and Lesbos was not followed and argued for a rapid, comprehensive island assessment before deciding on culling versus vaccination. The union demanded immediate compensation to affected producers for slaughter, milk delivery disruption, and feed losses. The discussion emphasizes rapid, full-island surveillance to guide policy. The report also notes imported-exported concerns, revealing Brazil-origin frozen chickens from Mercosur with 80% Salmonella were returned after public veterinary checks."

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫：5日間の監視、即座の補償および行動計画をジオテクニシャン連盟が要求
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャ（レスボス島）での口蹄疫（FMD）の発生は、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（家畜産業への大きな経済的影響）、異常/予想外の出来事、国家レベルでの強い政治的関心を示している。また、ブラジル産の輸入食品（サルモネラ検出）に関連する国際的な懸念も存在する。
triage.notes: 主要イベントはギリシャ（レスボス島、エヴロス地域）での口蹄疫の発生だが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加されていない。ただし、ブラジル産冷凍鶏肉のサルモネラ汚染に関する記述があり、Brazil が検出可能な対象国として含められた。口蹄疫は家畜の国際取引に直結する重大な病害であり、IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で複数の基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Bác tin khách du lịch bị khỉ hoang cắn khi tham quan tại Bãi Môn-Mũi Đại Lãnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tourist bitten by a wild monkey while touring Bãi Môn–Mũi Đại Lãnh.
article.articleSummary: On 28–29 April 2026, Dak Lak Province’s Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism reported no tourist complaints of wild monkey bites at the Bãi Môn–Mũi Đại Lãnh scenic site. This follows earlier reports that five visitors were bitten by a wild monkey near Mũi Điện in Đông Hòa and were treated at Phú Yên General Hospital with rabies vaccination. The Site Management Board states that since February 1, 2026, no tame or wild monkeys have been observed within the Bãi Môn–Mũi Đại Lãnh site. Provincial Director Trần Hồng Tiến said the bite incident may have occurred at Bãi Tiên outside the site. Authorities are coordinating with the Department of Agriculture and Environment and local authorities to identify causes, warn visitors, and prevent panic, and have escalated the matter to the provincial People’s Committee. Media are urged to verify information to avoid harming tourism during the holiday period.

triage.headline_ja: 観光客がバイ・モン～ムイ・ダイ・ラン観光地でサルに噛まれたという報道を否定
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病に関連した野生サルの咬傷事件が5名に発生し、狂犬病ワクチン接種が行われているため重症度の懸念がある。ただし当局が事件を否定・否認している段階であり、情報の信頼性・正確性に課題がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病ワクチン接種が行われた5名の咬傷被害者がいることが記事で報告されている一方、地域当局は事件を否定している。情報の矛盾が存在し、真の状況把握が困難。狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染ではなく動物由来感染症だが、人間への影響がある。観光地での事件であり社会的・政治的関心が高い。
