article.articleHeadline: Vigilância sanitária comprova ausência de Influenza Aviária e Newcastle no Tocantins | Agrimidia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sanitary surveillance confirms absence of avian influenza and Newcastle disease in Tocantins | Agrimidia
article.articleSummary: Tocantins, Brazil, reports no circulation of Avian influenza and Newcastle disease after sanitary surveillance by Adapec. Part of the 2025/2026 Plan, the program aims to confirm absence of these viruses in local poultry. Initiated in November 2025 and expected to conclude in June 2026, it monitors 28 properties (16 commercial farms, 12 subsistence holdings) and analyzes 308 birds. Samples include blood and tracheal and cloacal swabs to detect prior exposure and active infection. The seroepidemiological study covers industrial poultry and high-risk areas, especially where migratory birds are present. To date, all lab analyses are negative for the H5N1 virus, indicating no viral circulation in evaluated flocks. Findings reinforce the effectiveness of surveillance, support continued sanitary status, and help prevent trade restrictions, preserving Tocantins’ competitiveness in national and international markets.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生監視がトカンチンス州における鳥インフルエンザおよびニューカッスル病の不在を確認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、ブラジル・トカンチンス州における鳥インフルエンザおよびニューカッスル病の「不在確認」を報告するネガティブサーベイランス結果である。現在の発病や流行の兆候がなく、感染症危機管理の対象とならない。
triage.notes: 本事例はサーベイランス陰性報告であり、アクティブな感染症イベントではない。動物衛生管理の文脈での定期的な監視プログラムの一環であり、シグナル検知対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 廣東基孔肯雅熱捲土重來 擴散風險超往年 | 运动式防疫 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong Zika fever makes a comeback; risk of spread higher than in previous years | Movement-style Epidemic Prevention | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever makes a comeback in Guangdong, China, with higher transmission risk this year. By April 19, 2026, Guangdong reported 3 chikungunya cases, including 1 locally acquired. Dengue cases totaled 69: 63 imported from abroad, 2 from other provinces, and 4 locally acquired. Hong Kong also reported 2 imported chikungunya cases. Although detections are limited to Guangdong and Hong Kong so far, climate, borders, and trade raise transmission risk beyond areas. Official experts say domestic spread is likely this year. In 2024, virus emerged in Foshan and spread to 12 cities; by end-2025, Guangdong’s cumulative chikungunya cases exceeded 25,000. Past measures emphasized sweeping mosquito-control and restrictive controls, sparking discontent and memories of COVID-era policies. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, joint and muscle pain, headache, fatigue, and rash, typically resolving in 1–2 weeks; infants, the elderly, or those with chronic disease may develop severe complications or die.

triage.headline_ja: 広東のチクングニア熱が再来、拡散リスクは過去年より高い | 運動式感染症対策 | 大紀元
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とデング熱の同時発生、地域的な局所感染の確認、および気候・国境・貿易による国際的拡大リスクが明示されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは見出しではZika熱と誤記されているがChikungunya(チクングニア熱)が主な疾患。複数疾患同時発生：チクングニア3例（局所感染1例を含む）、デング69例（輸入感染63例、他省2例、局所感染4例）。2024年のフォーシャンでの初出現から2025年末までに広東全域で25,000例超の累積患者。蚊媒介感染症としての拡散リスク、高い伝播適性、過去の広域拡散実績を踏まえ、国際的な懸念が高い。香港での輸入症例確認により地域的な国際波及の可能性も示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusão competitiva ganha espaço no controle de Salmonella na avicultura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Competitive Exclusion Gains Ground in Salmonella Control in Poultry Farming.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella control in poultry is advancing earlier in life via competitive exclusion, as described by Vet Viviane Silveira Rizello (UFPR) at the March 19 Facta Seminar in Toledo, Paraná, Brazil. Early-life gut microbiota development is critical; with low diversity, small Salmonella amounts can colonize and cause infection. Modern hatcheries’ sterile environments and reduced maternal contact heighten exposure to pathogens. Competitive exclusion employs a diverse, mature consortium of beneficial bacteria to outcompete Salmonella through nutrient competition, adhesion-site occupation, metabolite production, intestinal pH modulation, and immune stimulation, thereby reducing colonization. Timing is essential: apply soon after hatch to exploit the window before microbiota is established. Field data show progressive reductions in Salmonella positivity in flocks adopting the approach, with more aviaries testing negative over production cycles. The strategy complements, not replaces, core biosecurity and husbandry practices within an integrated control program.

triage.headline_ja: 家禽飼育におけるサルモネラ制御で競争的排除が広がりを見せる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの家禽産業におけるサルモネラ制御技術（競争的排除）に関する学術セミナー報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。動物衛生技術に関する情報発信であり、公衆衛生上の危機的状況は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の診断確定症例の報告やアウトブレイク事象ではなく、家禽産業における予防技術（競争的排除法によるサルモネラ制御）に関する学術情報である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。記事サマリーに「患者」「症例」「確認患者」等の人的影響の記述がなく、純粋に動物飼育技術の紹介であることから、対象国リストに含まれるブラジルであっても verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố vụ án giết mổ, tiêu thụ heo nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indictment in the case of slaughtering and consuming pigs infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Vietnamese authorities have indicted a case involving the slaughtering and consumption of pigs infected with African swine fever (ASF). The defendants are identified as having used diseased animals to slaughter, process, and place them on the market, thereby posing a serious threat to public health. The indictment centers on ASF-infected pigs and highlights illegal slaughter and sale to consumers. No outbreak totals or fatalities are provided in the report. The development follows ongoing enforcement against the handling of animals diseased with ASF in Vietnam. The information was published on 30 April 2026 at 18:37 local time by Sai Gon Giai Phong, with source credit to Dương Quang.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアで豚熱(アフリカ豚熱)に感染した豚の屠殺・消費事件で起訴
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は既知の動物感染症であるが、本事件は違法屠殺・販売という刑事事件が焦点であり、流行状況やヒト感染リスクの情報が不足している。ベトナムでの継続的な取り締まり活動は注視に値する。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病として重要だが、本記事は刑事事件（違法な屠殺・販売）が主題であり、新たな流行やヒト感染への直接的なリスクについては情報がない。ベトナムでのASF対策の継続的な執行状況を示唆しているため、経過観察の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de dengue: criança de 5 anos e dois adultos são internados em estado grave em Teresina - Portal É Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak: a 5-year-old child and two adults are admitted in critical condition in Teresina - Portal É Notícias
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Simplício Mendes, Piauí, Brazil, has surpassed 400 notified cases with about 40 laboratory-confirmed. Three locals were hospitalized in Teresina in critical condition: a 5-year-old child and two adults aged 25 and 34; two remain in intensive care and one in the Yellow Ward. Two patients are treated in private hospitals, while the third is at the Instituto de Doenças Tropicais Natan Portella. All showed marked thrombocytopenia, with lab confirmation pending at Lacen. The surge, ongoing since March, is linked to February–March water-supply disruptions that led residents to store water in containers, fostering Aedes aegypti breeding. Response includes mass cleanup campaigns, waste collection, household visits, area lockdowns near suspected cases, insecticide use, and fogging via fumigation trucks. Sesapi reports expanded vector-control supplies, rapid tests, and dengue vaccines for ages 10–14 across 224 municipalities, plus guidance to risk areas; residents urged to eliminate breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の集団発生：テレジーナで5歳児と成人2名が重篤な状態で入院 - Portal É Notícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州でデング熱の集団発生が400件以上報告され、3名が重篤な状態で集中治療中。IHR基準（異常性・重症度）2項目以上該当し、公衆衛生への影響が顕著である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはシンプリシオ・メンデス市（ピアウイ州）でのデング熱集団発生を主題としており、ブラジルでの発生であることが明確。SFTS Virusが疾患リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではデング熱のみが言及されている。水供給中断によるAedes aegypti繁殖の増加が背景因子となっており、長期的な曝露リスクあり。公式な対応体制（ワクチン接種、ベクター制御、住民教育）が既に展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Thanh Hoá: Khởi tố đối tượng giết mổ, tiêu thụ lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thanh Hóa Province: An individual charged with slaughtering and consuming pigs infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: On 30 April 2026, Thanh Hoa Province Police announced criminal charges against three individuals—Nguyen Van Chien (1984), Le Van Trung (1982), and Nguyen Khac Nguyen (1966)—for violating food safety regulations after slaughtering and selling pigs infected with African swine fever (ASF). On 31 March 2026, authorities inspecting a pig slaughter facility in Hamlet 3, Hoang Loc Commune found 3 slaughtered pigs totaling 384.5 kg and eight live pigs showing disease signs. Chien admitted ordering slaughter despite illness to market the meat, and later bought eight more diseased pigs for slaughter. Trung had knowingly purchased diseased pigs from Nguyen, a breeder in Hoang Hoa, who, upon noticing illness, did not report it and attempted to dispose of the animals. Laboratory testing confirmed ASF virus in meat and blood samples. Authorities seized 384.5 kg of pork and destroyed the eight infected pigs; the case remains under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省：アフリカ豚コレラ感染豚を殺処分・販売した人物が起訴される
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラの感染豚の不正販売という異常なイベントであり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当するが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクの詳細情報が不足しており、社会的関心も限定的と判断されるため。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラ感染豚の不正販売・消費という食品安全違反の刑事事件として報道されている。病原体の人への感染リスク、流行への拡大可能性については記事に明記されていないため評価困難。当局による迅速な対応（押収・殺処分）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Morte por raiva humana é confirmada no Piauí; vítima tinha 17 anos - Portal É Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death from human rabies is confirmed in Piauí; the victim was 17 years old.
article.articleSummary: Seventeen-year-old resident of rural Oeiras, Piauí, Brazil, died from human rabies on April 17 after admission on April 11 to Teresina’s Instituto de Doenças Tropais Natan Portella. He had been bitten by a squirrel monkey about 40 days before symptom onset, which included disorientation, projectile vomiting, and persistent fever. Diagnostic samples were sent to Instituto Pasteur, Rio de Janeiro, and confirmed rabies via laboratory testing. The State Health Secretariat (Sesapi) and Oeiras authorities activated surveillance and control measures. Public guidance emphasizes washing the wound with soap and running water, seeking prompt medical care, not capturing the animal, and maintaining vaccination of dogs and cats. The last human rabies case in Piauí before this was in 2024 (Piripiri); no ongoing outbreak is reported beyond this solitary case.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州で人間狂犬病による死亡が確認、被害者は17歳
triage.triage_reason: 単発の致死的狂犬病事例であり重症度は高いが、局所的で限定的な公衆衛生影響である。国際的拡大リスクは低く、IHR基準2項目以上の該当が確認できないため、情報追蹤が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。単発事例であり流行兆候はなく、ブラジル当局が適切に対応済み。狂犬病は動物咬傷後の予防可能な疾患であるが、発症後の死亡率は極めて高い。続報でPiauí州またはRio de Janeiroでの追加事例が報告される場合は段階的に評価を上げる必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Com a mesma incidência de SP, MS descarta decretar epidemia de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With the same incidence as São Paulo, Mato Grosso do Sul rules out declaring a chikungunya epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, registered 304.4 chikungunya cases per 100,000 inhabitants on April 29, 2026, per Ministry of Health arbovirus surveillance, indicating high transmission. Aedes aegypti is the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Despite the elevated incidence, the state will not declare an epidemic or sanitary emergency at this time, unlike São Paulo, which reached 300 dengue cases per 100,000 and declared emergency. An epidemic definition relies on multiple factors beyond incidence, including sustained increases versus historical baselines, geographic dispersion among municipalities, confirmed viral circulation, and health-service impact. Mato Grosso do Sul continues intensified surveillance, vector-control, laboratory diagnosis, and network organization, with targeted support to municipalities with higher incidence, guided by national and World Health Organization guidelines. Formal state-level epidemic classification awaits broader technical analysis.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロと同じ発生率で、マトグロッソドスル州はチクングニア流行宣言を見送り
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでZika、Chikungunya、Dengueの同時流行が報告され、高い伝播指標（人口10万人当たり304.4件）が確認されているが、州当局が流行宣言を見送っており、現時点では管理可能な状況と判断されている。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはサンパウロ州の位置情報が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はマトグロッソドスル州（MS）の状況であり、対象国リストにはBrazilのみ該当。複数のアルボウイルス（Dengue、Zika、Chikungunya）が同時に流行している点が注目されるが、当該州の当局が流行宣言を見送っている点から、現時点では統制された対応がなされていると判断される。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（serious_impact）だが、WPROスクリーニング基準で3つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）しており、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Reveals Pakistan Is Now the World's Largest Hepatitis C Hub
article.articleSummary: Pakistan is identified by the WHO Global Hepatitis Report 2026 as the world’s largest hub for hepatitis C infections and the single biggest contributor to the global population living with HCV, also among the 10 countries with the highest hepatitis C–related deaths. Along with India and China, Pakistan, India, and China together account for about 39% of the global hepatitis C burden; Pakistan is among the nations responsible for 58% of hepatitis C–related deaths in 2024. Major transmission drivers in Pakistan include unsafe injections administered by unqualified practitioners and the use of banned reusable or counterfeit syringes, with gaps in diagnosis and treatment limiting access to testing and short-course antiviral therapy. Experts urge mass screening, affordable treatment, strict enforcement against unsafe syringes, stronger blood safety, and decisive action against unqualified practitioners to curb new infections and reduce the national burden.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがパキスタンを世界最大のC型肝炎ハブと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高い罹患率、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。パキスタンにおける世界規模での顕著なC型肝炎負担が報告され、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではパキスタンが世界最大のハブとして主題だが、インドと中国が対象国として該当。安全でない注射器使用と不適格な医療従事者による感染伝播が主な課題。WHO Global Hepatitis Report 2026に基づく報告。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry applies TOKEN strategy to curb malaria in Papua
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Ministry launched the Find, Treat, Control (TOKEN) strategy to curb malaria in Papua, where 95% of the nation's malaria cases are found. To accelerate elimination of malaria, AIDS, tuberculosis, and leprosy, authorities aim to increase case detection from 700,000 to 800,000 this year through intensified passive case detection at community health centers. The plan expands community involvement, entrusting screening and medication distribution to local cadres, and creates village malaria teams with supporting village regulations and targeted training. For hard-to-reach areas, screening and treatment will be delegated to trained cadres. A forest intervention package targets the 20% of cases among migrant groups, including mass treatment, malaria prevention packages, and routine screening for people entering forests or remote areas. Challenges cited include program funding, low detection/testing, and geography. Globally, about 282 million malaria cases exist; Western Pacific ~2.4 million, with Indonesia second only to Papua New Guinea.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がパプアのマラリア抑制のためTOKEN戦略を適用
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア対策が公開されたもので、スクリーニング基準で「流行しやすさ」「重症度」「管理可能性」に該当し、地域的に対象国（インドネシア）で確認されるイベント。政府の公式戦略発表として社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア（パプア州）でのマラリア対策戦略の発表に焦点を当てており、パプアニューギニアは比較統計として言及されているのみ。Bluedotの発生地域にPapua New Guineaが含まれているが、実際のイベント発生地はインドネシアであるため、verified_locationsにはインドネシアのみを含める。マラリア、結核、ハンセン病、エイズの4疾患が対象だが、主にマラリア対策が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Hanya Anak-Anak, Ini 3 Alasan Orang Dewasa Bisa Kena Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only children, here are 3 reasons adults can catch measles.
article.articleSummary: Eight percent of measles cases in Indonesia occur among adults, according to the Ministry of Health. Dr. Erpryta Nurdia Tetrasiwi, an internist, notes adults lacking immunity remain at risk. Three factors keep adults susceptible: (1) waning antibodies from childhood vaccination as age increases; (2) incomplete measles vaccination, with older schedules often giving only one dose; newer guidance shows two-dose MMR achieving about 97% protection; (3) measles is highly contagious, with the virus detectable in the air for up to two hours after an infectious person leaves a room, spreading through droplets and airborne routes, elevating transmission in workplaces and public transport without immunity. The remarks were shared at Eka Hospital MT Haryono Jakarta on 30 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもだけではない、大人が麻しんに感染する3つの理由
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの麻しん患者（成人患者が8%）についての記事だが、新たな集団発生の報告ではなく、医療専門家による啓発情報。具体的な新規患者数、発生規模、国際拡大リスクが不明。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア保健省のデータに基づく医療啓発記事であり、新規の集団発生報告ではない。麻しんは高感染性疾患（WPROスクリーニング基準：流行しやすさに該当）だが、現在の流行状況、患者数規模、管理状況が不明確であるため、経過観察段階の判定とした。情報更新時に具体的な患者数増加や地域拡大が報告される場合は見直しが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Khách tham quan Mũi Điện nhập viện vì bị khỉ cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visitors to Mui Dien Cape admitted to hospital after being bitten by a monkey.
article.articleSummary: Five people aged 9–42 were admitted to Phu Yen General Hospital (Dak Lak) after monkey bites at Mui Dien Cape on 28–29 April. Three patients sustained severe multi-site wounds with high risk of infection and rabies exposure; two had milder injuries. Wound care included cleansing, suturing, and administration of rabies immunoglobulin, with appropriate anti-rabies treatment. The other two were evaluated and advised on rabies vaccination. All five patients are stable with no deterioration. Health authorities warn visitors to Mui Dien Cape, a natural-ecology area hosting wild monkeys, to maintain distance, avoid feeding, and not provoke wildlife. If bitten or scratched: immediately wash the wound with running water and soap for at least 15 minutes, disinfect with 70% alcohol or iodine, and seek prompt medical care for vaccine and rabies immunoglobulin. Do not rely on home remedies; rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ムイ・ディエン岬訪問者が猿に咬まれて入院
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は高い致命率を持つ重篤疾患だが、今回は5名の患者で全員安定しており、現時点での公式な患者数は限定的。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、野生動物由来の感染症として継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は5名の患者が猿に咬まれたことを報告。全員が適切な医療ケア（狂犬病免疫グロブリン、ワクチン接種）を受けており、現在全員安定している。ムイ・ディエン岬は野生猿が生息する自然保護地域であり、継続的な曝露リスクが存在する。狂犬病の致命率の高さから重症度基準を満たすが、現在の患者数が限定的かつ制御されているため、IHR基準の2項目以上を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Explainer - Region battles to contain new deadly strain of foot-and-mouth disease SAT1
article.articleSummary: SAT-1, the Southern African Territories strain of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), is highly transmissible among cattle, sheep, goats and other cloven-hoofed animals and causes fever with blister-like lesions on the tongue, lips, mouth, teats and between hooves; mortality in young animals exceeds 50%. Not a human health risk. The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) notes some vaccines are ineffective against SAT1. As of 2026-04-30, SAT1 outbreaks have been confirmed in 25 countries, including Botswana, South Africa, Zambia, Zimbabwe, and Algeria, plus China, Cambodia, Comoros, Côte d'Ivoire, Cyprus, Eritrea, Eswatini, Greece, Guinea, Indonesia, Israel, North Korea, South Korea, Lebanon, Lesotho, Malaysia, Mongolia, Mozambique and Palestine. Transmission occurs via aerosols and secretions; the virus is shed in milk and semen up to four days before clinical signs, and spread is aided by contaminated equipment, feed, meat products, and animal movements. Economic impact is severe, with EU beef imports suspended from Botswana and the Botswana Meat Commission stock valued around P2 million, while outbreaks in Botswana span at least 10 locations; Zambia, Zimbabwe and South Africa are also affected. Authorities slaughter and disinfect affected areas and maintain vigilance; some vaccines remain ineffective, underscoring the need for containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: 地域が新しい致命的な口蹄疫株の封じ込めに奮闘 - SAT1
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1株は高い伝染性を示し、25カ国以上で確認されており、国際的な拡大リスクが明確。動物衛生危機として公衆衛生および経済影響が深刻であり、ワクチン無効性による管理困難性が認められる。対象国（ザンビア、中国、インドネシア）での確認により、WPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは25カ国以上のSAT1確認を記載。対象国リストから確認された国はザンビア、中国、インドネシア。他の対象国（ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、フィリピン、タイ、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）については記事に明示的な言及なし。動物疾患だが国際貿易・移動制限リスク、経済的影響（EU輸入停止、畜産産業被害）が顕著。ワクチン無効性による管理困難性が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Repellent Market to Expand at 8.11% CAGR Reaching USD 7.23 Billion by 2031, Fueled by Rising Vector-Borne Diseases and Climate-Linked Mosquito Expansion: Mordor Intelligence - Business Upturn
article.articleSummary: Global mosquito repellent market projected to grow from USD 4.88B in 2026 to USD 7.23B by 2031 (8.11% CAGR). Asia-Pacific accounts for over half of demand, driven by high disease prevalence and climate-driven vector expansion; dengue reached 14.6M cases in 2024 and malaria affects about 246M people annually, with vectors expanding into temperate regions and creating year-round risk. Product mix remains sprays and aerosols, while vaporizers gain traction in endemic regions; demand for natural, DEET-free formulations rises in North America and Europe. Innovations include controlled-release polymers, spatial protection devices, wearables, and treated clothing. Government public-health initiatives and public-private partnerships support large-scale repellent deployment, aided by year-round e-commerce and consumer awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊忌避剤市場、2031年までにUSD 7.23 Billionに到達、年平均成長率8.11%で拡大—ベクター媒介感染症の増加と気候変動に伴う蚊の拡大が牽引役：Mordor Intelligence
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は蚊忌避剤市場の商業レポートであり、感染症イベント（確定例、アウトブレイク、流行）そのものを報告するものではない。統計的背景情報のみを提供し、個別の疾患イベントの発生や管理に関する実行可能な公衆衛生情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 本記事はBluedotによって感染症関連キーワード（dengue、malaria、mosquito repellent）により検出されたが、実質は市場分析レポートである。アジア太平洋地域の需要言及とChina への言及がサマリーに含まれるため verified_locations に China を含めるが、実際のイベント報告ではなく商業予測であるため公衆衛生上のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesch verzeichnet mehr als 220 Todesfälle durch Masern seit März - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangladesh records more than 220 measles deaths since March - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh is confronting one of its worst measles outbreaks in decades, with more than 220 child deaths and about 35,000 infections since March. Latest government figures cited yesterday put the death toll at 227 and infections near 35,000. The Kurukpata region, on the Myanmar border and home to many Indigenous residents, is the most affected. In rural areas like Kurukpata, vaccination coverage is often low, leaving children particularly vulnerable. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease that can cause severe complications and death; while it can affect all ages, it is most common in children. The report underscores gaps in vaccination driving the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュが3月以降200人以上の麻疹死亡者を記録 - ドイツ医学雑誌
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。227人の死亡と約35,000人の感染という数字から、バングラデシュ国内で進行中の大規模麻疹流行を示唆。ワクチン接種率の低さが継続的な拡大を招く可能性あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバングラデシュの麻疹流行を主題としており、Bluedot APIが示した「Union of Burma」と「Bangladesh」のうち、実際の発生地はバングラデシュのみ。ミャンマー国境のクルクパタ地域が最も被害を受けているが、地理的隣接関係は記載されており、イベント発生地はバングラデシュ。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。ただし、地域検証ルール再評価により、フィリピンを対象国として含める根拠が記事サマリーに見当たらないため、再度確認が必要。正確には対象国外のイベントのため、verified_locationsは[] が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 蜱虫进入活跃期！专家提醒："五一"出游谨防蜱虫叮咬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ticks Enter Their Active Period! Experts Warn: Beware of Tick Bites During May Day Outings.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-30, ticks enter their active period in Jiangsu, China, making May Day outings a tick-bite risk. Jiangsu CDC cautions ticks thrive in hill forest, grassy areas, tea gardens, and waterfront edges where outdoor activities occur. Ticks are arachnids; larvae have six legs, nymphs and adults eight. Unfed ticks resemble sesame seeds; engorged they can reach soybean size. They can transmit Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), Lyme disease, and babesiosis; SFTS may also spread via contact with fluids from severely ill or deceased patients. Prevention includes avoiding high-risk zones, wearing long sleeves and pants, tucking pant legs into socks, and using repellents containing DEET, permethrin, or other ingredients; protect pets as well. Post-trip checks and showers are advised; if a tick attaches, remove with fine-tipped tweezers close to the skin, rinse the bite and apply iodine, and monitor for two weeks, seeking care and informing doctors of exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 蜱虫進入活躍期！専門家が警告：「ゴールデンウイーク」外出時はダニ刺咬に注意
triage.triage_reason: 複数の媒介感染症（SFTS、ライム病、バベシア症）に関する季節的な啓発記事。具体的な患者報告や流行の報告ではなく、予防啓発が主体であるため、現時点では確定的なシグナルではないが、SFTS等の重要感染症を扱うため継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は江蘇省における季節的ダニ媒介感染症（SFTS、ライム病、バベシア症）の啓発記事。新規患者報告や流行警報ではなく、予防情報が主体。SFTS は重要感染症だが、現記事からは具体的な患者数や異常な増加傾向は不明。継続的なサーベイランス情報の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Serba-Serbi Penyakit Malaria: Penyebab, Gejala, dan Cara Mencegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All About Malaria: Causes, Symptoms, and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites, remains a communicable threat in Indonesia, especially in eastern regions. Transmission occurs when female Anopheles mosquitoes bite an infected person, delivering parasites to red blood cells. Early symptoms include fever, chills, headache, muscle pain, and sweating. High-risk groups are residents or travelers in endemic areas, those near stagnant water, and individuals with open-ventilation homes or outdoor nighttime activities. Anopheles larvae thrive in calm or standing water—rice fields, ditches, abandoned ponds, or puddles around communities. Prevention hinges on community action: eliminate standing water, ensure proper drainage, use bed nets, apply repellents, install window screens, and consider larvivorous fish or repellent plants like lemongrass and lavender. Malaria can be fatal if untreated; Indonesia targets malaria-free status by 2030, dependent on public awareness and vector-control measures. As of 30 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアについて：原因、症状、予防方法
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリアに関する一般的な啓発・教育記事であり、新規発生、異常な増加、または緊急的な公衆衛生危機を示す具体的なイベント情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアの一般的な情報（原因、症状、予防方法）を扱う啓発記事であり、新規クラスタ発生やアウトブレイク状況の報告ではない。インドネシアが2030年までにマラリア排除を目標としていることが言及されているが、これは既知の長期政策目標であり、新規の危機シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 14‑month‑old boy diagnosed with imported measles case
article.articleSummary: Imported measles case in a 14‑month‑old boy hospitalised in Hong Kong after travel to Pakistan, where outbreaks are ongoing. Fever began 22 April; rash on 26 April. Admitted 28 April with cough, runny nose and conjunctivitis; laboratory confirmation of measles; patient in stable condition in isolation. Travel spanned 19 January–17 April; no local source identified. First vaccine dose given 22 April; immunity not yet developed and second dose not yet due. Infectious period 22–30 April; he visited Kowloon City MCH Centre, a private clinic and Kwong Wah Hospital. Ninety‑five close contacts identified and under medical surveillance; no secondary transmission linked to a previous airport staff cluster. Public health actions include a free measles vaccination booth at HK International Airport from 24 April; >800 staff vaccinated; ~30% of airport employees uncertain about completing two doses. Incubation 7–21 days; symptoms include fever, rash, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis.

triage.headline_ja: 14ヶ月の男児がパキスタン渡航後の輸入麻疹症例と診断
triage.triage_reason: パキスタンからの輸入麻疹症例で、進行中のアウトブレイク地域からの感染確認。感染期間中に複数の医療施設と国際空港職員への曝露があり、二次感染リスク有。国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生対応の必要性からIHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。
triage.notes: パキスタンからの輸入症例だが、実際の感染発生地はパキスタンであり、香港での症例は輸入症例。記事の主題は香港での輸入麻疹症例と公衆衛生対応のため、verified_locationsはChina(香港)のみ。95名の濃厚接触者が医療監視下にあり、空港職員への曝露の可能性から、今後の二次感染リスク監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: پاکستان : ہیپاٹائٹس سی کے کیسز میں اضافہ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pakistan: Increase in Hepatitis C cases.
article.articleSummary: Pakistan reports a rise in Hepatitis C cases, prompting concern. WHO data show that Pakistan, along with India and China, accounts for 39% of the Hepatitis C burden. The report notes that Pakistan is among 10 countries where 58% of Hepatitis B and C deaths are reported, and that the country has the highest number of Hepatitis C patients worldwide. In 2024, worldwide Hep B and C caused about 1.34 million deaths and 1.8 million new infections. Only about 20% of Hepatitis C patients have access to treatment, while less than 5% of Hepatitis B patients receive treatment. Major drivers include unsafe medical practices, contaminated syringes, and reuse of injections; concerns about fake auto-disable syringes in Pakistan create a false safety impression. Hepatitis B vaccine provides over 95% protection; effective Hepatitis C treatment is achievable in 8–12 weeks. Experts warn current measures are inadequate to meet 2030 elimination targets.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタン：C型肝炎症例の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響と国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・管理可能性で該当。対象国インドが記事で言及されており、検証済み地域に含まれる。
triage.notes: 記事は主にパキスタンのC型肝炎危機を報道していますが、対象国リストではパキスタンは含まれていません。記事でインドは統計比較の文脈で言及されており（パキスタン、インド、中国が世界的C型肝炎負担の39%を占める）、インドは対象国であるため verified_locations に含めました。中国も言及されていますが、地域検証の原則に従い、主題の事象が実際に発生している対象国のみを記載しています。治療へのアクセス率の低さ（C型肝炎20%、B型肝炎5%未満）と2030年消滅目標達成への懸念が社会的・政治的関心を示唆しています。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya: se reportan 272 nuevos casos en Argentina y alertan sobre dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: 272 new cases reported in Argentina and a dengue alert.
article.articleSummary: During week 15 of 2026 in Argentina, at least 272 new chikungunya cases were reported, bringing the total confirmed and probable to 1,109 (1,003 autochthonous; 106 with travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Cuba). Data from the Boletín Epidemiológico Nacional indicate the rise reflects both real transmission increases and improved detection. For dengue, 4 new cases in week 15, located in Buenos Aires Province (PBA), City of Buenos Aires (CABA), and Salta. Since the season start, 50 confirmed dengue cases: 54% autochthonous and 46% travel-associated to Brazil and Colombia. Although overall risk remains low, several provinces—PBA, Córdoba, CABA, Tucumán, and Santa Fe—report increasing probable dengue cases, prompting health authorities to intensify surveillance, complete laboratory testing, and obtain second samples for confirmation. Circulation of respiratory viruses remains stable and seasonally expected; influenza, bronchiolitis, and pneumonia notifications are below levels seen in the previous four years.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア：アルゼンチンで272の新規症例が報告されデング警戒が発令
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介ウイルス（チクングニア、デング、インフルエンザ）の同時流行を報告しており、WPROスクリーニング基準の異常性・流行性が該当するが、情報不足と対象国（ブラジル）への限定的な関連性のため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はアルゼンチンが主体であるが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。記事ではボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバとの渡航関連症例が報告されており、ブラジル（対象国）との関連が明記されているため includeした。アルゼンチンはWHO PAHO地域だが、WPRO対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めない。チクングニアとデングの同時流行動向および複数州での検査強化体制は注視に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Morre bebê de 6 meses após diagnóstico de meningite em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6-month-old baby dies after meningitis diagnosis in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Six-month-old infant from Papanduva in Santa Catarina’s Planalto Norte died this week after bacterial meningitis. The patient had received only one dose of meningitis vaccine, with the second dose delayed; he was transferred to Joinville, where he died on 28 April 2026. Papanduva’s Municipal Health Secretariat says this is an isolated case and that measures are in place to protect the population. Meningitis is inflammation of the brain and spinal cord membranes and can be caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites; bacterial meningitis progresses rapidly. In meningococcal disease, bacteria in the blood can cause hemorrhagic skin spots; symptoms in infants include high fever, hypoactivity, drowsiness or irritability, and poor feeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with respiratory secretions. Vaccination through Brazil’s SUS is the primary preventive measure, and BCG at birth protects against severe tuberculous meningitis. Adolescents and young adults are common asymptomatic carriers of meningococcus.

triage.headline_ja: 聖カタリーナ州で髄膜炎と診断された生後6ヶ月の乳児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの単一事例報告であり、現地保健当局は「孤立した事例」と評価。死亡という重症度は認められるが、国際的拡大の兆候、異常性、管理性の欠陥が明確でなく、情報不足のため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 単一事例の死亡報告。現地保健当局は状況下での対策が実施されており、対応可能と判断している。ただしワクチン接種状況（1回のみ完了）や感染経路の詳細が不明であるため、引き続き類似事例の発生および集団発生の有無を監視する必要がある。WPRO基準では重症度と流行しやすさで複数該当の可能性があるが、当該情報源は南米であり、地域スクリーニング基準の適用はWPRO外である点を考慮。

article.articleHeadline: 广东基孔肯雅热卷土重来 扩散风险超往年
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever resurges in Guangdong; the risk of spread is higher than in previous years.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province reports a resurgence of chikungunya fever, with higher local transmission risk this year. As of 19 April 2026, Guangdong records 3 chikungunya cases (1 locally acquired). Dengue fever cases total 69 in Guangdong: 63 imported from abroad, 2 imported from other provinces, and 4 locally acquired. Hong Kong reports 2 imported chikungunya cases. Although new chikungunya detections are limited to Guangdong and Hong Kong, climate, border proximity and trade raise regional spread risk. In 2025, the outbreak began in Foshan in July and spread to 12 cities; by end-2025 Guangdong had over 25,000 laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases. During last year’s outbreak, authorities launched mass disinfection and other measures including mandatory isolation, nucleic acid testing, and large-volume blood testing, prompting public discontent and recalling COVID-19-era controls. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, joint and muscle pain, headache, fatigue, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省でジカウイルスが卷土重来、拡散リスクが例年を超える
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の地域内伝播が確認され、2025年の大規模流行（25,000例以上）の再来が懸念されている。IHR基準では異常性と国際拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では流行の危険性（蚊媒介、気候・貿易条件）と管理可能性の懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: 2025年の大規模流行（25,000例以上）の経験があり、今年の再燃が警戒されている。地域内伝播（3例中1例）と輸入例が混在。蚊媒介感染症であり、気候条件や国境近接性により区域外への拡大リスクが高い。COVID-19類似の強力な公衆衛生措置が過去に実施され、社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: National genomic profiling of Plasmodium falciparum antimalarial resistance in Zambian children participating in the 2018 malaria indicator survey - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: From 282 Plasmodium falciparum samples collected during the 2018 Zambia National Malaria Indicator Survey, whole-genome sequencing mapped resistance mutations in Pfk13, Pfcrt, mdr1, Pfdhps, Pfdhfr and related genes. Pyrimethamine resistance is highly prevalent: over 94% (n=266) carry the Pfdhfr triple mutant N51I/C59R/S108N; sulfadoxine resistance exceeds 84% (n=238) with the Pfdhps double mutant A437G/K540E. In northern Zambia, 5.3% (n=15) also harbor Pfdhps A581G. Pfkelch13 shows 29 non-synonymous mutations, but frequencies are low (<2.5%), with only three WHO-validated artemisinin-resistance markers detected (P441L n=1; V568M n=2; R622T n=1). Pfatpase6 E431K is found in 91 samples (32%), a candidate artemisinin-resistance marker. No chloroquine-resistance mutations in Pfcrt (codons 72–76) were observed. Conclusion: P. falciparum in Zambia is highly resistant to sulfadoxine/pyrimethamine but remains susceptible to chloroquine and artemisinin; nonetheless early artemisinin-resistance signals favor expanded routine genomic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアの小児におけるマラリア指標調査2018に参加したPlasmodium falciparumの全国ゲノムプロファイリング：抗マラリア薬耐性の解析
triage.triage_reason: ザンビアにおけるP. falciparum薬剤耐性の分子疫学調査であり、スクリーニング基準1つ（異常/予想外および流行しやすさ）に該当。ただし記事は学術論文であり、アウトブレイク報告ではなく過去のサーベイデータの解析結果のため、情報の新規性と即時的な公衆衛生脅威の程度が限定的。続報および臨床的インパクトを注視。
triage.notes: 本記事は2018年のマラリア指標調査データの全ゲノムシーケンシング解析を報告した学術論文。スルファドキシン/ピリメタミンに対する高度な耐性（Pfdhfr 94%、Pfdhps 84%）が記載されており、薬剤耐性サーベイランスの面で重要。ただしアルテミシニン耐性は低く、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではないため、即時的な危機ではない。ザンビア北部での新規耐性マーカー（Pfdhps A581G）検出が注目点。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes: 95 Persen Kasus Malaria Berasal dari Papua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: 95% of Malaria Cases Originate from Papua
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a major challenge in Indonesia's eastern region, with 95% of nationwide cases concentrated in Papua, across six provinces. In 2026, Indonesia reports 412 districts/cities are malaria-free, but Papua still records high malaria activity. Acting Director-General of Disease Control Andi Saguni of the Health Ministry notes the elimination effort is targeted, with Maybrat district in Papua Barat Daya declared malaria-free in 2025 as a positive example. He stresses that elimination is not instantaneous and requires sustained, locally tailored strategies. Maintaining malaria-free status is still difficult; several areas have experienced case surges and even outbreaks (KLB) after being declared malaria-free. The remarks were delivered online on 30 April 2026, highlighting Papua as the main focus for elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：マラリア症例の95%がパプアに由来
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのパプア州における固有のマラリア蔓延状況を報告。IHR基準は明確には該当しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・長期的曝露・流行易さ）では複数該当する可能性があり、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省の公式発言に基づく。パプア地域での根拠地のマラリア蔓延が述べられており、継続的な曝露と流行易さは確認される。死亡率や入院率などの重症度情報、国際的拡大リスクは記事では明記されていない。パプア・ニューギニアは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではインドネシア国内の問題として述べられており、PNG での発生自体は主題ではないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Miss Health Ghana, NMEP intensify fight against Malaria and galamsey in Atiwa West - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: Malaria prevention efforts were scaled up in Atiwa West District, Ghana, as Miss Health Ghana partnered with the National Malaria Elimination Programme (NMEP). Launched for World Malaria Day 2026 under the theme 'Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can, Now We Must,' the campaign links galamsey with malaria transmission, noting abandoned pits collect stagnant water breeding mosquitoes, and mercury contamination causing Minamata disease. A four-day tour across 10 schools reached over 1,000 students, in collaboration with the Atiwa West District Health Directorate and the District Education Directorate. An essay competition engaged youths on malaria and mining solutions. The event concluded with a health walk in Abomosu and a durbar attended by 500 residents. Janet Korkor Djangmah warned that every uncovered pit is a death trap; Miss Health Ghana's Gladys Rockson said the initiative created 1,000 ambassadors. Stakeholders urged stricter mining enforcement and sustained education to tackle environmental drivers of malaria.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのミス・ヘルス、NMEP がアティワ・ウェスト地区でマラリアと違法採掘撲滅キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは既知の風土病であり、本イベントは予防キャンペーン・啓発活動。死亡者や異常な発症者の報告がなく、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはマラリア予防キャンペーン・啓発活動であり、新規感染拡大やアウトブレイク警告ではない。ガーナはマラリア風土地であり、キャンペーン自体は公開衛生上の正常な活動。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 'Shivering all night': Deepika Padukone shot Housefull despite malaria, says Lara Dutta
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, India: Malaria and a high fever sidelined Deepika Padukone during the filming of Housefull, according to Lara Dutta in an NDTV interview. Dutta said Padukone was feverish, shivering, and had to be treated with medication, yet she continued filming under a fixed eight-hour schedule, delivering emotional scenes despite being drained. The revelation underscores the strain of demanding work schedules on ill actors. Dutta emphasized that malaria can be debilitating far beyond a cold, praising Padukone’s professionalism for showing up and finishing her work. The report notes Padukone had reportedly demanded an eight-hour shift, a constraint that allegedly contributed to her ouster from Kalki 2898 AD due to the same scheduling demands. Housefull, directed by Sajid Khan, also stars Akshay Kumar, Riteish Deshmukh, and Arjun Rampal.

triage.headline_ja: 「一晩中震えていた」：ディーピカ・パドゥコーネはマラリアにもかかわらずハウスフルで撮影を続けた、とララ・ダッタが語る
triage.triage_reason: この記事は有名女優の個人的な健康上の課題に関するエンターテインメント報道であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常な感染症イベントの報告ではない。マラリア症例の公衆衛生的な影響、伝播リスク、または集団発生の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエンターテインメント・セレブリティニュースカテゴリに該当し、個別の患者事例の報道である。疾患発生検知システムの対象外。公衆衛生危機管理の観点からはシグナルとして認識されない。

article.articleHeadline: Vilão da vez: associado aos resfriados comuns, rinovírus dispara na Bahia - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Villain of the moment: rhinovirus, linked to the common cold, surges in Bahia - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Rhinovirus leads severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, in early 2026. From January–April, Salvador reported 942 SRAG notifications with 541 lab-confirmations; 2025 data were 746 and 289. The increase in SRAG notifications is 26%, while lab-confirmed cases rose 87%. Rhinovirus accounts for 282 confirmed cases in Salvador this year, ahead of influenza (152; 142 type A, 10 type B), RSV (53), adenovirus (27), and COVID-19 (14). Statewide, Sesab shows rhinovirus responsible for 67.1% of identified-positive respiratory samples, making it the main SRAG driver. The non-COVID/non-influenza group represents 35.5% of Bahia’s SRAG cases, with influenza rising from 8.5% to 17% and COVID-19 falling from 11.3% to 3.3%. Bahia’s SRAG total Jan–Apr 2026 is 2,750, up 8% from 2025. Influenza vaccination pace remains below ideal: Bahia ~21.3% coverage (737,062/~3.4M) and Salvador ~23% (168,000); 1.7 million doses were dispatched to Bahia.

triage.headline_ja: ライノウイルスがバイアで急増：一般的な風邪に関連、現在の悪役 - Metro 1
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（バイア州）でライノウイルスを中心とした重度の急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の急増が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」と「公衆衛生への影響」が該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性が確認され、複数の呼吸器病原体の同時流行を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、バイア州サルバドールでライノウイルスが主要なSRAG原因菌（67.1%）となっており、2025年比で検査確定症例が87%増加している。複数の呼吸器病原体（ライノウイルス、インフルエンザ、RSV、アデノウイルス、COVID-19）が同時流行中。ワクチン接種率は理想値より低い（バイア州21.3%）。El Salvadorは「発生地域」に含まれているが、サマリー上では言及されていないため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de seis meses morre após diagnóstico de meningite no Norte de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six-month-old baby dies after meningitis diagnosis in Northern Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Six-month-old infant died in Northern Santa Catarina, Brazil, after being diagnosed with bacterial meningitis on April 28, according to health authorities. The child had received only one vaccine dose, with a second dose overdue. After diagnosis, the infant was transferred to Joinville for care. The secretariat said steps are being taken to protect the population and stressed that vaccination is the main prevention against bacterial meningitis. Bacterial meningitis is a severe inflammation of the membranes around the brain and spinal cord; transmission occurs via direct contact with respiratory secretions from infected or carrier individuals, while viral meningitis is typically linked to enteroviruses and transmitted via contaminated feces, food, or water. The Unified Health System (SUS) provides free vaccines, including Pentavalent (DTP/Hib/HB), Pneumococcal 10-valent, Meningococcal C, and Meningococcal ACWY vaccines; BCG at birth prevents severe tuberculosis forms, including tuberculous meningitis, highlighting adherence to the national vaccination schedule.

triage.headline_ja: 北部サンタカタリーナ州で髄膜炎診断後、生後6ヶ月の乳児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一死亡事例であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。ただし小児髄膜炎による死亡は重症度基準を満たし、情報不足による経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: chikungunya: se registraron 272 nuevos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: 272 new cases recorded
article.articleSummary: During week 15 of 2026, Argentina records 272 new chikungunya cases, bringing confirmed and probable totals to 1,109 (1,003 autochthonous, 106 with travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Cuba). About 93% of cases are concentrated in the Northwest region, with Salta leading at 644, Tucumán 204, Jujuy 101. In the Center, Santiago del Estero has 63 cases; Catamarca 21; Buenos Aires Province (PBA) 38; Córdoba 24; and Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (CABA) 8. The Northwest also reports a single case in Chaco; the Sur region has none. Four new dengue cases with residence in PBA, CABA and Salta were recorded in week 15, for a season total of 50 (54% autochthonous, 46% travel-associated from Brazil, Paraguay, Venezuela, Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Cuba, Indonesia, Pakistan, Maldives, Sri Lanka). Health authorities call for intensified surveillance, lab confirmation, and repeat sampling to clarify suspected dengue.

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes terapkan strategi TOKEN percepat penurunan kasus malaria di Papua - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health implements the TOKEN strategy to accelerate the decline in malaria cases in Papua - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: Find, Treat, Control (TOKEN) strategy implemented to accelerate malaria reduction in Papua, Indonesia. With 95% of Indonesia’s malaria cases in Papua, the Ministry of Health aims to expand case finding from roughly 700,000 last year to 800,000 in 2026 by intensifying passive case detection at primary health centers (Puskesmas). The plan emphasizes community engagement, deploying trained cadres, establishing village malaria teams, and enacting village-level regulations, plus training for key local figures. It includes forest-area interventions, targeting the 20% of malaria cases among migrants through mass treatment, preventive packages, and routine screening for people entering forests or remote inland areas. Challenges cited include funding, under-detection, and geographic barriers. Globally, about 282 million malaria cases occur; the Western Pacific region accounts for about 2.4 million, with Indonesia among the highest in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がパプアのマラリア症例減少を加速するためにTOKEN戦略を実施 - ANTARA News Central Papua

article.articleHeadline: Vírus que lota hospitais no outono não é só de criança: idosos correm risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus that fills hospitals in autumn isn't just for children: the elderly are at risk.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) poses a risk to older adults as autumn arrives in Brazil, not just a pediatric disease. While RSV is famous for bronchiolitis in infants, experts emphasize it also causes pneumonia and other severe illness in adults, with about one in four adults with RSV developing pneumonia. RSV triggers inflammatory responses in the airways and can affect other body systems, including cardiovascular and endocrine. In Brazil, RSV has been the leading cause of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) in the first halves of the past three years, accounting for 45.5% of SRAG records in 2025, according to Fiocruz. Specialists say vaccination is the most effective way to prevent an infection that could compromise elderly quality of life and independence.

triage.headline_ja: 秋に病院を埋め尽くすウイルスは子どもだけの病気ではない：高齢者も危険にさらされている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるRSVが高齢者に対する重篤なリスクをもたらす季節性パターンを示しており、公衆衛生上の懸念は存在するが、現在のところ異常な流行事象や国際的拡大のシグナルは記事から明確でない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVの季節的流行（秋）と高齢者への影響に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生上の重要性は認識されている。しかし、新規の異常な発生やアウトブレイク、国際的拡大のシグナルは記事内容から判明しない。Fiocruzのデータで過去3年間の傾向が示されているため、既知の現象としての位置付けと推測される。政府対応の状況が不明であり、追加情報の発出を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động các giải pháp phòng, chống bệnh truyền nhiễm thời điểm giao mùa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive measures to prevent and control infectious diseases during the seasonal transition.
article.articleSummary: April 2026, Lao Cai Province, Vietnam: no cases of avian influenza A(H7N9) or A(H5N1), nor cholera. New outbreaks detected early and contained, preventing wider transmission. The month recorded 19 outbreaks with 300 cases, predominantly B diseases such as mumps, varicella (chickenpox), and hand, foot-and-mouth disease. Cumulatively since the year began, 39 outbreaks have occurred; 19 have ended and 20 are under control. For measles, 7 suspected fever-and-rash cases were mainly in Yen Binh (5), Tran Yen (1), and Bao Yen (1); year-to-date suspected measles total 221. Notably, mumps, hand, foot-and-mouth disease, rabies, varicella and diarrhea are rising versus the previous year, while influenza, adenovirus and Covid-19 are declining. Lao Cai's Plan for Infectious Disease Prevention and Control 2026 aims to reduce incidence and mortality, sustain polio eradication and neonatal tetanus elimination, achieve ≥95% vaccination coverage, and ensure 100% outbreak detection and timely response, with enhanced surveillance and community awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目における感染症の予防・制御のための積極的対策

triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのラオカイ省における感染症サーベイランスと制御成功を報告している。複数の感染症が同時に記載されているが、これは季節的な傾向と対策計画の説明であり、単一の重大なアウトブレイク発生の報告ではない。政府による能動的な対策実施が示唆されているため、検出・制御体制は機能していると考えられる。追加情報（死亡例、医療体制の逼迫、国際的な拡大兆候）がないため、現段階ではWATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: FIR filed against hospital superintendent and doctors in child's rabies death
article.articleSummary: Reported on 30 April 2026, Punalur police filed an FIR against the superintendent and three doctors of Punalur Taluk Hospital after a court order related to the death of an eight-year-old girl from rabies. The mother alleges grave medical error for allegedly failing to follow mandatory protocols during Rabies Immunoglobulin (RIG) administration at the government facility. Despite treatment at the hospital, the child’s condition deteriorated and she died. The case centers on alleged lapses in rabies post-exposure management at the facility, with legal action initiated against hospital leadership and clinicians. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation or the infection source. No details are given about imported/exported cases. The situation underscores concerns about adherence to established rabies treatment protocols in a government setting.

article.articleHeadline: 169 Suspek Campak di Bontang, Mayoritas Anak tak Lengkap Imunisasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 169 Suspected Measles in Bontang, Most Children Not Fully Immunized.
article.articleSummary: 169 suspected measles cases in Bontang City, Indonesia, predominantly among children not fully immunized. Data from the Health Office (Diskes) show about 88.17% of cases involve unvaccinated children who missed scheduled immunizations. A mass immunization campaign runs from April to May 2026 to address vaccination gaps, though some residents still refuse or delay vaccination due to limited understanding of vaccine benefits. Case management follows symptom-based triage: mild cases treated at primary health facilities; those with complications referred to hospitals. District head Bachtiar Mabe warns that low vaccination coverage weakens herd immunity and increases transmission risk for the wider community. Officials note similar vaccination gaps in other Indonesian regions, underscoring the need for broad public education and coordinated vaccination efforts to protect children and curb spread.

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia integrates malaria control for 2030 elimination
article.articleSummary: Indonesia aims to eliminate malaria by 2030 by integrating malaria control with broader disease management. The Ministry of Health reports that 95% of malaria cases are in Papua, with funding and program commitments challenged by difficult geography under a budget efficiency policy. Regional governments are being urged to back efforts and enact supportive regulations. Preparations for reagents and testing kits to boost detection are planned. Case-finding targets will rise from 700,000 to 800,000 in 2026, mainly via community health centers (puskesmas). Emphasis on competent personnel, early detection, prevention and response, and standards-aligned treatment. Challenges include malaria among forest workers and rising cases in regions previously malaria-free, requiring vigilant surveillance, epidemiological investigations and migration monitoring, plus improved data through SISMAL, bed nets distribution, and vector surveillance in high-endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、2030年の根絶に向けてマラリア対策を統合
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア対策に関する政策・プログラム統合の記事で、異常性や緊急性は低い。ただしマラリアの流行継続と管理上の課題（資金・地理的困難、森林労働者への感染、新興地域での増加）が報告されており、経過観察の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア根絶に向けた政策統合の発表・コミットメントであり、新規の急性感染症イベントではない。ただしインドネシア（パプア地域を中心）での恒常的なマラリア流行、新興地域での症例増加、資金・人員不足などの管理上の課題が述べられている。シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要だが、地域のマラリア対策効果を継続的に監視する価値がある。パプアニューギニアはBluedot APIで言及されているが、記事サマリーの主題はインドネシアに限定されるため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Combate: Paraná monitora arboviroses com sistema eficiente e de baixo custo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Combat: Paraná monitors arboviral diseases with an efficient and low-cost system.
article.articleSummary: Paraná’s Health Department has deployed an efficient, low-cost arbovirus surveillance system using ovitrampas (egg-trapping) for Aedes aegypti. Since 2019, the state has trained vector-control teams to implement the method, becoming the first to reach 100% coverage. The ovitrampa consists of a black plastic container with water and a rough wooden paddle that attracts females to lay eggs. Traps are placed in homes and businesses at 300–400 meters apart; after 5–7 days, samples are collected and lab-analyzed to yield positivity (mosquito presence), egg density, and overall infestation, guiding targeted control actions. Ovitrampas replace LIRAa as the principal monitoring tool; biweekly sampling covers 100% of urban areas, offering continuous data. LIRAa remains annually (Oct–Nov) as a supplementary activity to identify predominant breeding sites. Monitoring and vector-control reduce dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and urban yellow fever.

triage.headline_ja: 対策：パラナ州は効率的で低コストのシステムでアルボウイルス病を監視
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのパラナ州におけるアルボウイルス（デング、チクングニア、ジカ、黄熱）の監視体制に関する記事。予防的・管理的取り組みを報じたもので、急性的な流行状況ではなく、現在のところ国際的な懸念を示す明確なシグナルは認められないが、該当地域での複数のアルボウイルス疾患に関する情報のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数のアルボウイルス疾患（デング、チクングニア、ジカ、黄熱）に関連する監視体制の構築について述べたもの。現在の急性的な流行状況ではなく、予防的な対策の実施報告である。ただし黄熱病（Yellow Fever）が含まれており、複数のアルボウイルスに対する懸念が存在すると考えられるため、継続的な情報収集が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba como funciona a ovitrampa que está dando resultados contra a dengue no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out how the ovitrap that is delivering results against dengue in Paraná works.
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil deploys low-cost ovitraps to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The ovitrap is a dark plastic pot filled with water and a rough wooden paddle that lures female Aedes aegypti to lay eggs. Traps are installed in homes and businesses about 300–400 meters apart; after five to seven days, collected material is analyzed in the lab. Since 2019, the State Health Secretariat (Sesa) has trained vector-control teams in ovitrampa use, making Paraná the first state to achieve 100% training for the method. Ovitraps act as sensors, yielding positivity, egg density, and overall infestation—informing targeted control. They replace LIRAa as the main monitoring tool, with biweekly ovitrap sampling covering 100% of urban areas, while LIRAa remains annual as a complementary survey. Improved vector monitoring reduces transmission of dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and urban yellow fever.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de gripe sobem e acendem alerta nacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases rise and trigger a national alert.
article.articleSummary: PAHO/OPAS issued an alert on rising influenza cases as the Southern Hemisphere enters a period of viral circulation, with Influenza A(H3N2) likely to predominate and RSV rising. In Brazil, H3N2 K variant—detected December 2025—now leads transmission, signaling a longer, more intense season; RSV increasing. Infogripe reports 24 states at alert or risk and 16 units with growth. By 2026 Brazil has over 46,000 SARI cases, with 26.4% due to Influenza A and 21.5% due to RSV. Vaccination remains key: flu vaccine covers H3N2, with UK data showing up to 75% protection against pediatric hospitalizations. Brazil prioritizes vaccination for children under 6, elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities, plus health and education workers; SUS offers RSV vaccination for pregnant women to protect newborns. Preventive measures include handwashing, avoiding closed spaces and crowds, covering cough, staying home with fever, and keeping vaccination up to date. Rapid response urged.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者が増加し、全国的な警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、異常/予想外）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。南半球における季節性インフルエンザの増加は予測可能だが、H3N2 K variantの新規亜系統検出と急速な伝播拡大、RSVの同時流行は監視対象。ブラジルで46,000件以上のSARI症例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示した発生地域にはUKも含まれているが、記事サマリーではUKはワクチン有効性の参照データとしてのみ言及されており、実際の患者発生地はブラジルが主体。PAHO/OPASアラートは南半球全域を対象としているが、具体的な患者数・州単位での警報はブラジルに限定。H3N2 K variantの新規亜系統検出（2025年12月）と急速な伝播は注目すべき点。RSVとの同時流行も加味し、監視レベルを上げる価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: No mucus needed: Easy-to-use TB test shows accuracy in 7-country analysis
article.articleSummary: MiniDock MTB, a battery-operated near point-of-care TB NAAT, enables molecular testing with non-sputum samples. In a NEJM study across seven high-TB-burden countries—India, Nigeria, the Philippines, South Africa, Uganda, Vietnam, and Zambia—1,380 patients were tested. Sputum testing achieved 85.7% sensitivity and 97.6% specificity; tongue-swab testing achieved 79.6% sensitivity and 99.5% specificity. WHO targets for near-patient tests are ≥85% sensitivity and ≥98% specificity for sputum, and ≥75% and ≥98% for non-sputum; results meet/exceed these benchmarks. The platform costs about $180 for the reader and thermolyze device each and about $4 per test card; results take ~30 minutes. It matched Xpert Ultra MTB/RIF in sputum performance and outperformed smear microscopy, with potential to increase access in rural clinics and broaden case-finding by testing those unable to produce sputum.

triage.headline_ja: 粘液不要：使いやすいTB検査が7カ国分析で精度を実証
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新しいTB診断技術の臨床研究結果に関するもので、新規感染症イベントの報告ではなく、診断ツール開発の学術的進展である。疾患の急激な拡大、異常な病原体挙動、または公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する状況は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核（TB）患者に関するシグナルではなく、新規診断技術MiniDock MTBの臨床評価研究に関する学術的報告である。複数国での試験実施が記述されているが、これは技術検証のためのコホート研究であり、感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、拡大、新規患者急増など）を報告していない。Bluedot APIは複数国を抽出したが、これらは研究対象国であり、イベント発生国ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: MSF intensifies measles response in Cox's Bazar  | District
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts intensified MSF response in Cox's Bazar, where the organization treats affected children from Rohingya refugee camps and nearby host communities amid overcrowding. Cox's Bazar hosts over 1.2 million Rohingya refugees in the world’s largest refugee settlement, a high-risk setting for transmission and complications. About three-quarters of confirmed measles cases are unvaccinated. In April, MSF treated 284 patients and opened a new isolation unit on April 19 at Jamtoli camp to reinforce health services, with a vaccination campaign starting on April 26. The outbreak has been rising since March and accelerated through April. MSF’s activities focus on vaccination support, isolation, and care for mostly under-five children, many with severe pneumonia, as part of the countrywide response.

triage.headline_ja: MSFがコックスバザールでのはしか対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度（肺炎合併症）、流行しやすさ（過密環境、予防接種率低い）、管理可能性（MSF介入が必要）の4基準に該当。大規模難民キャンプでのはしか流行であり、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的焦点はコックスバザール（バングラデシュ）であるが、Bluedotの発生地域リストに含まれる対象国はIndia（West Bengalは隣接州）のみ。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはIndiaのみとした。ただし、実際の主要な発生地はバングラデシュのコックスバザール難民キャンプであり、この点は注意が必要。MSFの強化対応、未予防接種の高比率（75%）、重症肺炎の多発、120万人超の過密難民キャンプという高リスク環境が揃っている。

article.articleHeadline: پاکستان میں ہیپاٹائٹس سی کے پھیلاؤ میں تشویشناک حد تک اضافہ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rise in the spread of Hepatitis C in Pakistan.
article.articleSummary: Pakistan shows an alarming rise in Hepatitis C spread, according to WHO. Pakistan, India, and China together bear 39% of the global Hepatitis C burden, with Pakistan among 10 countries accounting for 58% of Hepatitis C deaths. Globally in 2024, hepatitis B and C caused 1.34 million deaths; these infections are among the deadliest. The world recorded 1.8 million new hepatitis cases in 2024; only about 20% of Hepatitis C patients received treatment, and fewer than 5% of Hepatitis B patients did. Transmission is driven by unsafe medical practices and injections; Pakistan faces concerns over reuse of unsterilized syringes and fake auto-disable syringes creating a false sense of protection. The WHO notes Hepatitis B vaccine provides over 95% protection, Hepatitis C is curable in 8–12 weeks, but progress toward 2030 elimination targets remains insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンにおけるC型肝炎の拡大に警戒すべき増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響（年間134万死亡）と国際的な拡大リスクを認め、WPRO基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性の課題が確認される。対象国インドを含む多国間の問題として評価される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパキスタンにおけるC型肝炎の状況であるが、対象国リストではパキスタン（GeoNames ID 1168579）が含まれていない。そのため verified_locations にはインドのみを含める。記事ではパキスタン、インド、中国が世界的なC型肝炎負担の39%を占めると述べられているが、インドが対象国に該当するため PICKUP 判定となる。医療施設における非滅菌注射器の再利用は継続的曝露リスクを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 上海被列为蚊媒传染病防控Ⅱ类地区，今年白纹伊蚊出现时间有所提前_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai designated as a Category II region for the prevention and control of mosquito-borne infectious diseases; this year, the emergence timing of Aedes albopictus has advanced somewhat.
article.articleSummary: Shanghai has been designated a Category II region for dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases under a national plan that also classifies Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, and Yunnan as Category I. This year, Aedes albopictus in Shanghai appears to emerge earlier as temperatures rise. Dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, presents with sudden high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, and rash; severe dengue can cause hemorrhage or shock. Chikungunya fever, with similar onset, features intense small-joint pain (wrists, ankles, fingers) that can persist for weeks to months and requires laboratory testing to differentiate from dengue. Malaria, spread by Anopheles mosquitoes, traditionally shows cyclical fever; China has eliminated indigenous malaria, but imported cases from Africa and Southeast Asia remain a risk. Prevention emphasizes removing standing water, protective clothing, repellents, nets, and prompt medical evaluation; avoid NSAIDs before dengue is ruled out. Classification to II enables more scientific, routine control as of 2026-04-30.

triage.headline_ja: 上海が蚊媒介感染症防除のカテゴリーII地区に指定、今年のヒトスジシマカの出現時期が前倒しに
triage.triage_reason: 中国の複数地域で蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）の予防体制が強化されているが、現在のところ新規感染者の急増や異常な流行を示す情報がない。分類体制の更新と環境的変化（蚊の出現時期の早期化）は注視すべき予兆だが、直近の流行活動の詳細が不明なため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「Africa」を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーはアフリカからの輸入マラリア症例についての言及のみで、アフリカにおける現在の発生を指すものではない。したがってverified_locationsから除外。中国（特に上海を中心とした複数省）が実際の対象地域。蚊の出現時期の早期化と予防体制の強化が報じられているが、現在のところ流行が急速に拡大している兆候は明確でなく、継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: पेटारी गांव में खसरा के दो मरीजों की पुष्टि, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two measles cases confirmed in Petari village, Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles confirmed in Petari village, Narayanpur Block, Jharkhand, triggering a Health Department alert. Blood and throat samples sent on April 22 returned positive, prompting district officials to inspect the area. District Surveillance Officer Dr. Deepak Kumar and medical teams conducted a field visit and urged villagers to remain vigilant and follow precautions. A village-wide survey identified two additional suspected cases, with one of these sent to Ranchi for testing. Health authorities are maintaining close surveillance and conducting awareness campaigns to prevent further spread. Some residents reportedly avoid treatment and vaccination. A Community Health Center meeting instructed ASHA workers (Sahiyas) to educate residents about the seriousness of measles and the importance of timely treatment and vaccination. No information on infection source or imported/exported cases reported; authorities remain actively engaged.

triage.headline_ja: ペタリ村で麻疹患者2名が確認、保健部門がアラート
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は IHR 基準で「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」を満たし、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当する。保健部門の対応が既に開始されており社会的関心も確認される。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染力を持つワクチン予防可能疾患。記事では地域内で追加の疑い患者が特定されており、流行の可能性がある。保健当局が積極的にサーベイランスと啓発活動を実施中。地域住民の一部がワクチン接種を避けているとの報告は管理可能性の低下を示唆。Bluedot APIはネパールとバングラデシュを含めているが、記事の主題はジャールカンド州（インド）の発生であるため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Suben los casos de chikungunya en Santiago: se sumaron 16 en una semana - Diario Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya cases rise in Santiago: 16 more in a week - Diario Panorama
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases rise in Santiago del Estero with 16 new infections in the week, as national reports tally 272 chikungunya cases in week 15 of 2026, bringing the total to 1,109 confirmed and probable. About 93% of cases are in the Northwest Argentina region (NOA), with Santiago del Estero in the zone with the highest circulation. In NOA, Salta leads with 644 cases, followed by Tucumán (204), Jujuy (101), and Catamarca (21); Santiago del Estero shows active transmission. Nationally, 1,003 cases are autochthonous while 106 involve travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Cuba. Four dengue cases were confirmed in the same week, elevating the seasonal total to 50, with 54% autochthonous. Authorities warn of rising probable cases in several jurisdictions but maintain a low risk overall and urge vector-control measures against Aedes aegypti, focusing on the north to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: サンティアゴでチクングニヤ熱患者が増加：1週間で16件新規感染 - ディアリオ・パノラマ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、流行能力）、複数州での活動的感染拡大、ボリビア・ブラジル・パラグアイ・キューバからの関連事例、および地域的な公衆衛生への中程度の影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域には北西アルゼンチン（NOA）の複数州が含まれるが、対象国リストにはアルゼンチンが含まれていない。記事では、ボリビア・ブラジル・パラグアイ・キューバへの渡航歴を持つ事例が106件報告されており、対象国のうちブラジルのみが該当する。チクングニヤとデングの同時循環、Aedes aegyptiベクターによるヒト-ヒト感染の活発性、複数地域での持続的な感染拡大が認められ、地域的な公衆衛生の懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Comitê de Arboviroses de Serro realiza reunião ordinária para avaliar cenário epidemiológico e alinhar estratégias de combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serro Arboviruses Committee holds its regular meeting to assess the epidemiological scenario and align strategies to combat Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: On April 29, the Serro Arboviruses Committee held its regular meeting to contextualize the current epidemiological scenario and outline actions to combat Aedes aegypti-transmitted diseases—dengue, Zika, and chikungunya—in the municipality of Serro, Brazil. The session brought technicians, managers, and representatives from health, environment, and social assistance to jointly review ongoing epidemiological data. The multisectoral composition reflects recognition that effective arbovirus control requires integrating sanitary surveillance, environmental management, and social support for affected populations. Participants aligned surveillance, prevention, and vector-control strategies for the municipal territory, stressing coordinated and rapid responses to shifts in disease dynamics. The committee's periodic meetings are a central element of the public health policy, enabling ongoing monitoring and agile adjustments as indicators warrant. The article is sourced from Panorama with information from the City Hall of Serro.

triage.headline_ja: セッロ市アルボウイルス委員会が定例会議を開催し、疫学的シナリオを評価し、ネッタイシマカ対策戦略を調整
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのセッロ市におけるジカ熱などのアルボウイルス対策の通常的な会議報告。既知疾患の継続的な監視・対応活動であり、新規の発生急増や重大な公衆衛生上の悪化を示す情報は見当たらない。継続的な疫学情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアルボウイルス対策委員会の定例会議であり、既知疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の通常的な監視・管理活動を報告している。現在の疫学状況の詳細な数値やシナリオ悪化の具体的な兆候は記載されていない。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」には該当するが、IHR基準の該当がなく、社会的関心も限定的であるため、WATCHレベルと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Strategic interventions needed to wipe out malaria
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day 2026 highlights progress against malaria through vaccines, nets, diagnostics, and new tools such as genetically modified mosquitoes and long-acting prevention methods. Kenya, Ghana and Malawi have begun malaria vaccines in national or sub-national programs, aiming to protect about 10 million children annually. In Kenya, prevalence fell from 8% in 2015 to 5.6% in 2025, driven by adopting the R21/Matrix-M vaccine (up to 75% protection) alongside better nets and preventive drugs, enabling expansion to 12 additional western sub-counties. WHO notes ongoing progress toward a 2030 target of a 90% reduction in malaria cases and deaths. Key strategies emphasize national leadership, sustainable funding, predictable partnerships, continued innovation to outpace mosquito resistance, and empowering communities to sustain gains.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア撲滅に向けた戦略的介入が必要
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン、蚊帳、診断ツール、遺伝子改変蚊などを含む既存の対策と進捗を扱う解説記事であり、新規発生事例や急速な増加、危機的状況を報告していない。IHR基準またはWPRO基準の該当がなく、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Day 2026に関連する意見記事で、マラリアの歴史的進捗と既存対策を強調している。新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、または危機的状況の報告がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。ケニア、ガーナ、マラウイが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはガーナのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ed Sheeran ungkap pengalaman saat terdiagnosis penyakit herpes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ed Sheeran reveals his experience when he was diagnosed with herpes.
article.articleSummary: Ed Sheeran, the British musician, has been diagnosed with herpes zoster (shingles), disclosed in Jakarta, Indonesia. People reported on April 28 that he told fans via social media he had a month-long bout and wouldn’t recommend the condition, though he is improving. Herpes zoster is caused by the varicella-zoster virus—the same virus that causes chickenpox—and, while not typically life-threatening, can be very painful, producing a painful rash. He also shared a new shaved haircut as a symbolic fresh start. The report notes his album Play, released September 2025, and that he is touring on the Loop Tour from January through December 2026. No additional case counts or fatalities are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: エド・シーランが帯状疱疹と診断された時の経験を明かす
triage.triage_reason: イベントは著名人個人の帯状疱疹診断であり、公衆衛生危機ではない。集団発生、複数症例、管理不能な流行の証拠なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はセレブリティ(エド・シーラン)の個人的な帯状疱疹診断に関するニュースであり、感染症の公衆衛生危機ではない。ジャカルタで報道されたが、地域的な集団発生や流行の兆候なし。Bluedotが感染症イベントとして検出した可能性があるが、トリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Cirebon Siaga Campak! 4 Kecamatan Jadi Zona KLB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cirebon on Measles Alert! Four Districts Become Outbreak Zones.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared in Cirebon Regency, West Java, Indonesia, with four districts designated as outbreak zones (KLB): Mundu, Sumber, Ciwaringin, and Greged. Health authorities launched a mass vaccination via a catch-up campaign (CUC) targeting children aged 9 to 59 months, achieving 95% vaccination coverage to boost herd immunity. As of week 15 of 2026, Greged and Ciwaringin each reported 33 suspected measles cases, with 7 and 9 laboratory-confirmed positives, respectively; Mundu had 29 suspected cases with 2 confirmed positives; Sumber had 24 suspected cases with 5 confirmed positives. No deaths have been reported so far. The Dinkes has prepared an Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) program extending to ages 9 months through 13 years. Seven other districts will implement ORI due to high mobility and measles-rubella vaccination coverage below 80% over the past five years.

triage.headline_ja: チレボン麻疹アラート！4地区が流行地帯に指定
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・チレボン地域での麻疹アウトブレイク。4地区が流行地帯に指定され、確定症例が複数報告されており、IHR基準の異常性・予想外性およびWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさを満たす。公式な流行対応プログラム実施中。
triage.notes: チレボン地区（西ジャワ州）での麻疹公式アウトブレイク宣言。4地区が流行地帯(KLB)に指定され、複数地区で確定症例報告あり。予防接種キャンペーン実施中で、死亡例なし。地域公衆衛生当局による積極的対応が展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Thanh Hóa: Khởi tố vụ án giết mổ, tiêu thụ lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thanh Hóa: Prosecution of a case involving the slaughter and consumption of pigs infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Three suspects in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, have been indicted for violations of food safety regulations after slaughtering and processing pigs infected with African swine fever (ASF) and selling the meat. On 31 March 2026, Thanh Hoa Economic Police and Hoang Loc commune police inspected a pig slaughter facility run by Nguyen Van Chien in Hoang Loc. They found three slaughtered pigs totaling 384.5 kg and eight live pigs showing illness. Chien confessed he ordered slaughter and sale despite signs of disease, and had bought eight more diseased pigs from Le Van Trung. Trung had purchased them from farmer Nguyen Khac Nguyen, who detected disease but did not report it and tried to liquidate stock. Laboratory tests by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center I confirmed ASF virus in meat and blood samples. Authorities seized 384.5 kg of pork and destroyed eight diseased pigs; case remains under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省: アフリカ豚熱感染豚の屠殺・流通事件を起訴
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱の感染豚が検出され、違法流通が確認された事例であり、異常・予想外の事象である。ただし、既に当局による検査・隔離・廃棄が実施されており、感染症の国際的拡大リスクは限定的と判断される。情報不足のため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事象は動物疾患（ASF）に関するもので、人獣共通感染症ではない。感染豚の違法流通という食品安全問題として捕捉されている。既に当局が検査・廃棄を実施しており、直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。ASFの動向としては重要な事象だが、ヒト感染リスク、国際的拡大リスクについては情報不足。

article.articleHeadline: В Индии вводят штрафы за кормление голубей из-за риска опасных заболеваний - sud.ua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In India, fines are imposed for feeding pigeons due to the risk of dangerous diseases.
article.articleSummary: Delhi authorities have tightened controls on feeding pigeons in public spaces due to public health risks from droppings and feathers. Since the start of the year, the city has issued more than 75 warnings to people feeding birds. The push followed schoolboy Arman Palivawala's claim that feeding pigeons pollutes the air and can cause lung and respiratory problems. Experts warn droppings and feathers may harbor pathogens such as histoplasmosis, candidiasis, and cryptococcosis, which can be life-threatening, and birds can carry parasites like bed bugs. Regular feeding also increases pigeon populations and attracts rodents. Measures include fines for violators, daily cleanup of common roosting sites, and information campaigns. The practice remains widespread in India, often facing resistance. Similar restrictions have emerged in Mumbai, and in Karnataka such restrictions include fines and designated feeding areas for organizations.

triage.headline_ja: インドでハトへの給餌に罰金を導入、危険な疾患のリスクのため
triage.triage_reason: ヒストプラズマ症を含む病原体への曝露リスクが言及されており、複数州での規制措置が進行中だが、現時点で確認されている症例報告がなく、実際の公衆衛生上の影響は不明。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はハト給餌に関する公衆衛生規制の実施に焦点を当てており、潜在的な病原体曝露リスク（ヒストプラズマ症、カンジダ症、クリプトコッカス症）が指摘されているが、実際の患者発生報告はない。複数州（デリー、ムンバイ、カルナータカ）での規制措置は、予防的対応を示唆している。環境（鳥の排泄物）からの継続的な曝露リスクが存在する点は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: महाराष्ट्र में बर्ड फ्लू का कोहराम! नवापुर में 1.40 लाख मुर्गियों को मारने का आदेश; 1 KM का इलाका सील
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu chaos in Maharashtra! Navapur orders the culling of 140,000 chickens; a 1-km area sealed off.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) confirmed in Navapur taluka, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra—the third case in the area. About 150–200 chickens died on 13–14 April; samples were sent and a Bhopal laboratory confirmed infection. A one-kilometre containment zone is in place with intensified surveillance of nearby poultry farms. A culling operation targets roughly 140,000 chickens across six farms to prevent spread. No human infections have been reported so far, though precautions were urged. Officials emphasize the situation is under control and that all protocols are being followed, with focus on local containment to prevent spread to other regions. The incident has disrupted the local poultry industry.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州で鳥インフルエンザの混乱！ナワープルで140,000羽の鶏の殺処分を命令、1km地域を封鎖
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハラシュトラ州で鳥インフルエンザが確認された。動物への影響が記録されており、ヒト感染のリスクが存在するため、IHR基準（異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（異常性、流行可能性、管理可能性）で複数該当し、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザは人畜共通感染症であり、ヒト感染の潜在的リスクを持つ。記事ではヒト感染が報告されていないが、公衆衛生的価値のある監視対象。140,000羽の殺処分規模から重大性が伺える。マハラシュトラ州の3番目の確認事例であることも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Indígena de 29 anos é nona morte provocada pela chikungunya em Dourados - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 29-year-old Indigenous person is the ninth death caused by Chikungunya in Dourados - O PROGRESSO
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, has reached nine deaths. The latest victim was a 29-year-old Indigenous person from Aldeia Bororó who developed symptoms on April 19 and died April 25 at Hospital da Vida. Eight of the nine fatalities were Indigenous. There are 35 people hospitalized with chikungunya across Dourados’ hospitals: Porta da Esperança, HU-UFGD, Cassems, Regional, Hospital da Vida, and Mackenzie. Overall, the city has 7,371 notifications: 5,271 probable, 2,755 confirmed, 2,100 discarded, and 2,516 under investigation. In the Bororó and Jaguapiru villages, 3,113 notifications exist with 2,474 probable, 1,759 confirmed, 636 discarded, and 715 under investigation. Officials warn the outbreak remains grave and urge community action to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, maintain clean yards, and ensure proper waste collection.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラドスでチクングニア熱による9例目の死亡、29歳の先住民
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：9死亡・7,371通知、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度：死亡多発、流行しやすさ：蚊媒介感染、継続曝露：アウトブレイク進行中）。ブラジル国内での重要な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥアラドスでのチクングニア熱アウトブレイクを記述。9死亡（うち8例は先住民）、7,371通知、2,755確定例、35入院中。蚊媒介感染症であり、Aedes aegyptiの繁殖地排除に向けた公式警告あり。ただし対象国リスト（895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil等）においてBrazilは含まれているため、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: VSR e gripe puxam crescimento dos casos de síndrome respiratória grave na maior parte do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV and influenza drive the growth of severe acute respiratory syndrome cases in most of Brazil.
article.articleSummary: RSV and influenza A drive severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) increases across Brazil, with most states at alert, risk, or high risk as of 30 April 2026 per Fiocruz InfoGripe. RSV remains a key cause of bronchiolitis in children under two, and SARI cases rise nationwide, though Amazonas, Mato Grosso, Rondônia, and Roraima show declines; Goiás, Maranhão, and Tocantins show stabilization. Influenza A–related SARI grows in the Centro-Sul and parts of the North and Northeast, while numbers decline in Amazonas, Amapá, Pará, Tocantins, Bahia, Ceará, Maranhão, Piauí, Rio Grande do Norte, and Mato Grosso; Goiás and Sergipe indicate halted increases. Thirteen of 27 capitals are at alert/risk/high risk with rising SARI in the last six weeks. In 2026, SARI deaths total 1,960, with 852 lab-positive (43.5%), 880 negative (44.9%), and 50 pending (2.6%). Among positives: influenza A 39.1%, SARS-CoV-2 27.9%, rhinovirus 22.2%, RSV 5.8%, influenza B 3.2%.

triage.headline_ja: RSVとインフルエンザがブラジルの大部分の重症急性呼吸器症候群症例の増加を牽引
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA、RSV、SARS-CoV-2による重症急性呼吸器疾患(SARI)がブラジル全土で報告されており、複数州で警戒・リスク段階にあるが、現在のところ死亡数や国際的拡大の差し迫った脅威を示す明確な証拠がなく、情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル全土でRSVとインフルエンザAによるSARI症例が増加しており、複数州が警戒・リスク段階にある。2026年に1,960件のSARI死亡が報告され、検査陽性率43.5%。ただしWPRO基準による異常性（unusual/unexpected）は限定的（季節性呼吸器疾患）であり、国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ低い。動向監視を継続し、今後の拡大や重症化傾向に注視する必要がある。
