article.articleHeadline: Vuelven a aumentar los casos de Fiebre Chikungunya: en Santiago del Estero ya suman 63 los positivos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever cases rise again: in Santiago del Estero there are now 63 positive cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever cases have risen in Argentina, per the National Epidemiological Bulletin covering April 12–18. A total of 1,109 positive cases have been reported (confirmed and probable), including 1,003 autochthonous and 106 with travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba. Santiago del Estero reports 63 cases. Ninety-three percent of chikungunya cases are in the Northwest Argentina region (NOA), with Salta leading at 644 cases, followed by Tucumán (204) and Jujuy (101). Other locales include Catamarca 21; Buenos Aires Province 38; Córdoba 24; City of Buenos Aires 8; Entre Ríos 2; Santa Fe 1; San Luis 2 in Cuyo; Chaco 1; the Southern region reports none. Dengue shows four new Week 15 cases (residence in Buenos Aires Province, City of Buenos Aires, and Salta), bringing 50 confirmed since start of season, 54% autochthonous, 46% travel-associated from Brazil, Paraguay, Venezuela, Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Cuba, Indonesia, Pakistan, Maldives, and Sri Lanka. Authorities call for intensified surveillance and repeat testing, especially in PBA, Córdoba, CABA, Tucumán, and Santa Fe.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱の症例が再び増加：サンティアゴ・デル・エステロで63例が確認
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンで1,109例のチクングニア熱患者が報告され、特に北西部地域で集中的な流行が続いている。また複数の輸入デング熱患者も報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・公衆衛生影響）とWPRO基準（重症度・流行性・管理対応の必要性）を複数満たす。国内流行の継続と対象地域での活動が確認される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の国を「発生地域」に列挙しているが、サマリーの主題はアルゼンチンの国内流行である。ブラジルはデング熱の輸入ソース国として言及されているため included。パキスタン・インドネシア・モルディブ・スリランカはデング熱の輸入源国としてのみ言及されており、サマリー上の主要イベント発生地ではないため除外。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含まれない。ただし Brazil (id: 3469034) は対象国かつ実際の輸入ソースとして言及されているため included。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma 9ª morte por chikungunya e faz drive-thru de vacina no feriado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department confirms 9th death from chikungunya and offers drive-through vaccination on the holiday
article.articleSummary: As of April 30, 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 9 confirmed chikungunya deaths and 3 under investigation. A 29-year-old Indigenous man from Aldeia Bororó died April 25 due to chikungunya complications; symptoms began April 19 and he was hospitalized at Hospital da Vida. The Reserva Indígena de Dourados is the epicenter, with eight deaths Feb–Apr (three men aged 73, 77, 55; a 29-year-old man; two women aged 60 and 69; and two infants, 1 and 3 months). In the urban area, a 63-year-old man died April 7. Dourados has 35 hospitalized with chikungunya, 7,371 notifications, 5,271 probable cases (2,755 confirmed, 2,100 discarded, 2,516 under investigation). Vaccination began April 25 in city and indigenous villages; goal 43,000 people aged 18–59. Drive-thru May 1, 8:00–12:00, in front of CAM; pre-screening per Instituto Butantan guidelines; contraindications include pregnancy, immunosuppression, recent cancer treatment, BMI >30. Vaccine by Instituto Butantan with Valneva.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がチクングニア熱による9番目の死亡を確認し、祝日にワクチン接種ドライブスルーを実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニア熱による複数死亡（9件確認、3件調査中）と大規模流行（7,371件通知、2,755件確認）が報告されており、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行易性）。緊急ワクチン接種対応が開始されており、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ドウラドス市（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）におけるチクングニア熱の重篤な流行。先住民保留地が震源地で、複数の死亡者（乳幼児2名を含む）が報告されており、易感受性集団への影響が顕著。7,371件の通知と2,755件の確認症例は地域的な大規模流行を示唆している。ワクチン接種キャンペーンが急速に実施されていることから、政府の対応が強化されている。チクングニア熱は西半球での継続的な脅威であり、国際的な懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox aumenta no Brasil e reacende alerta para monitoramento e vigilância - CBDL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox on the rise in Brazil and reignites the alert for monitoring and surveillance - CBDL.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases in Brazil rose in early 2026, with 140 laboratory-confirmed and nine suspected infections across 13 states and the Federal District, led by São Paulo with 93 cases. Other states reporting cases include Amazonas, Ceará, Minas Gerais, Pará, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Norte, Rondônia, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, Sergipe, and Tocantins. Symptoms: fever, malaise, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions evolving to crusts. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with infected skin lesions, close physical contact, and sharing contaminated objects. No deaths reported so far in 2026; most cases are mild to moderate. Rapid molecular testing, particularly real-time PCR, is central to confirming cases and feeding surveillance, guiding isolation and health-network responses. Emphasis on early detection to speed the response and prevent transmission, with authorities highlighting the role of structured laboratory capacity in outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのエムポックス増加が監視と警戒を再点火 - CBDL
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年初頭にエムポックスの症例が増加し、13州と連邦地区で140件の確定症例と9件の疑い症例が報告されている。複数州への地理的拡大、Clade I/II両株の関連、感染力の高さ、国際的な懸念から PICKUP 判定。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月30日配信で、ブラジル全土13州の広い地理的範囲に及ぶエムポックスの増加を報告している。Clade I と Clade II 両方が記載されており、ヒト-ヒト感染能力を持つ。死亡報告がないため重症度は中程度だが、複数州への急速な拡大と感染力の高さが懸念される。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはブラジルの複数州が列挙されており、すべてブラジル国内である。IHR基準4つすべてとWPRO基準5つすべてに該当し、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Importance of rabies vaccine for children: Doctor explains risks, symptoms and bite care
article.articleSummary: Rabies causes 18,000–20,000 deaths annually in India (NCDC/WHO); over 40% are children under 15, with India hosting more than 30 million stray dogs. Transmission is via saliva from infected dogs or cats, through bites, scratches, or licks on broken skin; incubation is 1–3 months. Untreated rabies is 99.9% fatal; category III bites on limbs, face, or neck are common. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar report the most cases. Rabies vaccination is the cornerstone of prevention: modern vaccines are safe from infancy; pre-exposure doses cut treatment by ~90%. Post-exposure, five Essen doses on days 0,3,7,14,28 are recommended, with immunoglobulin for severe exposures. Immediate wound care includes washing with soap and water for 15–20 minutes and applying povidone-iodine, then seeking care within 24 hours. Dr Amit P Ghawade underscores timely vaccination to protect children in endemic zones.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のための狂犬病ワクチンの重要性：医師が危険性、症状、咬傷ケアを説明
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の既知の風土病地域（インド）における予防啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし高い死亡率と小児被害数、複数州での継続的な発生報告により継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドにおける狂犬病の既知の風土病状況に関する医学的啓発記事である。年間18,000～20,000人の死亡（うち40%以上が15歳未満の小児）、3000万頭以上の野犬が存在するため、長期的な曝露リスクと流行傾性が高い。IHR基準では新規性がないため1基準のみ該当。ただし死亡率99.9%の重篤性と継続的な地域発生のため、スクリーニング基準3つが該当し、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Lower GST on household insecticide products and last-mile accessibility necessary to curb mosquito-borne diseases, note EY-HICA report
article.articleSummary: India's EY-HICA report, announced in New Delhi/Mumbai on 23 April 2026; as of 30 April 2026 it advocates reducing GST on household insecticides from 18% to 5% and establishing a distinct product classification under GST. The measure aims to improve affordability and rural access to liquid vapourisers, coils, and aerosols, which function as a first line of defense against malaria, dengue, and chikungunya where large-scale interventions are limited. Urban household penetration is high (92–99%), while rural adoption lags (64–73%), with low-income populations most affected. The report argues current 18% GST creates price distortions and fuels unregulated substandard products, undermining safety and revenue integrity. A 5% rate could boost formal, safe product use and strengthen last-mile disease prevention, though some input tax credit effects under inverted duty structures are noted.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介感染症の抑止には家庭用殺虫剤製品のGST引下げと最後の一里塚のアクセス性が必要、EY-HICA報告書が指摘
triage.triage_reason: インドで蚊媒介感染症（マラリア、デング熱、チクングニア）の対策に関する政策提言レポートであるが、具体的な患者数、死亡例、または現在の疾患流行の急増を示す情報がないため、シグナル確定には情報が不足している。政策立案文書としての関心度は高いが、疾患イベントの深刻さの実証がない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおけるマラリア、デング熱、チクングニアの蚊媒介感染症対策に関する政策レポートであり、疾患流行の現況というより政策提言が主体。WPRDスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当するものの、具体的な患者数増加、死亡率、または新規事例数などの疾患イベントの深刻度が記事に記載されていない。続報で実際の疾患発生状況の詳細が報告された場合はPICKUPへ昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis C cases rise in Pakistan, WHO warns of surge
article.articleSummary: Pakistan sees a sharp rise in hepatitis C cases, with WHO data highlighting a broader regional burden. Pakistan, India, and China together account for 39% of global hepatitis C burden, and Pakistan ranks among countries with the highest hepatitis C–related deaths. Globally, hepatitis B and C caused about 1.34 million deaths in 2024, with around 1.8 million new hepatitis infections that year; treatment coverage remains limited, with only about 20% of hepatitis C patients receiving treatment. In Pakistan, unsafe medical practices—reused syringes and contaminated injections—are identified as key transmission drivers, reflecting weak infection control. Health specialists warn that current measures fall short of meeting the 2030 elimination targets. They call for stronger prevention strategies, improved healthcare regulation, and, where possible, expanded awareness and vaccination efforts to curb the ongoing burden.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンでC型肝炎症例が増加、WHOが急増を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。パキスタンにおけるC型肝炎の急増と地域的負担の大きさから、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパキスタンでのC型肝炎症例の急増であるが、パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ただしインド・中国は対象国であり記事サマリーで言及されているため含める。パキスタンでの不安全な医療行為（注射針の再利用等）が伝播原因として特定されており、感染制御が弱いと指摘。2030年排除目標達成に現在の対策では不十分であると警告。

article.articleHeadline: " C'est en voie de guérison " : qu'est-ce que le zona, maladie infectieuse dont le chanteur Ed Sheeran a souffert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "It's on the road to recovery": what is shingles, the infectious disease that the singer Ed Sheeran suffered from.
article.articleSummary: Shingles (herpes zoster) results from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus years after chickenpox. Ed Sheeran disclosed in late March 2026 that he developed shingles while touring in Mexico, Brazil and Paraguay, ahead of resuming South American dates. The infection causes a painful, usually unilateral vesicular rash that follows a dermatomal band, most often along the thorax, and may include fever and burning sensations. Lesions crust in 5–7 days, with healing around day 10, though some patients endure persistent neuropathic pain or skin infections. Ophthalmic involvement carries a 1–4% risk, increasing with age; about half of people over 85 may be affected by some form of shingles in the ophthalmic region, risking conjunctivitis, keratitis, uveitis, retinitis, and possible vision problems. Shingles risk rises with age; vaccines are recommended for immunocompromised adults (18+) and for all 65+ in France, with 65% reimbursement since December 2024. Incidence ranges 1.3–5 per 1,000, rising to 5–10 per 1,000 in those over 60, with many cases after age 45.

triage.headline_ja: 「回復過程にあります」：シンガーエド・シーランが患った感染症である帯状疱疹とは何か
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹は既知疾患の個人感染事例であり、異常な集団発生ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は著名シンガー（エド・シーラン）の帯状疱疹感染の個人事例報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事象ではない。帯状疱疹はワクチン接種可能な既知疾患であり、集団発生の報告もない。メディア関心は芸能人の健康問題によるものであり、感染症サーベイランスの優先度は低い。対象国に含まれるのはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya Epidemic in Sint Laurent: Suriname Warns of Silent Crisis - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak reaches epidemic status along western French Guiana, with Saint Laurent as the epicenter, accounting for 80% of 143 confirmed cases since January 2026. The western coast is hardest hit, and the outbreak has crossed into Suriname, where hundreds of chikungunya cases have been reported; Albina, across the river from Saint Laurent, has confirmed infections, signaling cross-border transmission. Suriname has launched a fumigation campaign to reduce the mosquito population, obtaining tools and chemicals from Brazil; officials expect operations to continue six to twelve months, with additional supplies underway. The health crisis has prompted alarm in Suriname's De Nationale Assemblée about the healthcare system's capacity to respond. Containment remains focused on fumigation and public health interventions in the border region as the situation develops, with public health authorities coordinating across French Guiana and Suriname.

triage.headline_ja: シント・ローラン地域でのチクングニア流行：スリナムが静かな危機を警告
triage.triage_reason: 国境を越えた伝播（フランス領ギアナからスリナムへ）、流行状況への進展、複数国での対応体制の整備が確認されており、IHR基準2項目以上とWPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるフランス領ギアナ（Guyane）とスリナムは対象国外のため、verified_locationsに含めない。ただしブラジルが支援国（燻蒸用機材・化学品供給元）として記事に明示されているため含める。チクングニアはアルボウイルス感染症として重要なシグナルであり、国境地域での活動的な伝播と複数国による調整対応がWHO通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Dez dicas de cuidados com a meningite e os principais tipos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ten Tips for Caring for Meningitis and the Main Types.
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 6,169 confirmed meningitis cases in 2025, with 2,643 (42.8%) bacterial, 2,109 (34.2%) viral, 398 (6.5%) other etiologies, and 1,012 (16.4%) unspecified. Globally, meningitis affects over five million people yearly, with about 10% mortality and roughly 20% developing sequelae. Meningitis is inflammation of the brain’s protective membranes, caused by viruses, bacteria, parasites, or fungi; bacterial meningitis is the most severe, while viral forms are typically milder. Common symptoms include neck stiffness, fever, nausea, and severe headache. The public health system offers free vaccines against the most dangerous forms: meningitis type C (Meningo C), pneumococcal (Pneumo 10), Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) via Pentavalente, and tuberculosis meningitis protection with BCG. Management emphasizes urgent medical care, essential diagnostics (clinical exam, lumbar puncture, blood cultures, imaging), pathogen-specific treatment, contact prophylaxis when indicated, strict hygiene, vaccination, and follow-up for complications.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎のケアに関する10のヒントと主要なタイプについて
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2025年に6,169件の髄膜炎確定症例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の関心事項であるが、新規発生や異常なアウトブレイクの示唆がなく、情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎の疾患教育および予防対策に関する一般的な情報提供であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な発生パターンの報告ではない。ブラジル国内での日常的な感染症監視データの報告であると判断。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、長期曝露、流行性の高さが確認されるが、IHR基準は1つのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Measles explodes in Bangladesh after vaccination breakdown, killing hundreds of children
article.articleSummary: Measles epidemic in Bangladesh since January, starting in Rohingya refugee camps near the Myanmar border, has surged to more than 32,000 suspected cases and over 250 deaths, mostly among young children. By 23 April, about 21,000 hospitalizations occurred and the outbreak spread to 58 of 64 districts, with overwhelmed hospitals and children treated on floors. The crisis follows a breakdown in vaccine procurement after the 2024 revolution, as an open-tender system disrupted UNICEF-supplied MR vaccines and campaigns, leaving immunization around 59% in 2025 and canceling supplementary campaigns. As of 30 April 2026, the government reinstated UNICEF procurement and launched emergency vaccination: 5 April targeting 6 months–5 years in high-risk areas, then nationwide rollout on 20 April. WHO warned of spillover risk to Myanmar and India. Malnutrition and vitamin A deficiency amplify severe disease, while authorities coordinate with WHO and Gavi and aim to restore vaccination and vitamin distributions.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種の崩壊後、バングラデシュで麻疹が爆発的に流行し、数百人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。32,000件以上の疑い例と250人以上の死亡、58/64地区への拡大、ミャンマーとインドへの波及リスクが明記されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事はバングラデシュを主要な発生地とし、ミャンマー国境のロヒンギャ難民キャンプが発端で、ミャンマーとインドへの波及リスクが明示されている。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには対象国のインドとミャンマーのみを含める。2024年の革命後のワクチン調達の崩壊、栄養不良とビタミンA欠乏症の複合要因、WHO・Gavi等による国際支援が継続中である。

article.articleHeadline: Produto brasileiro ganha apoio internacional contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian product gains international support against malaria.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian malaria-control technology Verniz Afastinsetos, a water-based coating, receives official backing from Cameroon’s Embassy in Brazil to test against Anopheles, the malaria vector. The product, authorized by Anvisa and OCDE-validated, is applied on walls, doors, furniture and outdoor areas, forming an invisible protective layer that releases microdoses when a mosquito lands, reducing survival and transmission. In OCDE-lab tests, it showed 100% efficacy against Aedes aegypti within 24 hours; the next step is validating efficacy against Anopheles in Africa. On 19 March 2026, Ambassador Martin A. MBENG facilitated an official letter confirming Cameroon's health authorities will support in-country testing, field trials with local institutions, and health-policy integration, with potential expansion to other high-incidence African countries. Malaria remains a global challenge, with 263 million cases and about 600,000 deaths in 2023, ~95% in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル製品がマラリア対策で国際的支援を獲得
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル製マラリア対策技術の国際展開に関するニュースだが、新規患者発生や疾病流行の報告ではなく、製品開発・試験計画の進展を報じるもの。シグナル（流行・アウトブレイク）としての即時対応は不要だが、アフリカでの臨床試験開始に向けた動きとして経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは既知のマラリア流行地における新規患者発生やアウトブレイク情報ではなく、ブラジル製マラリア対策物質（Verniz Afastinsetos）の国際的認可・試験計画についての報道。カメルーンは製品試験の対象国として言及されているが、カメルーン国内でのマラリア発生報告ではないため、verified_locationsからは除外。ブラジルは製品開発・認可国として含める。WPRO基準およびIHR基準のいずれにも該当しないため、フルRRAの優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados registra 9ª morte por chikungunya; MS concentra 66% dos óbitos no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados records the ninth death due to chikungunya; MS accounts for 66% of deaths in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: On Apr 30, 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reported a ninth chikungunya death and 79 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, with 2,755 confirmed and 5,271 probable; 2,516 under investigation and 2,100 discarded. The state reports 14 confirmed chikungunya deaths, about 70% of Brazil's 21. The latest victim is a 29-year-old Indigenous man from Aldeia Bororó who died this week; no comorbidities were reported. Indigenous territories account for most cases, with over 2,400 infections in communities of 20,000+. Among confirmed deaths, eight are Indigenous, including two infants and several adults. A 63-year-old non-Indigenous man with comorbidities died outside Indigenous territory on Apr 13. Three deaths remain under investigation: a 12-year-old Indigenous child; an 84-year-old non-Indigenous with coronary disease; and a 50-year-old man with no known comorbidities. Thirty-five people are hospitalized; CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, causing high fever and severe joint pain; lab tests via SUS.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスでチクングニア熱による9番目の死亡を記録。マットグロッソ・ドゥ・スル州がブラジル全体の死亡の66%を占める

triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列となります。ただし、記事内容は重大な感染症イベントを示しており、シグナルとしてのピックアップは適切と判断されます。先住民地域での高い死亡率（8/14確定死亡例）、短期間での急速な患者増加（79例/24時間）、複数の未解明死亡例が存在し、公衆衛生上の懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: हेलो डॉक्टर: गर्मी में बच्चों को टाइफाइड-डायरिया से बचाएं, दूषित भोजन और पानी से बढ़ रहा खतरा  - lucknow rising typhoid diarrhea in children from unhygienic food
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hello Doctor: Protect children from typhoid-diarrhea in summer; rising risk from contaminated food and water - Lucknow: rising typhoid-diarrhea in children from unhygienic food.
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, India reports a notable rise in pediatric typhoid and diarrhea as summer heat increases exposure to unhygienic street foods and contaminated water. In the past week, the number of children affected by typhoid and diarrhea rose by approximately 30%. The surge is attributed to open-air foods and tainted drinking water sold in markets, highlighting increased infection risk among children during hot months. No figures on deaths or laboratory-confirmation details are provided. The update emphasizes ongoing transmission risks tied to poor sanitation and hygiene, and calls for improved food safety and safe-water practices to curb infections in the summer season. Reported from Lucknow, by Jagran, the piece underscores a local public health concern related to street-vendor food exposure and water quality.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季の子どもたちをチフス・下痢から守ろう：汚染された食物と水からのリスク増加 - ラッキナウでの子どもたちにおけるチフス・下痢の増加が不衛生な食物から報告

triage.notes: 記事はHindi言語ソースであり、ラッキナウ（インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州）における小児チフスと下痢の増加を報告。1週間での30%増加率は注視に値するが、死亡例、検査確認数、地域外への拡大情報が不明確。夏季の季節性感染症として一般的な傾向の可能性もあり、さらなる情報追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: स्कूली छात्राओं को टीबी रोग के प्रति किया जागरूक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Awareness raised among schoolgirls about tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: TB awareness raised among schoolgirls in Araria, Bihar: At Plus Two Girls High School in Araria city, a 100-day TB campaign educated students on TB symptoms and prevention under the Prime Minister's TB-Free India drive. About 27,000 suspected individuals have been screened so far. The event was chaired by Head Master Dr. Yugesh Jha, with District TB Officer Dr. Akash Kumar Rai in attendance; District TB Coordinator Damodar Sharma outlined the program. Key early TB signs highlighted include persistent cough for two weeks, evening fever, loss of appetite, weight loss, chest pain, and coughing up blood in sputum. The initiative reflects ongoing public health efforts to eliminate TB in Bihar, promoting school-based outreach and early case finding.

article.articleHeadline: Paraíso em SC cobra taxa de R$ 200 e vive surto de diarreia em turistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paradise in Santa Catarina charges a 200 reais fee and experiences a diarrheal outbreak among tourists.
article.articleSummary: Bombinhas, Santa Catarina, Brazil—the ecotourism capital of diving with crystal-clear waters—faces a gastrointestinal illness surge among tourists in early 2026. Official health data show 409 presentations for acute diarrhea in the first week of the year, a 370% increase from 87 cases in the same period last season. The ongoing outbreak of gastrointestinal illness affects visitors to popular beaches including Quatro Ilhas Beach. Locals and visitors protest the use of Environmental Preservation Fee (TPA), which for large vehicles now costs up to R$200, amid concerns about sanitation. Videos circulating online show alleged sewage discharges into the sea at popular beaches, fueling debates about water quality and beach suitability. The report notes acute diarrheal illness and viral gastroenteritis, but does not mention laboratory-confirmed pathogens or a definite infection source.

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de São Paulo amplia vacinação contra dengue - 30/04/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of São Paulo expands dengue vaccination - April 30, 2026 - Balance and Health - Folha
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state expands dengue vaccination with Butantan-DV to 59-year-olds, starting May 4, 2026, across public and private health facilities, marking the first time the single-dose Butantan-DV is offered outside priority groups. The rollout also covers all health workers in public and private settings; estimated eligible 1.8 million. To receive the vaccine, individuals must prove healthcare employment. Primary care workers were eligible earlier in 2026. Butantan-DV, developed by Instituto Butantan, is a tetravalent dengue vaccine licensed by Anvisa in November 2025 for ages 12-59. Efficacy in 12-59: overall 74.7%, 91.6% against severe dengue, 100% against hospitalizations; protection lasts five years. The vaccine induces immunity to all four dengue serotypes. Vaccination sites: Basic Health Units (UBSs) and Ambulatory Medical Assistances (AMAs)/Integrated UBSs, weekdays 7:00-19:00, with weekend availability. Adolescents 10-14 remain eligible for QDenga with a two-dose schedule since April 2024.

article.articleHeadline: Norovírus: o vírus que causa surtos de gastroenterite - Portal Drauzio Varella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus: the virus that causes gastroenteritis outbreaks - Portal Drauzio Varella
article.articleSummary: Norovirus is the leading cause of viral gastroenteritis worldwide, responsible for about one-fifth of acute gastroenteritis and infectious diarrhea cases. Known as the 'stomach flu' (not influenza), it spreads via fecal-oral routes, contaminated water or food, and close contact; around 48 norovirus types exist. This year, outbreaks have been confirmed on the São Paulo coast and in Pelotas, Rio Grande do Sul, with schools, cruise ships, and crowded beaches repeatedly affected. Symptoms typically appear 12–48 hours after exposure and include abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea; dehydration is the major complication, especially in young children, the elderly, and the immunocompromised. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, surface disinfection, safe water, and avoiding raw or undercooked foods. Recovery is usually 1–3 days; treatment is supportive, with oral rehydration and IV fluids for severe dehydration if needed. Some individuals remain contagious for days to about two weeks after symptoms stop.

triage.headline_ja: ノロウイルス：胃腸炎のアウトブレイクを引き起こすウイルス

article.articleHeadline: Produto brasileiro ganha apoio internacional contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian product gains international support against malaria.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains one of the world's major public health challenges. A Brazil-developed product, Verniz Afastinsetos, created by chemical engineer Itamar Viana, has received official support from the Embassy of the Republic of Cameroon in Brazil to begin testing against Anopheles, the mosquito that transmits malaria. The product is already authorized by the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency (Anvisa) and validated under a protocol from the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). The initiative signals international interest in Brazil-origin vector-control technologies and potential expansion of malaria prevention tools. No specific case counts, outbreaks, or symptoms are reported in the article; the focus is regulatory clearance and diplomatic-backed testing for an anti-mosquito varnish aimed at reducing malaria transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル製品がマラリア対策で国際的支援を獲得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア予防製品（蚊忌避ニス）の開発・承認と国際的な試験計画に関するものであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク、患者数の増加、または公衆衛生危機を報告していない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア予防製品の開発・承認・試験計画についての報道であり、感染症イベント（患者増加、アウトブレイク、疾患の異常発生）ではない。ブラジルとカメルーンは外交的協力の文脈でのみ言及され、いずれの国でもマラリア発生の実態報告はない。対象国に該当する国の感染症イベント報告もないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Perú comparte su experiencia de prevención y control  del dengue en evento internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru shares its experience in the prevention and control of dengue at an international event.
article.articleSummary: Peru's Ministry of Health (Minsa), via the Office of International Technical Cooperation (OGCTI), presented Peru's dengue prevention and control experience at the international webinar 'Towards Dengue Vaccination at Scale: Lessons from Peru and Indonesia for Adoption, Integration and Impact', held during Vaccination Week in the Americas 2026 in Singapore. The session highlighted a focused dengue vaccine implementation and the innovative Wolbachia-based vector-control strategy to reduce transmission. Organized within the framework of the Americas Vaccination Week, the event aimed to share practical lessons for scaling dengue vaccination and integrating vector-control tools into national programs. Peru’s presentation underscores the combined use of targeted vaccination and Wolbachia deployment as key components of its dengue prevention and control portfolio, illustrating actionable steps for adoption and impact in similar settings.

article.articleHeadline: No podemos esperar": pasaron 20 días de la detección de una enfermedad exótica y en el sector ovino hay una fuerte preocupación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We can't wait": Twenty days have passed since the detection of an exotic disease, and in the sheep sector there is strong concern.
article.articleSummary: Scrapie classic confirmed in Argentina by Senasa, with three ovine cases in Santa Fe and Entre Ríos; twenty days on, export markets impose restrictions, raising sector alarm. Scrapie is a fatal neurodegenerative disease of sheep and goats and poses no human health risk, but endangers Argentina’s sanitary status and market access. Several destinations maintain partial or full bans on Argentine animal-origin products, including live animals, semen and embryos, meat and offal, meat-and-bone meal, fats, protein byproducts, animal feeds, and some dairy products; leather and unprocessed wool are also restricted. Chile, Peru, China, Mexico, Morocco, South Africa, and Vietnam have not fully reinstated imports. Senasa is pursuing bilateral talks to demonstrate containment, traceability, and regionalization, while exporters report halted shipments and costs. For instance, a bone-meal export to Vietnam/Peru was cancelled after a memo dated April 10, costing about US$45,000 for 12 containers; a dairy exporter halted 20 containers. Paraguay origin is suspected; calls for contingency plans and models from Australia, New Zealand, and the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 「待つことはできない」：エキゾチック病の検出から20日が経過し、羊産業で強い懸念
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンで確認されたScrapie（スクレイピー）は人間の健康リスクを持たない動物疾病であり、IHR基準では該当しない。ただし、複数国の輸出制限により国際的な経済影響と貿易摩擦が生じており、地域の疾病制御状況の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Scrapieは動物のみに感染する神経変性疾患であり、人間の健康リスクはない。記事の主要な懸念は経済的・貿易的影響である。複数国（チリ、ペルー、中国、メキシコ、モロッコ、南アフリカ、ベトナム）がアルゼンチン産動物由来製品の輸入制限を維持している。Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域の多くは、単なる輸出制限国または引用対象国であり、実際のScrapie発生地はアルゼンチンのみ。verified_locationsはアルゼンチンのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Kotapinang Police Conduct Fogging to Prevent Dengue Fever - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Kotapinang Police Sector (Polsek Kotapinang) conducts mass fogging to prevent Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DBD) transmission by Aedes aegypti. Fogging at the police headquarters (Mako) and surrounding residential areas aims to reduce the infection risk for officers and residents. Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever is a viral illness presenting with high fever, severe headache, joint and muscle pain; in severe cases, platelet depletion can cause internal bleeding. Fogging is a rapid vector-control method that kills adult mosquitoes on contact but does not affect larvae or pupae in water containers. As of 2026-04-30, long-term prevention requires integrated pest management and environmental cleanup to remove breeding sites—emptying flower pots, cleaning gutters, and covering water storage tanks. The initiative highlights collaboration between public safety and public health. The article does not report specific case or death counts.

article.articleHeadline: Comitê confirma 9ª morte por Chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Committee confirms 9th death from Chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Nine people have died from Chikungunya in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, the latest a 29-year-old Indigenous resident of Aldeia Bororó who first showed symptoms on April 19 and died on April 25 at Hospital da Vida. Total deaths reach nine, eight of them Indigenous. Earlier fatalities include a 69-year-old Indigenous (Feb 25), a 73-year-old man (Mar 9), a 3-month-old Indigenous infant (Mar 10), a 60-year-old Indigenous (Mar 12), a 77-year-old Indigenous (Mar 14), a 1-month-old infant (Mar 24), a 55-year-old Indigenous (Apr 3), and a 63-year-old Black man (Apr 13). Currently, 35 patients are hospitalized with chikungunya across health units. Dourados has 7,371 notifications: 5,271 probable, 2,755 confirmed, 2,100 discarded, 2,516 under investigation. In the Bororó and Jaguapiru villages, 3,113 notifications: 2,474 probable, 1,759 confirmed, 636 discarded, 715 under investigation. Authorities urge collective action to eliminate standing water and improve waste management to curb the Aedes aegypti vector.

triage.headline_ja: 委員会がドゥラドスでのチクングニア熱による9番目の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのドゥラドスでチクングニア熱による死亡例が9件確認され、そのうち8件が先住民。既に2,755件の確定症例と35件の入院患者がいるなど、重症度と長期曝露の基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 先住民（Aldeia Bororó、Jaguapiru villages）が特に被害を受けており、集団的な被害パターンが確認されている。ドゥラドスではアフリカヌスカアブラムシ（Aedes aegypti）ベクター対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta! Febre Oropouche tem primeiro caso com transmissão local e é transmitida por mosquito maruim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert! Oropouche fever has its first locally transmitted case and is transmitted by the maruim mosquito.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 April 2026, Goiás, Brazil, reported its first autochthonous case of Oropouche fever, in Anápolis, an adult male with March onset (dizziness, fever, red rash) and no travel history. The infection is transmitted by Culicoides paraensis, known as maruim. Clinical features resemble dengue; there is no specific therapy, and relapse is common—after 2-7 days of improvement, about half experience return of fever, headache, and myalgia for 1-2 weeks. Nationally in 2025 Brazil recorded about 12,000 cases and five deaths. The Goiás State Public Health Laboratory has processed over 6,000 samples for monitoring. Vector control emphasizes clearing yards of organic debris that sustain breeding, plus long-sleeved clothing and window screens. Officials urge vigilance and continued laboratory surveillance without panic to aid diagnosis and containment.

triage.headline_ja: 警報！オロポウシ熱が初の地域内伝播症例を記録、マルイム蚊によって伝播される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで新規の媒介蚊感染症（オロポウシ熱）の地域内伝播初症例が報告された。2025年に全国で約12,000症例・5死亡が記録されており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻で異常な事象であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: オロポウシ熱はブラジルで新興感染症として台頭している。地域内伝播の確認、媒介蚊（マルイム）の存在、2025年の全国症例数（12,000症例、5死亡）、そして再発率が高い臨床的特性により、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。WPRO地域外のイベントであるが、新興ウイルス感染症として国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Γρίπη των πτηνών και των χοίρων: 13 κρούσματα σε ανθρώπους τους πρώτους μήνες του 2026 - thetimes.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza and swine influenza: 13 human cases in the first months of 2026.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) reported 13 human cases of avian influenza (H5N1, H9N2) and swine influenza (H1N1v, H1N2v, H3N2v) in four countries during the first quarter of 2026. Bangladesh reported a child who died from H5N1 after exposure to household poultry; symptoms began Jan 21, hospital admission on Jan 28, death Feb 1, 2026. Cambodia reported three additional H5N1 cases. H9N2 infections totaled five—four in China, one in Italy. H1N1 infections were all in China. Swine influenza cases included three pediatric cases (H1N1v, H1N2v, H3N2v); two Chinese children with direct pig contact; one Brazilian boy in a rural school. Genetic analyses linked the Bangladeshi and other H5N1 infections to poultry viruses circulating since 2011. Overall population risk remains low, but those in frequent contact with poultry or pigs should be vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザと豚インフルエンザ：2026年最初の数か月間で人間に13件の症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数国での鳥インフルエンザH5N1死亡例、複数インフルエンザ亜型の同時報告、ヒト-ヒト感染への懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際のイベント発生国はバングラデシュ（H5N1死亡例）、中国（H9N2、H1N1、豚インフルエンザ複数例）、ブラジル（豚インフルエンザH1N1v事例）、カンボジア（H5N1 3例）の4か国。Bluedot発生地域にはイタリアが含まれているが、サマリーではH9N2 1例のみで限定的。カンボジアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。複数亜型の同時検出、死亡例、家畜接触による感染、遺伝解析による既知ウイルス系統との関連確認など、パンデミック準備段階での重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de raiva em morcego é confirmado em Cacoal, RO | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies case in a bat confirmed in Cacoal, Rondônia | G1
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a bat in Cacoal, Rondônia (RO), Brazil. The animal, found at the Instituto Federal de Rondônia (Ifro), exhibited atypical behavior including difficulty flying. Several students had contact; one student was scratched but is reported well. The bat was captured and sent to the Laboratório Central de Saúde Pública de Rondônia (Lacen) in Porto Velho, with the rabies virus confirmed in March this year. Authorities say the virus continues circulating in the municipality, and past years have seen infected animals in both urban and rural areas of Cacoal. A veterinarian notes the disease is fatal without proper prophylaxis, which, when performed correctly, is effective. Following confirmation, environmental health services will implement region-wide controls, including vaccination of dogs and cats within 12 kilometers of the discovery site. Public guidance: do not handle wildlife; seek health care immediately after any contact; suspicious daytime-active bats should be reported.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのカコアルで確認された蝙蝠の狂犬病症例
triage.triage_reason: 動物における狂犬病確認で予想外だが、人への直接被害は限定的（接触学生は無症状）。ただし都市部での循環継続の警告があり、続報が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内のRondônia州カコアル市での蝙蝠における狂犬病確認。接触した学生は軽度の外傷（掻き傷）のみで無症状報告。ただしサマリーは「ウイルスが市内を循環し続けている」と警告しており、都市部・農村部での継続的な発見実績がある。対象国（WPRO）ではなく南米事案のため、地域的検証からはWATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: A single swab is sufficient: Study paves the way for simplified tuberculosis diagnosis Led by researchers from Heidelberg Faculty of Medicine at Heidelberg University and the University of California, San Francisco (USA), an international research team has evaluated a novel approach for the diagnosis of tuberculosis. The method enables detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis without laboratory infrastructure, within a markedly shorter time frame than conventional diagnostics, and using a simple swab. The test demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy as well as feasibility for use by minimally trained personnel. The results, published in NEJM, made a significant contribution to the World Health Organization's decision to already recommend the global use of the diagnostic method.
article.articleSummary: TB diagnostic study from Heidelberg and UCSF evaluates a tongue-swab, near point-of-care test for Mycobacterium tuberculosis detectable in under 35 minutes using two portable devices: one lyses bacteria, the other performs molecular detection with visual positives/negatives. In a multicentre NEJM study of 1,380 individuals with suspected pulmonary TB across India, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, Vietnam, Zambia, and the Philippines, tongue swabs yielded 80% sensitivity and 99.5% specificity, comparable to sputum-based molecular assays. The test's performance and usability were robust for non-specialist users; most steps followed manufacturer instructions. WHO has recommended the test as the first near-point-of-care molecular TB diagnostic. Pilot implementation is planned with Global Fund and other partners. Benefits include simplicity, battery operation, lower costs, and applicability to patients unable to produce sputum (children, severely ill, HIV), aiding rapid detection of TB, a leading cause of >1 million deaths annually (2024).

triage.headline_ja: 単一のスワブで十分：結核診断の簡素化への道を開く研究 ハイデルベルク大学ハイデルベルク医学部とカリフォルニア大学サンフランシスコ校（USA）の研究者らが主導する国際研究チームが、結核診断の新しいアプローチを評価した。この方法により、実験室インフラなしに、従来の診断よりもはるかに短い時間枠で、単純なスワブを使用して結核菌を検出できる。このテストは高い診断精度と最小限の訓練を受けた人員による使用の実現可能性を実証した。NEJM に発表された結果は、世界保健機関がすでに診断方法の世界的使用を推奨することになった重要な貢献である。
triage.triage_reason: これは結核診断法の臨床的検証研究の発表であり、新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、研究成果の報道である。公開情報と医学的関心は高いが、IHR基準やWPROシグナル基準での「公衆衛生危機」の定義には該当しない。ただし対象国複数での実証研究という性質から、今後の実装段階でのシグナル発生の可能性として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、国際的多施設臨床研究の発表である。記事サマリーに記載されている7カ国（インド、ナイジェリア、南アフリカ、ウガンダ、ベトナム、ザンビア、フィリピン）のうち、対象国リストに含まれる5カ国を verified_locations に含めた。この診断法は WHO により推奨されており、将来的な実装段階でのシグナル発生の監視は有用であるが、現段階では通常の医学・公衆衛生ニュースの範疇である。

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കുൻഗുനിയ: വിദഗ്‌ധ സംഘം അഞ്ഞൂറോളം വീടുകൾ സന്ദർശിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: An expert team visited around three hundred houses.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak response in Kerala: An expert team under the Indian Council of Medical Research conducted field investigations in Chengamanad panchayat (Ward 1 and Ward 19) and Kunnukara gram panchayat (Wards 6, 7, and 9) after chikungunya cases were detected. Over the last two days, the team visited about 300 houses to identify new patients and assess the health status of those under treatment, as well as screen for any co-existing health issues and provide treatment guidance. The operation will continue for two more days. Ward-level squads will be formed to locate and destroy mosquito breeding sites to interrupt transmission. Participants include Dr. Kimberly D’Souza, Dr. P. Arthi, Anju Baby; Chengamanad Government Hospital doctors; public health and health block workers; and nursing students from Chalak Sri Narayanan Medical College.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア：専門家チームが約300軒の家屋を訪問
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーラ州でのチクングニア感染症の流行対応であり、IHR基準では異常性と国際拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では複数基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に該当する。対象国インドでの流行事例として直接対応が必要。
triage.notes: ケーラ州でのチクングニア感染症の流行対応が進行中。インド医学研究評議会傘下の専門家チームが300戸以上の家屋訪問調査を実施。蚊の繁殖地の破壊を含む感染制御活動が展開されている。ベクター媒介感染症の季節的流行パターンに適合。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Jundiaí registra caso de gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Jundiaí records a case of avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: City of Jundiaí, Brazil, confirmed an avian influenza case in a wild Neotropical cormorant (biguá) admitted to the Mata Ciliar Association. The bird arrived April 25, died the same day, and is reported to have originated from a neighboring municipality. On the day of death, samples were collected and Influenza A testing yielded a positive result on April 30. Avian influenza is a viral disease that primarily affects wild and domestic birds. Mata Ciliar staff with contact to the bird are being monitored by Jundiaí Epidemiological Surveillance. The report notes ongoing surveillance and laboratory confirmation. The case involves an imported wild bird from another locality, and the investigation focuses on potential exposure and containment; no human cases are described in the brief, but exposure monitoring is in place.

triage.headline_ja: ジュンジャイ市、トリインフルエンザの症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 野生鳥類（ネオトロピカルウミウ）におけるインフルエンザA陽性が確認されたが、人間への感染は報告されておらず、現在の段階では公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。動物でのアウトブレイクの初期段階として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生鳥類における限定的なインフルエンザA陽性確認。人間への感染なし、局所的な疫学監視が実施中。野生鳥類でのアウトブレイク初期段階のため、人獣共通感染リスクの監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária mata biguá em Jundiaí (SP) | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza kills biguá in Jundiaí, São Paulo | G1.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (influenza A) caused the death of a wild biguá (a waterfowl also known as mergulhão or cormorant) at Mata Ciliar in Jundiaí, São Paulo state, Brazil, on April 25. Laboratory results released on April 30 confirmed infection as the cause; the bird exhibited neurological symptoms prior to death. The animal had been found in a neighboring municipality and brought to Mata Ciliar on the day it died. Municipal Epidemiological Surveillance is monitoring staff with contact to the bird; no human infections have been reported to date. Avian influenza circulates among wild and domestic birds since the 1990s, with influenza A posing higher risk to people working with contaminated birds, though there is no confirmed human-to-human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがジュンディアイのビグアを殺す（サンパウロ州）| G1
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物での鳥インフルエンザA型確認は公衆衛生上の懸念を示すが、現在のところ人間感染は報告されておらず、現地の監視体制が確立されている。継続的な人間感染の発生を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 野生動物（水鳥）での鳥インフルエンザA型の確認。人間への感染リスクは低いが、ヒト感染の可能性がある病原体のため警戒が必要。接触者の監視が実施されている。1990年代から鳥類間で循環しているが、本件は確認された具体的な死亡事例として報告価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de leishmaniose caem quase 50% no Ceará em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis cases fall by nearly 50% in Ceará in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ceará, Brazil, records a near 50% reduction in leishmaniasis cases in 2026 compared with 2025. By April 2026, Fortaleza has seven cases—the highest local count—followed by the Metropolitan Region’s Maracanaú with three cases. In 2025, Fortaleza led with 49 cases. In 2026, males predominate (25 cases, 73.5%), while females total 9 (26.5%). Fatalities: 2025 saw 13 deaths, with Sobral accounting for three; January–April 2026 records one death, also in Sobral. The report highlights current concentrations in Fortaleza and Sobral and a statewide decline in Ceará for 2026, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年セアラ州のリーシュマニア症患者が前年比でほぼ50%減少
triage.triage_reason: リーシュマニア症患者数が大幅に減少する好ましい傾向であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし、また異常な流行拡大やWPRO警戒基準該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はセアラ州におけるリーシュマニア症患者の減少トレンドを報じているもので、新規の流行発生やアウトブレイクではない。2025年から2026年4月にかけて患者数が約50%減少しており、公衆衛生的に肯定的な傾向を示している。死亡者数も減少（2025年13人→2026年1～4月1人）。対象国リストではBrazil（3469034）のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Com 14 óbitos, MS alcança 5.214 casos confirmados de chikungunya em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 14 deaths, Mato Grosso do Sul reaches 5,214 confirmed Chikungunya cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil, reached 5,214 confirmed cases in 2026, with 8,894 probable cases, per the 16th epidemiological week SES report published 2026-04-30. Four municipalities—Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, and Fátima do Sul—account for 14 chikungunya deaths, most with comorbidities; two additional deaths are under investigation. Fifty-two pregnant women in MS have confirmed chikungunya, necessitating closer maternal-fetal monitoring. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and causes high fever, severe joint and muscle pain, red spots, and fatigue; joint pain can persist for months. Dengue activity: 655 confirmed and 4,779 probable cases, with no dengue-related deaths reported. In the last 14 days, several municipalities show low dengue incidence, suggesting reduced transmission. Vaccination against dengue: 223,322 doses administered of 241,030 received; the two-dose schedule with a three-month interval targets 10–14-year-olds. Prevention emphasizes eliminating mosquito breeding sites; avoid self-medication and seek care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 14人の死亡者を伴い、マットグロッソドスル州は2026年にチクングニア感染症の5,214例を確認
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア感染症の大規模集団発生（5,214例確認、14人死亡）がブラジルで進行中。IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な感染数増加）し、妊婦を含む特殊集団への影響、蚊媒介感染症の国際拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ブラジル、マットグロッソドスル州で進行中の大規模チクングニア感染症流行。確認症例5,214例、死亡14例、妊婦52例が確認されており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。同時にデング熱も655例確認されており、ベクター媒介感染症の複合流行状況。WPRO基準は本評価対象地域（南米）ではないが、IHR基準で判定。

article.articleHeadline: Argentina Chikungunya Cases Surpass 1,500 in 2026 - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports a chikungunya fever surge with cases across the country. As of 30 April 2026, the Ministry of Health lists 1,109 confirmed and probable chikungunya cases (1,003 autochthonous, 106 travel-associated from Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Cuba). A week earlier (week of 15 April 2026) added 272 cases. About 93% of cases are in the Northwest region, with the most affected provinces including Salta and Tucumán (the latter with 23 autochthonous cases showing local transmission), Córdoba (24), Buenos Aires Province (38), and the City of Buenos Aires (8). Isolated cases appear in Entre Ríos (2), Santa Fe (1), San Luis (2) and Chaco (1). Reports indicate local transmission linked to imported cases from Bolivia; surveillance and vector-control measures are urged as mosquito activity rises in summer/early autumn. Symptoms include fever, myalgia, headache, polyarthralgia and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチン チクングニア熱の症例数が2026年に1,500件を超える
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の国内流行拡大（1,109確認症例、地元伝播あり）、複数州への拡散、蚊ベクターの季節的増加によるさらなる拡大リスク。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでのチクングニア熱流行であるが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、ボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバからの輸入症例が報告されており、ブラジルは対象国。地域内での地元伝播確認、複数州での拡散、蚊ベクター活動の季節的増加がリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 生吃猪肉可能感染哪些寄生虫，具体有什么危害？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What parasites may be contracted from eating raw pork, and what specific health hazards do they pose?
article.articleSummary: Three deadly parasites may be contracted from raw pork: Taenia solium (pork tapeworm), Trichinella spiralis, and Toxoplasma gondii. Taenia solium larvae form rice-grain nodules in pork; ingestion can lead to intestinal worms and, more dangerously, eggs/larvae that invade brain, eyes, and muscles. Brain cysticercosis accounts for 70–91% of cysticercosis in China, causing epilepsy and paralysis; ocular infection can cause vision loss. Trichinella spiralis encysts in muscle and resists ordinary freezing; fever, eyelid edema, and severe myositis typically appear within two weeks; a Yunnan outbreak infected over 60 people, with multiple deaths. Toxoplasma gondii spreads via undercooked pork and risks miscarriage or fetal abnormalities in pregnant women, and encephalitis or pneumonia in the immunocompromised. Pork is riskier than other meats due to pig's omnivory and parasite adaptations. Cook to ≥75°C, avoid meat with nodules, prevent cross-contamination, and high-risk groups should avoid raw pork; seek medical care for neurological or ocular symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 生の豚肉から感染する可能性のある寄生虫は何か、具体的な危害は何か？
triage.triage_reason: 中国雲南州でTrichinella spiralisによる集団発症（60人以上、複数の死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）を満たし、かつWPRO基準（重症度、流行性）に該当する。脳嚢虫症は中国で70-91%の症例を占める重大な公衆衛生課題。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明示された雲南州での集団発症事例（Trichinella spiralis、60人以上感染、複数死亡）とそれに関連する中国における脳嚢虫症の高い罹患率（70-91%）が主要なシグナル。食品安全に関連する環境的・行動的な長期曝露リスク（生肉食習慣）が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Com epidemia em 23 cidades, MS registra mais de 1,2 mil casos de chikungunya em 7 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul reports more than 1,200 chikungunya cases in 7 days across 23 cities.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreaks continue in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 1,295 probable cases reported in the last seven days, raising the incidence to 322.6 per 100,000 population. For 2026, the state has 3,997 confirmed chikungunya cases and 4,897 awaiting laboratory results, totaling 8,894 probable cases, up 17 percent from the previous week. Itaporã and Iguatemi joined the epidemic list, bringing the number of affected municipalities to 23; top incidence is in Sete Quedas, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Paraíso das Águas and Jardim. Dourados recorded another chikungunya death, bringing state fatalities to 14; nationwide total is 21 with two more deaths under investigation. Several towns approach epidemic thresholds, including Maracaju and Laguna Carapã. The capital Campo Grande shows low transmission at 1.6 per 100,000 with 14 probable cases. Public health guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water and other mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソドスール州が7日間で1,200件以上のチクングニア患者を報告、23都市で流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：高い発症率と死亡者、予想外：流行の拡大と新規地域追加、国際拡大リスク：ベクターボーン感染症の性質）。ブラジルは対象国であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマットグロッソドスール州に限定されたチクングニア流行を報告している。1週間で1,295例の新規患者、23都市への拡大、14例の州内死亡記録、高い発症率（322.6/10万人）は深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆。蚊媒介感染症の性質上、国際拡大の潜在的リスクがある。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはブラジル内の複数の都市が含まれているが、検証対象国リストでブラジルのみが該当するため verified_locations はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo amplia vacinação contra a dengue e libera Butantan-DV para a população geral de 59 anos - Correio Regional São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo expands dengue vaccination and makes Butantan-DV available to the general population aged 59 - Correio Regional São Paulo
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state expands dengue vaccination (Butantan-DV) to health workers in public and private settings and to the general population aged 59, effective 04 May, targeting about 1.8 million people. Developed by Instituto Butantan, the world’s first single-dose dengue vaccine provides protection against all four serotypes. Since February, 129,563 doses have been administered; the state has received 292,215 doses via the National Immunization Program. As of 30 April, 33,877 dengue cases and 13 deaths have been recorded this year; 2025 saw 885,511 cases and 1,133 deaths. Efficacy in ages 12–59 is 74.7% overall and 91.6% against severe dengue with warning signs, based on a phase 3 trial of over 16,000 volunteers across 14 states (2016–2024); results published in The New England Journal of Medicine and The Lancet Infectious Diseases. The vaccine is considered safe, with mostly mild adverse events. Guidance advises against co-administration with other vaccines to avoid ESAVI, with intervals: 24 hours after inactivated vaccines and 30 days after attenuated vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州がデング熱ワクチン接種を拡大し、ブタンタン-DVを59歳以上の一般人口に提供開始
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはデング熱ワクチン接種プログラムの拡大に関する公衆衛生政策ニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク検出ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジル（対象国外）の予防接種プログラム拡大に関するニュースであり、対象国リストに含まれない。過去の感染症統計（デング熱発症例と死亡数）は記載されているが、新規のアウトブレイク通知や異常な感染症イベントではなく、予防医学的アクションである。シグナル検出対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng, COVID-19 gia tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, and COVID-19 on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health reports April 2026 infectious-disease activity rising nationwide. Dengue fever: 6,408 cases and 1 death in April; since mid-December 2025, 44,965 cases and 5 deaths (up 1.8× in cases, 2× in deaths vs year ago). Hand-foot-mouth disease: 11,808 cases and 3 deaths in April; cumulative 34,432 cases, 8 deaths (about 2.5× higher). Influenza: 17,894 cases in April; no deaths; year-to-date 52,865, down 15.1% vs 2025. COVID-19: 302 cases in April; no deaths; cumulative 356 cases, 1 death (up 4.4×). Measles-like rash: 697 cases in April; no deaths; cumulative 3,127 (down 26.9×). Regional distribution: South 4,420 (63.2%), North 1,929 (27.5%), Central 530 (7.5%), Northwest 127 (1.8%). Notable: a 19-year-old dengue patient with obesity survived after three shock episodes within 24 hours in Vung Tau. Food poisoning: 7 outbreaks, 349 ill; Salmonella-linked outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City (185 on 8-4); 27 outbreaks since 18-12-2025, 849 ill, 3 deaths. May plan emphasizes enhanced surveillance, border/community monitoring, and stricter food-safety enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、手足口病、COVID-19が増加
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症における国内的な増加傾向が報告されており、特にデング熱と手足口病では前年比で有意な増加（1.8〜2.5倍）が確認されている。異常・予想外の疾病活動がWPROスクリーニング基準を満たし、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ベトナム保健省の公式レポートに基づく複数感染症の同時増加。デング熱（前年比1.8倍の症例、2倍の死亡）と手足口病（2.5倍増）が特に顕著。5月の強化サーベイランスと国境監視が実施予定であることから、政府の認識度は高い。ホーチミンとブンタウに具体的な患者報告があり、国内の複数地域で感染症活動の拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-country outbreak of mpox, External situation report #65 - 30 April 2026
article.articleSummary: Mpox (MPXV) continues multi-country transmission, largely within sexual networks and households, with all clades circulating. By March 2026, 48 countries reported 1,235 confirmed cases and five deaths (CFR 0.4%), about 70% of cases in the WHO African Region. Outside Africa, declines occurred in the Americas, Africa, Europe and Southeast Asia, while the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific reported increases. In Africa, 16 countries had active transmission in the past six weeks (9 March–19 April 2026): 969 cases, three deaths (CFR 0.3%), led by Madagascar, DR Congo, Guinea, Kenya, and Burundi. First-time reports of clade Ib mpox were in Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador, Singapore, Argentina, Germany, Portugal, Spain, and the UK, including community transmission among men who have sex with men; Poland and Slovakia reported clade I pending subclade. Pakistan’s Sindh province reports a healthcare-associated mpox outbreak with 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%), including many infants under six months.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の多国間流行、外部状況報告第65号 - 2026年4月30日
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの多国間流行が継続し、アフリカ地域では48ヶ国で1,235確認症例、5死亡が報告されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当。対象国のDRC、ギニア、ケニア、ブルンジで活発な伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが48ヶ国を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーは多国間流行の統計報告であり、対象国リスト内で実際にMpox活動が明記されているのはDRCのみ。ただし、ギニア、ケニア、ブルンジは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。パキスタン（Sindh州）のヘルスケア関連アウトブレイク（29症例、8死亡、CFR 28%）は記事に明記されているが、パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng tăng trong tháng 4
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and hand, foot, and mouth disease increase in April.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health reports April 2026 saw increases in dengue fever and hand–foot–mouth disease, with concurrent meningococcal meningitis and viral encephalitis activity. In April nationwide, dengue: 6,408 cases, 1 death; year-to-date through April about 45,000 cases and 5 deaths, up 1.8 times from 2025. Hand–foot–mouth disease: 11,808 cases and 3 deaths in April; cumulative 34,400 cases and 8 deaths, more than 2.5 times higher than 2025. Predominantly affects children 1–5. Lab results indicate circulation of Enterovirus 71 (EV71), a virulent strain linked to severe neurological complications. Meningococcal meningitis had 5 cases and 2 deaths in April; cumulative 26 cases and 4 deaths, higher than 2025. Viral encephalitis: 25 cases in April; cumulative 106 cases, 1 death. Influenza nearly 17,900 in April; measles-like rash 697; no deaths. Rabies: 20 deaths year-to-date, down 4. Authorities will continue close monitoring at communities and border gates to detect and respond quickly.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と手足口病が4月に増加
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重大な感染症の同時流行（デング熱、手足口病、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎、脳炎）で、死亡を含む重症例が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常な増加傾向）を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、特にEV71を含む脳炎との関連で管理可能性の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ベトナム保健省による公式報告。4月単月でデング熱6,408例（1死亡）、手足口病11,808例（3死亡）、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎5例（2死亡）、脳炎25例（1死亡）が報告されている。年初からの累積では前年比で大幅な増加（デング熱1.8倍、手足口病2.5倍以上）。EV71の検出による神経合併症リスクが懸念される。主に1～5歳の小児が影響を受けている。複数の感染症の同時流行と増加傾向が国の公衆衛生上の課題として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: 医生从患者身上拔出 17 只蜱虫！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor Removes 17 Ticks From a Patient!
article.articleSummary: On May 1, 2026, doctors at Anhui Medical University Fourth Affiliated Hospital treated a severe bunyavirus infection (tick-borne disease) in a patient who developed fatigue, fever, and poor appetite after tick bites. Thirteen ticks were removed from the lower abdomen and chest/back, with four more found during hair cleansing. Ticks can embed painlessly; their mouthparts inject anesthetic, allowing feeding and growth from sesame-seed to soybean size. Early symptoms resemble influenza, with fever up to 40°C; prompt treatment is crucial. Do not forcibly pull ticks; use pointed tweezers to grasp the head and pull vertically, then disinfect and seek professional care if possible. Monitor 2–4 weeks for fever or rash. China CDC warns May Day holidays bring higher tick activity. Prevention during outdoor activity includes wearing light-colored long-sleeved shirts and pants, tucking pant legs into socks, avoiding sandals, applying DEET-based repellent, and inspecting scalp, ears, armpits, navel, and inner thighs after return.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が患者から17匹のダニを摘出！
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介ブニヤウイルス感染症（ダニ刺咬症）の単一症例報告であり、IHR基準は2つ未満。ただし中国CDCの公開警告と予防啓発が含まれており、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例報告だが、中国CDCの季節的警告と公衆衛生啓発を含む。GWによるダニ活動の増加リスク、予防ガイダンスの提供があり、社会的・政府的関心が高い。ただしアウトブレイク段階ではなく、監視継続が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Rising Global Mpox Threat Sparks Fresh Alarm Across Continents - Thailand Medical News
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) remains circulating globally per WHO outbreak report through 30 April 2026. As of March 2026, 1,235 confirmed mpox cases in 48 countries with 5 deaths (CFR 0.4%). Declines in the Americas, Africa, Europe and Asia since February contrast with rising Eastern Mediterranean activity. In Africa, 16 countries reported active transmission from March to mid-April 2026 (969 cases, 3 deaths), with Madagascar, DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi most affected. New clades Ib detected outside Africa in Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore; clade I in Poland and Slovakia. Outside Africa, Ib transmissions noted in Argentina, Germany, Spain and the United Kingdom among men who have sex with men. Pakistan’s Sindh reports a healthcare-associated mpox outbreak with 29 cases and 8 deaths (CFR 28%). A rare recombinant Ib/IIb case linked to Qatar travel recovered with no secondary transmission. The report calls for coordinated global action: surveillance, vaccination, infection control, and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的なエムポックス脅威の高まりが大陸全体で新たな警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（公衆衛生への重大な影響、複数国での国際的拡大、複数死亡例報告）。WPROスクリーニング基準全項目該当。複数の対象国での確認により国際的なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月30日時点のWHOアウトブレイク報告書に基づく。48カ国での確認、5名の死亡（CFR 0.4%）、パキスタン・シンド州での医療関連アウトブレイク（CFR 28%）が特に懸念。新規クレードIbはアフリカ外での検出が報告されている。対象国のうち、DRCはアフリカ内での最も影響を受けた国の1つとして明示。インドについては対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー内では明示的なインド国内での発生が述べられていないため、DRCのみに限定することが適切。再評価：verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura realiza drive-thru de vacinação contra chikungunya nesta sexta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall holds a drive-thru vaccination against chikungunya this Friday
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya drive-thru vaccination held in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, on International Workers’ Day (May 1, 2026) from 8:00 to 12:00 at the City Hall courtyard on Rua Coronel Ponciano. Part of COE strategies to fight an ongoing chikungunya epidemic; aims to increase vaccination access for adults 18–59 without contraindications, with a 3–5 minute pre-vaccination triage. Vaccine developed by Instituto Butantan in partnership with Valneva. Health Secretary Marcio Figueiredo notes low uptake at usual vaccination sites and positions the drive-thru as an option for working individuals. By May 1, Dourados reported 7,208 chikungunya notifications: 5,195 probable, 2,676 confirmed, 2,013 discarded, 2,519 under investigation; Reserva Indígena totals: 3,066 notifications, 2,427 probable, 1,708 confirmed, 639 discarded, 719 under investigation. Contraindications include pregnancy, immunosuppression, recent chemotherapy/radiation, BMI >30, acute fever; regular unit hours vary, with a plan to administer about 43,000 doses (~27% of target) over ~40 days.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所が金曜日にチクングニア熱ワクチン接種のドライブスルーを実施
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のチクングニア熱流行への対応としてのワクチン接種キャンペーン報道。流行の重症度や拡大リスクに関する詳細情報が不足しており、PICKUP判定の基準達成が不確実なため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（ダウラドス市、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）での進行中のチクングニア熱流行に対するワクチン接種キャンペーン報道。5月1日時点で7,208件の通知（確定例2,676件）が報告されており、地域流行が継続している。ただし、IHR基準の国際的拡大やWHO通知相当の基準達成の有無が不明瞭。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（継続的な流行）と「流行しやすさ」（ヒト-ヒト感染可能な病原体）で2項目該当。情報不足のため、より詳細なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 繼越南取證、泰國送審後！高端腸病毒 EV71 疫苗再向菲律賓提交新藥審查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following Vietnam's clearance and Thailand's submission for review! The high-end Enterovirus EV71 vaccine again submits for New Drug Application review in the Philippines.
article.articleSummary: Envacgen Enterovirus 71 vaccine (EV71) has formally filed a New Drug Application with the Philippine FDA, following approvals in Vietnam and a submission in Thailand; within a week, Southeast Asia saw two NDA filings for the high-end vaccine via strategic partners. In the Philippines, 2025 enterovirus outbreaks had nearly 40,000 cases by August, a more-than-sixfold YoY rise; roughly 1.36 million babies are born each year, and no EV71 vaccine is licensed locally. Envacgen could offer active immunization for children aged 2 months through under 6 years. Phase 3 multicenter trials reported 100% efficacy against circulating Southeast Asian genotypes and durable protection with antibodies lasting over five years; results published in Vaccines and peer-reviewed in The Lancet, with experts underscoring pre-exposure vaccination in 2–6 month-olds and durability after a third dose. Taiwan licensed Envacgen earlier; prospects include Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines NDA submissions.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの承認とタイの申請の後に続く！高度なエンテロウイルス EV71 ワクチンがフィリピンで新薬審査申請を再度提出
triage.triage_reason: EV71ワクチンの規制申請に関する記事であり、疾病の流行拡大やアウトブレイク対応の緊急性よりも、医療製品の承認プロセスに焦点が当たっている。フィリピンでの2025年の腸ウイルスアウトブレイク（約40,000例）は報告されているが、現在の流行状況の詳細は不明。
triage.notes: 本記事は現在のアウトブレイク対応というより、医療製品（EV71ワクチン）の規制申請プロセスについての報道。フィリピンでの2025年の腸ウイルスアウトブレイク（40,000例超、前年比6倍以上）が言及されているが、これは過去の流行データであり、現在の継続的な流行リスクの評価には情報不足。ワクチン開発・承認の進展自体はパブリックヘルスポジティブだが、シグナルトリアージの対象は感染症危機の探知である。

article.articleHeadline: Orang Dewasa Kena Campak, Kondisi seperti Apa yang Perlu ke Dokter?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adults Contract Measles: What Kind of Condition Requires a Doctor's Visit?
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, adults with measles should seek medical evaluation, per Dr. Erpryta Nurdia Tetrasiwi of Eka Hospital MT Haryono in Jakarta, Indonesia. Adults with measles should still see a doctor because complications can be numerous. During examination, clinicians assess the lungs to rule out pneumonia, one of the serious measles complications; they also check for potential secondary infections such as brain inflammation (encephalitis), heart problems, and even vision loss. If no secondary infection is found, patients may be discharged to isolate at home to prevent transmission. Treatment is symptom-driven: fever is managed with paracetamol; in severe cases, hospital admission is advised. Treatment is individualized; some patients with good immunity may require only about two days of hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: 成人の麻疹：医師の受診が必要な状態とは？
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹と脳炎の2つの疾患が報告されており、成人での麻疹発症と合併症リスク（肺炎、脳炎など）が強調されている。ただし記事は医学的啓発色が強く、発生規模、患者数、流行状況に関する具体的情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタの医師による成人麻疹患者の臨床管理に関する啓発記事であり、患者数や流行規模など定量的なシグナル情報が明記されていない。麻疹と脳炎の両疾患が言及されているが、脳炎が麻疹の合併症として位置づけられている可能性が高い。IHR基準は該当するが、具体的な発生状況が不明であるため、WATCHレベルでの経過観察が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Científicos quieren frenar al dengue con drones: buscan detectar criaderos ocultos de mosquitos y prevenir enfermedades antes de que se propaguen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists want to curb dengue with drones: they aim to detect hidden mosquito breeding grounds and prevent diseases before they spread.
article.articleSummary: As part of a study spearheaded by Stanford University and tested in Makassar, Indonesia, drones with AI detect hidden breeding grounds of Aedes aegypti to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya outbreaks. In a four-square-kilometer pilot, the drones detected nearly double the number of breeding sites compared with traditional ground inspections. The system uses high-resolution aerial cameras and AI models trained to recognize water-collecting objects such as discarded tires, buckets, and unused containers, including those on rooftops, inner courtyards, and in dense vegetation. This approach aims to bolster urban epidemiological surveillance, complementing house-to-house inspections, which are labor-intensive. Potential enhancements include multispectral sensors to identify additional water reservoirs and applicability across different climates. By addressing climate-change-driven expansion of Ae. aegypti, drone-based detection could be integrated into public health programs to anticipate and prevent widespread dengue outbreaks in dense cities.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者はドローンでデング熱を抑制したい：蚊の隠れた繁殖地を検出し、病気が蔓延する前に予防することを目指す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の研究パイロットプロジェクトの報告だが、現在の発生流行状況ではなく、新しい防止技術の試験的取り組みについての記事である。異常な疾病発生や公衆衛生への即座の脅威の報告ではないため、シグナルと判定するには情報不足である。
triage.notes: 記事はスタンフォード大学とインドネシア・マカッサルで実施されたドローンとAI技術を用いたデング熱予防のパイロット研究に関する報道である。デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は西太平洋地域で流行しやすい疾患であるが、本記事は新技術開発の進展報告であり、現在の感染症発生危機の報告ではない。経過観察対象とするが、フルRRA対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil e África do Sul firmam memorando para ampliar cooperação agropecuária, combater febre aftosa e abrir caminho para mais comércio bilateral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil and South Africa sign a memorandum of understanding to broaden agricultural and livestock cooperation, combat foot-and-mouth disease, and pave the way for greater bilateral trade.
article.articleSummary: Brazil and South Africa signed a Memorandum of Understanding to broaden agricultural and livestock cooperation, with emphasis on sanitary defense, fighting foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), prevention of animal diseases, technical exchange, and expanded bilateral trade. The agreement between Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture and Pecuária (MAPA) and South Africa's Department of Agriculture aims to deepen agropecuary cooperation, including a plan of action to tackle FMD through prevention, control, and eradication, with vaccination, post-vaccination surveillance, and field evidence generation, plus a regional focus on avian influenza within the sanitary agenda. South Africa seeks to adopt a regional approach to FMD inspired by Brazil, noting economic impacts from southern Africa. Brazil notes international recognition as FMD-free without vaccination by the OIE. The talks also target expanded trade in animal proteins and citrus fruits, and potential bilateral vaccination agreements and knowledge sharing to strengthen sanitary measures and regionalization for avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルと南アフリカが農畜産協力の強化、口蹄疫対策、二国間貿易拡大に向けた覚書に署名
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫とトリインフルエンザの地域的な管理協力を扱う政策文書であり、社会的関心と政府関心は高いが、現在の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、予防的な二国間協力枠組みに重点が置かれている。情報不足により確定的なシグナル判定は保留すべき。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルと南アフリカ（対象国リスト外）間の農畜産協力覚書の署名を報道するもので、現在の流行を報告していない。口蹄疫とトリインフルエンザは流行易の高い疾患として識別されているが、アウトブレイク自体の深刻度、拡大の可能性、管理可能性に関する具体的な情報は欠けている。続報でアウトブレイク状況の悪化や拡大兆候が報告される場合は判定を変更する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Case filed against four doctors in Kerala over death of 7-year-old due to rabies
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, police filed an FIR against four doctors of Punalur Taluk Hospital and its superintendent after the death of seven-year-old Nia Faisal from rabies, despite vaccination. The child, from Kunnikod in Kollam district, was bitten by a stray dog on April 8, 2025. She received preventive treatment at Vilakkudi's Family Health Centre and the final dose scheduled for May 6, 2025. A fever preceded admission to Punalur Taluk Hospital and later Thiruvananthapuram SAT hospital, where rabies was laboratory-confirmed. She died May 5, 2025 during treatment at SAT. Police allege negligence in administering immunoglobulin; the superintendent is charged with providing inaccurate information under RTI and destroying evidence, while the doctors face charges of careless treatment. The Punalur First Class Judicial Magistrate Court directed the FIR following the mother's complaint, Habira.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州で狂犬病による7歳児死亡をめぐり4人の医師に対し訴訟提起
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡事例だが、個別の医療過誤事件であり、公衆衛生的な流行や集団発生の兆候がない。情報が限定的であり、予防措置（ワクチン接種）が実施されていた点でも拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病による死亡事例は深刻だが、本事象は医療過誤に関する個別訴訟事件が主体であり、地域の流行を示唆する情報がない。患者は予防接種を受けていたが効果不十分だったもので、感染症の広範な拡大リスクは認められない。社会的・政治的関心は医療過誤問題に焦点が当たっているため。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa đến sớm, nhiều ca nặng ở người bệnh nền và lưu ý khi "tự chẩn đoán" bằng AI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu arrives early, with many severe cases among people with underlying conditions, and caution about self-diagnosis using AI.
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, influenza season in northern Vietnam is arriving earlier than usual, with a notable rise in severe cases among patients with underlying conditions. Hospitals report patients presenting with chest tightness and shortness of breath requiring oxygen therapy or mechanical ventilation; fatalities have occurred in this high‑risk group. Typical influenza symptoms include high fever, headache, myalgia, plus respiratory signs such as runny nose and cough. Disease often progresses to severe illness around days 7–10; healthy individuals recover with symptomatic care, whereas those with comorbidities may experience prolonged fever and rapid respiratory deterioration. Vaccination is advised, with two seasonal peaks in Vietnam (May–Jul and Nov–Jan); optimal timing is March–April and October–November. High‑risk groups (age >65, pregnant women, people with diabetes, COPD, asthma, chronic liver disease) should receive yearly flu vaccine. Do not rely on AI for diagnosis or treatment; seek medical evaluation, and practice prevention (masks, hand hygiene, reduced crowd exposure).

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが早期到来、基礎疾患のある患者で重症例が多数、AIによる自己診断への注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性インフルエンザの早期流行と重症例増加が報告されているが、既知の季節的パターンの範囲内と判断される。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの季節性インフルエンザの早期流行と重症化傾向を報告しており、IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準4つ全て該当している。しかし季節性インフルエンザは既知の疾患であり、国内の高リスク集団における重症化は予想範囲内の可能性がある。国際的な懸念や外部支援の必要性については明記されていない。医療施設からの報告に基づく内容だが、パンデミック対応が必要な段階かは現在の情報では判断不可。続報により症例数、致死率、医療逼迫度等の詳細が判明した場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: New Coronavirus Found in Bats: Pandemic Risk? - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Kenyan scientists have identified a novel coronavirus in bats in Kenya, detected through ongoing wildlife surveillance. The virus can enter human cells via the ACE2 receptor, the same mechanism used by SARS-CoV-2, raising questions about spillover risk though no human infections have been reported. The Kenyan finding follows reports of HKU5-CoV-2 in bats in China, which also uses ACE2 for cell entry; again, no human cases to date. News outlets including Linfo.re, Le Monde, and Medisite.fr cover the surveillance-driven discovery. The U.S. CDC says there is currently no public health justification for concern, but monitoring continues. Researchers emphasize the importance of surveillance of bat populations and studying viral entry mechanisms to inform pandemic preparedness. A Nature article by Gallo et al. on alphacoronavirus receptors reinforces the need for vigilant surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリで発見された新規コロナウイルス：パンデミックリスク？
triage.triage_reason: ケニアおよび中国でコウモリから新規コロナウイルスが検出されたが、現在のところ人への感染報告はなく、米国CDCは公衆衛生上の懸念は不要と判断。監視継続の必要性は認識されるが、リスク評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニアと中国でのコウモリからのウイルス検出が主題。米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文上での米国でのイベント発生ではなく、CDCの見解言及のみのため、verified_locationsから除外。現在のところ人への感染報告がなく、パンデミック段階ではないが、動物疫学監視の重要性と将来のリスク評価の観点から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: População de Dourados (MS) começa a receber vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Dourados (MS) begin receiving the chikungunya vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Residents of Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, began chikungunya vaccination amid a local outbreak that led the municipality to declare a public health calamity. The 18–59 age group is targeted, with a drive-thru vaccination on May 1 from 8:00 to 12:00 at the Prefeitura de Dourados, aiming to immunize about 43,000 people (27% of the eligible population). As of 2026, Dourados reported 2,621 chikungunya cases and eight deaths, with one death under analysis. Nearly 60% of cases affect Indigenous residents; 21.3% White; 18% mixed-race (pardo). Contraindications include pregnancy or lactation, immunosuppression, congenital immunodeficiency, active cancer treatment, solid organ or bone marrow transplant within two years, HIV/AIDS, autoimmune diseases, and multiple chronic conditions. Also disqualifying are recent chikungunya infection within 30 days, fever, live attenuated vaccine within 28 days, or inactivated vaccine within 14 days. The effort aligns with Anvisa’s 2025 approval of a strategic vaccination plan covering about 20 municipalities in six states, as Brazil registered over 127,000 chikungunya cases and 125 deaths in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラード市（MS）の住民がチクングニア熱ワクチンの接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソドスル州で局所的なチクングニア熱の流行が発生しており、公衆衛生非常事態が宣言されている。2,621症例と8死亡が報告されており、深刻度と予想外性を満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内で局所的な流行が確認されているが、記事の主な焦点は予防接種キャンペーンとワクチン安全性である。チクングニア熱は2025年にブラジル全体で127,000症例以上が報告されており、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。HIV等の免疫状態を考慮した複雑な禁忌設定が示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 95 Persen Kasus Malaria Indonesia Terkonsentrasi di Papua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 95 percent of Indonesia's malaria cases are concentrated in Papua
article.articleSummary: 95% of Indonesia's malaria cases are concentrated in six Papuan provinces, with about 600,000 of an estimated 700,000 nationwide cases in 2025 occurring in Papua; outside Papua, roughly 32,000 cases are reported. Mimika District bears the heaviest burden, recording 190,597 cases in the previous year, about 27% of national malaria. To accelerate decline in Papua, the Ministry of Health implements the TOKEN (Temukan, Obati, Kendalikan) strategy. Cross-ministerial coordination led by the Deputy Ministers for Villages and Home Affairs and meetings with six Papuan governors aim to secure commitment for elimination. Despite 90% of Indonesians living in malaria-free areas, mobile migrant populations account for about 20% of cases, posing a risk of resurgence. Sporadic outbreaks (KLB) have been reported in areas previously malaria-free. As of now, 412 of 514 districts/cities are malaria-free, and seven provinces—Bali, Jakarta, Banten, West Java, East Java, Yogyakarta, South Sumatra—are entirely malaria-free. Continued migrant surveillance is essential to prevent reintroduction.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのマラリア症例の95%がパプアに集中している
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるマラリアの地理的集中が報告されているが、これは既知の地域性疾患の既存流行のパターン化であり、急性な異常事象ではない。ただし、モバイル移民集団による再流入リスクと以前マラリア撲滅地域での散発的な集団発生報告があるため、経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア国内のマラリア流行の地域的集中を報告している。パプア地域での高い感染負荷（約60万症例）と移民人口による再導入リスク、以前撲滅地域での散発的集団発生が懸念点。インドネシア保健省がTOKEN戦略で対応中。パプアニューギニアは記事の地理的参照としてのみ記載されており、当該イベントの主題ではないため verified_locations に含めない。
